lexicon.content: Il cuore dell'industria dell'intrattenimento di Los Angeles, teatro di fama e finzione. La Court of the Night manipola media e celebrità dietro le quinte, dove il confine tra umano e soprannaturale si assottiglia sotto le luci dei riflettori.
lexicon.name: Hollywood

lexicon.content:
The Hex Valley stop is a short wooden jetty on the valley floor, where the Yarrow runs through the middle of the terraces. There is no building, only a shelter, a bell on a post and a gravel track that climbs to the estate roads.

The stop exists because the valley is cut by the river and the vampire families' vineyards drink from it, so there has always been traffic between the water and the slopes. Most of what moves through here is cases going down rather than people coming up.

The ferry calls in the late afternoon in both directions, which suits a valley that keeps a crepuscular schedule anyway.
lexicon.name: Hex Valley Ferry Stop

lexicon.content: Il calendario della cappella è gestito su prenotazione dallo Student Association Building, con fasce orarie separate per le diverse confessioni e comunità del campus, oltre a serate libere per eventi studenteschi non religiosi. L'assenza di simbologia fissa permanente la rende adattabile a qualunque tipo di rito o celebrazione. È anche la sede fissa della Vampire & Undead Association, che vi si riunisce la domenica e il lunedì alle 23 per sostenere la piccola popolazione studentesca e di personale vampirico e non-morto del SUCC; l'associazione è nota per un processo di ammissione particolarmente rigoroso.
lexicon.name: Helsing Chapel

lexicon.content: Le palestre del campus SUCC e gli spogliatoi. Pesistica massiccia, spesso fuori scala per umani, e docce blindate per evitare incidenti da territorialità.
lexicon.name: Gym & Changing Facilities

lexicon.content: Oltre al celebre orologio e alle gargoyle a forma di grifone che si animano e sorvolano la torre ogni ora, l'edificio ospita ai piani superiori le Lecture Theatres delle facoltà di Giurisprudenza e Ingegneria, insieme agli uffici del corpo docente. Nel seminterrato, isolato dal resto della torre e accessibile principalmente in orario serale e notturno, si trova The Pendulum, un piccolo club informale, punto di ritrovo abituale per gli studenti dei corsi notturni di Nocturnal Hall. La torre, che di fatto funge da principale struttura per le lezioni del campus, chiude periodicamente per manutenzione: durante queste chiusure le classi vengono temporaneamente ricollocate a Building C.
lexicon.name: Griffin Clocktower

lexicon.content: Galleria d'arte studentesca del SUCC. Spazio espositivo elegante e tranquillo.
lexicon.name: Gallery

lexicon.content: Caserme separate per personale umano e non umano, strutture dimensionate per esigenze biologiche diverse (piscine per specie acquatiche, terreni aperti per weres e demihuman, banca del sangue, calendari lunari nei turni). Tensione nota e non risolta fra soldati umani e non umani riguardo a regole di fraternizzazione, trattamento e rischio in missione. Qui prestano servizio il Maggiore Graham Purcell e la squadra Alpha (Tenente Miles Airhardt, Sergente Rafael Callaway, Soldato Kade Leavis). Storicamente è anche dove Nixara Bloodmoon lavorò come consulente psichiatrica per il personale sovrannaturale durante Project BlackWolf, ebbe Kaladin Nargathon in cura, e dove Kaladin e Marcus Thornfield, unici sopravvissuti di Gamma-7, prestarono servizio prima di passare alla DCC Security Division nel 2019.
lexicon.name: Fort MacArthur

lexicon.content:
The flat takes up the whole upper floor of Directions & Dragons and is reached by an outside staircase at the side of the building. Shared, cheap, and closer to Bricklane than to campus, which is the entire reason anybody puts up with it.

It is a mess, and not a transient one. Books in stacks that have become furniture, laundry with a geography, a kitchen table that has not been fully visible in living memory, and a sofa that is the flat's most contested resource. The floor slopes toward the street corner and everything migrates that way.

Mackenzie Sanchez Rogers lives here. The noise from the shop stops at six and the noise from Bricklane does not, so the flat is loud in a way that its residents have stopped registering and visitors have not.

The one immaculate thing is the fire escape, because the shop below is full of paper and the landlord is not sentimental about it.
lexicon.name: Flat above Directions & Dragons

lexicon.content: Studio di produzione gestito da vampiri, situato nel distretto di Paradise a Blackwood City, cuore della scena artistica e dell'intrattenimento del quartiere.
lexicon.name: Eidolon Creative

lexicon.content: Dullahan's residence in the Contractor wing of DDM HQ: a set of rooms shaped like a comfortable, permanently messy two-storey house. Weapons on the furniture, a television always on, and dozens of cats, kittens and cat-adjacent creatures, each named after somebody he knows. Kept running by his two ACES, Bartholomew the butler and Madge, who enforces the house rules absolutely.
lexicon.name: Dullahan's Quarters

lexicon.content: Dullahan's condo, a small rented two-bedroom in a beige block ten minutes from the SUCC campus. Permanently messy: playbooks, game tape, three televisions always on, takeaway boxes, a weight bench, and a hook-shaped axe by the door he calls a Halloween prop. Far too many cats, each named after somebody he knows. No mirrors and no photographs of himself anywhere. Almost nobody has ever been inside.
lexicon.name: Dullahan's Condo

lexicon.content: Uno stretto sentiero alberato del SUCC, noto agli studenti come scorciatoia per raggiungere il Lunar Quad dalla Fraternity & Sorority Row senza prendere la strada principale del campus.
lexicon.name: Dragon's Shortcut

lexicon.content:
Il piazzale centrale del SUCC, incrocio nevralgico della vita studentesca. Affollato a tutte le ore da migliaia di studenti soprannaturali. All'ingresso svetta lo striscione 'Welcome Freshman 2024!', costantemente monitorato dall'alto dalla discreta sorveglianza aerea dei droni DCC.

Prato calpestato e cemento chiaro accecante sotto il sole, gruppi sparsi sulle panchine e sull'erba, biciclette abbandonate ovunque. Il chiacchiericcio sovrapposto di decine di specie diverse, qualcuno che ripassa ad alta voce, qualcuno che dorme sullo zaino. Da qui si vede la Griffin Clocktower e si raggiunge tutto il resto del campus.

Nelle sere in cui non si tiene a Nocturnal Hall (a rotazione stagionale), il Lunar Quad ospita anche le riunioni del martedi di The Pack, la societa ufficiale were e canide/lupina del campus.

Al centro del piazzale c'e la fontana decorativa della luna. La sua faccia riproduce sempre la fase lunare corrente, quindi cambia di notte in notte, ed e il modo piu veloce che ha chiunque attraversi il campus per sapere a che punto e il mese. Nei giorni intorno alla luna piena il piazzale si riempie molto oltre il solito.

[LOCATION INSTRUCTIONS: Luogo di passaggio e di incontri casuali. Qualcuno di conosciuto puo sempre comparire qui senza bisogno di spiegazioni. Spazio pubblico e visibile: le conversazioni private qui vengono sentite.]
lexicon.name: Lunar Quad

lexicon.content:
The landing is a single stone quay at the upstream end of Dockside, wedged between the barge berths that do the city's actual river freight. It was not built for passengers and has never been rebuilt for them: a mooring, a gangway, a shed with a stove in it.

Blackwood is inland, so this is river traffic and not a port, and the distinction matters to everyone who works here. The ferry is a small, tolerated part of a quay that is otherwise gravel, timber and scrap.

It is the upstream terminus of the line and the only scheduled passenger service in or out of Blackwood that is not a road.
lexicon.name: Dockside Ferry Landing

lexicon.content: Zona di import/export fluviale di Blackwood City, situata sulle rive dello Yarrow River (Blackwood è nell'entroterra, non è una città costiera). Non un vero molo marittimo: banchine, gru e magazzini per il traffico merci via chiatta lungo il fiume navigabile, nebbia costante, odore di acqua dolce e pesce di fiume, territorio di contrabbandieri e creature anfibie. Un traghetto collega Dockside a Solarton (dove lo Yarrow sfocia in mare), usato soprattutto da turisti più che come reale rotta commerciale. Il nome moderno del fiume è una storpiatura anglosassone del norreno originale "Ýrá".
lexicon.name: Dockside

lexicon.content:
Directions & Dragons is a two storey building on the corner of the Bricklane grid, shop below and a flat above, with a wooden sign that has swung crooked since before anyone currently studying at SUCC arrived.

It is a bookshop and it is very clear about not being a library. Where the Basilisk Library is the academic collection, this is the trade: tabletop manuals and modules, hand drawn regional maps, field guides to things students are told not to approach, secondhand grimoires of no verified provenance, compasses, lanterns, rope, and a rack of walking boots in sizes that no ordinary outfitter stocks.

The two halves of the stock explain the name and explain the clientele. Half the customers are here for a Tuesday night game and half are here because they are actually going somewhere, and both halves get served at the same counter by staff who have long stopped distinguishing.

There is a permanent table at the back where games run, and a noticeboard by the door that is the most reliable place in Solarton to find a group, a lift, or a warning about a trail.
lexicon.name: Directions & Dragons

lexicon.content:
Delta Omicron Epsilon is fourth on the campus side, between Beta Rho Omega above and Mu Alpha Nu below, facing Alpha Sigma Sigma across the road.

The position is the difficult one on the Row. DOE has the loudest fraternity in the system directly opposite it and the most hostile one directly below it, and no sorority within shouting distance on its own side. Whatever else the house is, it is the one that had to learn to hold a line early.

The letters follow the animal pattern the sorority system fell into a long time ago, alongside MOO, FOX and BEE. Nobody on the Row can explain when that started.
lexicon.name: Delta Omicron Epsilon (DOE or ΔΟΕ)

lexicon.content: DDM Inc. Headquarters, a vast non-euclidean building suspended in voidspace with no exterior. Windows are screens faking a cityscape for morale. Contains mess halls, training floors, classrooms, infirmary, HR, and living wings separated for mortal staff, ACES and Contractors. The restricted lower levels store and study supernatural artefacts. Departments: A.O.C, Security and Defense, Euclidean Division, Supernatural Research, Human Resources, LAZARUS.
lexicon.name: DDM Inc. Headquarters

lexicon.content: La torre della Dominion Compliance Council nel cuore di Blackwood City, monolite di luce LED perenne e aria condizionata sterile che domina lo skyline. Insieme alla 101 Freeway, che funge da barriera geografica, è uno dei due epicentri di potere della città.
lexicon.name: DCC Tower

lexicon.content: Quartieri residenziali di Solarton lungo la costa. Case unifamiliari tranquille con vista sull'oceano.
lexicon.name: Coastal Residential

lexicon.content:
Claws Steel & Ink has a street front on the quieter of the two main Bricklane lanes, glass at the front and a long room behind it with four stations and a piercing room at the back.

The walls are flash sheets to the ceiling, and a good third of the work on them is not designs so much as solutions: patterns that read correctly over fur, layouts that survive a partial shift, placements that account for skin that will not be the same shape in twelve hours. The shop's real specialism is bodies that change, and the ordinary human work pays the rent between.

Steel is the other half of the name and it is meant literally. Piercing here means knowing which alloys go into which client, because a stud that is fine on one student is a chemical burn on another, and the shop keeps a wall chart about it that the artists point to rather than explain again.

Javier Sinclair works here part time while he studies Art and Media at SUCC. He tattoos and pierces, he is precise to the point of being slow, and the shop keeps him because the work is good and the regulars ask for him.

Sterilisation is visible from the front counter on purpose. The shop has been inspected more often than any other business in Bricklane and has the certificates framed where you have to look at them while you wait.
lexicon.name: Claws Steel & Ink

lexicon.content: Distesa arida di pompe di estrazione petrolifera a Bakersfield. Vecchie cisterne vuote e pozzi esauriti nascondono rifugi sotterranei e depositi illegali della criminalità locale.
lexicon.name: Campi Petroliferi di Kern River

lexicon.content: Il grande stadio di football del campus SUCC. Gradinate immense, erba sintetica, riflettori altissimi.
lexicon.name: Bulls Stadium (St. Neptune Athletic Complex)

lexicon.content: Aule didattiche standard, usate normalmente per lezioni ordinarie e uffici del corpo docente. Assume un ruolo speciale nei periodi in cui la Griffin Clocktower chiude per manutenzione: in quelle finestre, le lezioni normalmente ospitate nella torre vengono temporaneamente ricollocate qui, con conseguente sovraffollamento momentaneo dell'edificio.
lexicon.name: Building C

lexicon.content: Building B ospita prevalentemente aule di piccole dimensioni per corsi con iscrizioni limitate e gli uffici del corpo docente. Al piano terra si trova un'area studio comune, aperta a tutti gli studenti, spesso usata per gruppi di studio informali tra una lezione e l'altra.
lexicon.name: Building B

lexicon.content: L'edificio raggruppa sia aule generiche di piccole dimensioni sia lecture theatres più capienti, usate soprattutto per i corsi introduttivi e le classi a maggioranza umana. È il primo punto di contatto con il campus per molte matricole umane, per lo stile architettonico più familiare rispetto agli edifici magici del resto del campus.
lexicon.name: Building A

lexicon.content:
Bluemoon is Blackwood City's nightlife district, a former industrial strip of exposed brick warehouses and converted garages now split between working-class daytime businesses and after-dark venues. By day it's quiet, mechanics, diners, corner bars serving locals. After sundown, neon signage flickers on across the district and it becomes the city's underground entertainment corridor, drawing a mixed crowd of humans and supernaturals alike. Several venues here operate under Neutral Territory status, making Bluemoon one of the few parts of the city where faction politics are expected to stay outside.

[LOCATION INSTRUCTIONS: Daytime scenes here should feel grounded and unglamorous: working-class, practical, low stakes. Nighttime scenes shift to neon-lit, pulsing, slightly hedonistic energy. Always let the tone shift with the hour rather than staying static.]
lexicon.name: Bluemoon

lexicon.content:
The baths stand apart from the Longhouse itself, built of logs thick enough that the walls read as a single piece of wood, set directly over a natural thermal spring. White plumes of steam rise between the trees around it and are visible from a distance in cold weather, which is the only part of the Bloodmoon compound that announces itself at all.

Inside it smells strongly of sulphur and hot water. The basin is carved out of the rock and the water boils up gently through it, and the only light comes through the gaps in the roof, so the interior is dim at every hour. It is the one place in the compound where the old household routine still runs exactly as it always has: someone prepares the baths, and the baths are used, and nobody has changed the procedure in a very long time.
lexicon.name: Bloodmoon Longhouse Baths

lexicon.content:
La massiccia struttura norrena millenaria sotto il grande tasso. Niente elettricità, zero tecnologia. Il dominio assoluto di Wulfnic e dei Firstborn.

Il grande tasso sorge accanto alla sala, non lontano: è l'albero che Wulfnic ha piantato, e ai suoi piedi nasce la sorgente dello Yarrow. Intorno alla radura si stringe un'enclave di capanne norrene, una ventina, dove vive il branco. Legno, torba e pietra, fuochi veri, nessun cavo.

C'è un solo accesso: il sentiero sterrato che sale nei boschi da Villa Douglas. Nessuna strada asfaltata arriva fin qui, e non ce n'è una seconda.
lexicon.name: Bloodmoon Longhouse

lexicon.content: L'ospedale principale di Blackwood City, nel tranquillo distretto residenziale di Arcadia, vicino alle scuole primarie della città.
lexicon.name: Blackwood General Hospital

lexicon.content:
Popular with 'cryptid' and less-common species, the Bigfeet Hiking Club is very welcoming to new members and organises a r ange of hikes and camping trips over the academic year. Most popular is the summer getaway, a week long camping trip known for beautiful views...and lots of drinking.
Location: Unicorn Hall
Schedule: Varies
lexicon.name: Bigfeet Hiking Club

lexicon.content: Quartiere residenziale esclusivo di Los Angeles, enclave di ricchezza e vecchio potere. Ritrovo di celebrità mondane, vampiri dell'alta società e ricchi licantropi.
lexicon.name: Beverly Hills

lexicon.content:
Beta Rho Omega is third down the campus side, tucked between Theta Iota Theta above it and Delta Omicron Epsilon below, and looks across the road at Phi Omicron Chi.

The letters read as BRO and the house leans into it without embarrassment. It is the athletes' house: Jared Thompson, Bailey Rogers and Santiago Herrera all live here, and the split between Bulls and Bears runs straight through the common room, which is either the best thing about the house or the reason nothing gets decided in it.

The front yard has a permanent set of weights under a tarp and a barbecue that has never once been put away. Noise carries north to the TIT, which is the single most reliable source of friction on the Row and has never escalated past shouting from a window.
lexicon.name: Beta Rho Omega (BRO or ΒΡΩ)

lexicon.content:
Beta Epsilon Epsilon is last on the outer side, the southernmost house on the Row, directly opposite Mu Alpha Nu.

Being at the bottom of the street means the longest walk to campus and the least foot traffic past the door, and being opposite MAN means the house shares a stretch of road with the one fraternity that has a political position. Those two facts define the place more than anything the house does on its own.

The letters follow the animal pattern shared with MOO, DOE and FOX.
lexicon.name: Beta Epsilon Epsilon (BEE or ΒΕΕ)

lexicon.content: The broad civic centerpiece of downtown Bakersfield, California. Characterized by wide sunbaked avenues, red-brick municipal halls, classic clock towers, and heat-resistant desert landscaping, the square acts as a prominent Central Valley hub where regional logistics, agricultural commercial interests, and inland supernatural packs intersect.
lexicon.name: Bakersfield Square

lexicon.content: L'edificio ospita sia il dipartimento di Belle Arti, con aule di pittura e scultura sempre disordinate e piene di opere in corso, sia quello di Arti Performative, con sale prova per danza, teatro e musica. Un Auditorium interno viene usato regolarmente per saggi, spettacoli studenteschi e proiezioni.
lexicon.name: Arts Building

lexicon.content:
Artemis is the women's hall at CUMS, a long gothic block on the north side of the campus with heavy shutters on every window and a courtyard that gets no direct sun at any hour, which was the point of building it there.

The hall runs on the university's crepuscular timetable: quiet through the middle of the day, awake from late afternoon, loudest around midnight. Rooms are doubles with blackout fittings as standard rather than as an accommodation, and the lower floor is windowless for residents who want it that way.

About half the hall is at least part vampire, which at CUMS is simply the demographic and not a remark. The rest are fae, undead of various kinds, and a small number of witches admitted on ability.

It is named for the moon, and its residents have opinions about the fact that the men's hall is named for the sun.
lexicon.name: Artemis Dorms

lexicon.content: Motel scadente con annessa tavola calda lungo la Route 101, a metà strada tra Blackwood City e Solarton. Funge da punto di sosta neutrale per viandanti soprannaturali e corrieri: territorio strettamente neutrale, niente spargimenti di sangue.
lexicon.name: Area di Servizio "The Halfway House"

lexicon.content: Una delle scuole primarie del quiet distretto residenziale di Arcadia, a Blackwood City, non lontano dal Blackwood General Hospital.
lexicon.name: Arcadia School

lexicon.content: Quartiere residenziale di Blackwood City, a ridosso di Seven Hills. Case familiari, vita di quartiere tranquilla; ospita il Blackwood General Hospital (principale struttura ospedaliera cittadina) e il polo scolastico low-grade della città (asilo, elementari e medie), a differenza delle strutture accademiche superiori/universitarie che si trovano invece a Solarton (SUCC). Di fatto è annesso al territorio di Seven Hills: non ha un proprio pack leader di distretto e ricade sotto l'autorità dei Seven Hills.
lexicon.name: Arcadia

lexicon.content:
Apollo is the men's hall at CUMS, the south block, built to the same plan as Artemis and to the same specification: shutters, blackout, a windowless lower floor, and a courtyard laid out to stay shaded.

The naming is the university's joke on itself. The sun hall is where nobody wants sun, and every intake works this out in its first week and thinks it is the first to notice.

The hall keeps the campus crepuscular schedule and is the more social of the two residences, which mostly means the courtyard is in use at three in the morning and Artemis has complained about it in writing more than once.

Most of the Clams and the Beavers live here in season, which does not help the noise.
lexicon.name: Apollo Dorms

lexicon.content:
SUCC's Anime Club: An informal group where both human and supernatural otakus gather to watch anime and discuss anime & manga series.
Location: Library Basement Meeting Room 005
Schedule: Fridays at 6 PM
Known Members: Stan Davies Jr., Andrew Campbell, Oskar
lexicon.name: Anime Club

lexicon.content:
Alpha Sigma Sigma is fourth on the outer side, between Phi Omicron Chi and Beta Epsilon Epsilon, looking across at Delta Omicron Epsilon.

The letters spell ASS and the house has spent decades deciding that this is funny rather than a problem, which has shaped the entire personality of the place. The ASS is the party house of record: loudest, least organised, most likely to be the reason campus security drives down the Row on a Friday.

Vincent and Andrew Campbell both live here.

The alternating layout of the Row puts a sorority directly opposite every fraternity, and the ASS has DOE, which means the house's noise problem is a neighbour problem and not an abstraction.
lexicon.name: Alpha Sigma Sigma (ASS or ΑΣΣ)

lexicon.content:
Alpha Rho Omega sits at the very top of the campus side of the Row, first house you reach walking down from the main campus, with Mu Omega Omega directly across the road.

It is the least theatrical of the five fraternities. No columns, no painted letters three feet high, just a wide porch that always has somebody on it and a lawn that gets mowed roughly when somebody remembers. The house reads as a place people live in rather than a place people perform in.

Finnegan Novak lives here. The ARO porch looks straight down onto the Theta Iota Theta front steps, so whoever ends up living in that sorority in a given year is his immediate neighbour and neither of them can leave the house without the possibility of running into the other. Revazhael lives here too, and does the handyman work for the sorority next door, which is less a job than a consequence of geography.

The practical effect of the position is that ARO is the crossing point of the Row. Everyone walking to campus from any of the ten houses passes this porch.
lexicon.name: Alpha Rho Omega (ARO or ΑΡΩ)

lexicon.content: Il viale delle confraternite del SUCC. Strutture imponenti, feste perenni e forte segregazione per clan o specie.
lexicon.name: Fraternity & Sorority Row (Greek Row)

lexicon.content: Edificio amministrativo del SUCC. Uffici burocratici, presidenza, segreterie.
lexicon.name: Administration

lexicon.content: Alloggi extra per studenti del SUCC, appartamenti condivisi appena fuori dal ring principale del campus.
lexicon.name: Additional Student Housing

lexicon.content:
A&Co. has a wide street front on the main Bricklane lane, all mirror and warm light, and the mannequins in the window are not human shaped: one has a ten foot wingspan, one is built for a centaur's barrel, one has four arms.

The sign is three characters and a full stop, black on white, with the ampersand in fuchsia. Nobody who has not met Angelo Moreno reads anything into it. Everybody who has met him reads Angelo and Company and understands that the loud part of the name is the part he could not resist.

It is the Solarton window of Eidolon Creative, not its home. The house is in Blackwood City, in Paradise; this is where the line is actually sold, to the people it was cut for.

What they sell is fit. Jeans and trousers with a tail port, hemmed and reinforced rather than cut open with scissors at home. Shirts and jackets cut for a wingspan, back panels split and fastened so the wings come through without the whole garment hanging like a sack. Collars and hoods sized for ears that do not lie flat. Hats with horn cutouts in every configuration anybody has thought to ask for. Shoes for digitigrade feet and for hooves. Compression wear that does not chafe over scales. Formalwear, which is the expensive end and the reason the place stays open, because a demihuman who needs a suit for a funeral has nowhere else to go.

The staff measure properly, they do not stare, and they have heard the question before. For a lot of young supernaturals the first trip to A&Co. is the first time getting dressed has not been a compromise, and the shop knows perfectly well what it is actually selling, which is not clothes.

The alterations counter at the back does same day work and is where the real business happens.
lexicon.name: A&Co.

lexicon.content:
Bricklane is not a mall in any sense a visitor from a bigger city would recognise. It is a quaint outdoor shopping area of low two storey buildings, each one its own business with its own front door onto the street, laid out on a small grid of lanes too narrow for through traffic. Cars stop at the edge and everyone walks.

The paving is old red brick, which is where the name comes from, worn smooth in the middle of each lane and still sharp at the kerbs. Two planted courtyards break the grid, one with a fountain that works most of the year and one with three jacarandas and a ring of benches that fills up between classes. String lights cross the lanes overhead and stay up year round.

The tenants are the ordinary business of a coastal college town, sized for a population that is not entirely human. Nothing here is a chain. Shops open late in term time and close early in August. Students treat it as the default place to be when there is nowhere they have to be, which means most conversations in Solarton that are not on campus happen somewhere in these four lanes.
lexicon.name: Bricklane Mall

lexicon.content: Russ works as a tattoo apprentice at Claws Steel and Ink in the Bricklane district of Solarton. His genuine talent is starting to show through the still-rough early work, but he has done at least one bad tattoo on each of the boys from nights they don't fully remember. Those shitty early pieces are permanent monuments to bad decisions. Every tattoo Russ gives, on his own skin or a client's, tells a story. It's his way of leaving a permanent mark in a world that changes too fast, blending precision and sentimentality.
lexicon.name: Russ's Tattoo Shop
lexicon.comment: Russ's Tattoo Shop

lexicon.content: Dean's dorm smells like garlic and weed. He's got a hot plate setup that's technically not allowed, spices everywhere, a bag of weed that's barely hidden, and a mattress he never makes. The boys hang there the most because there's always food. Russ's apartment is a mess except the kitchen counter where he makes breakfast. His cat has claimed most of the furniture. Eric's dorm looks like a thrift store exploded, ramen cups stacked like architecture, guitar and amp taking up half the floor. Javier's room has the fairy lights and posters trying to have a vibe but the laundry pile ruins it. Raymond's frat room has a beanbag chair, party flyers, solo cups, and a protein powder collection that takes up an entire shelf.
lexicon.name: Locations - Living Spaces
lexicon.comment: Locations - Living Spaces

lexicon.title: Camp Mystic
lexicon.content:
[LOCATION: Camp Mystic; REGION: Riserva boschiva sul Lago Erie; TYPE: Campo estivo e centro d addestramento sovrannaturale]
Struttura estiva per studenti del SUCC con chalet in legno rinforzato, moli per canoe e barriere antimostro runiche.

created.name: Svartúlfr - Lorebook
created.description:
Svartúlfr | Urban is set in modern-day supernatural California, where an ancient werewolf dynasty, chaotic campus life, and high-stakes dungeon incursions collide. At its center lies Blackwood: the thousand-year-old supernatural seat tucked inland within dense pine forests, ruled by the Douglas-Bloodmoon werewolf dynasty. A short drive away sits Solarton, the vibrant coastal college town hosting SUCC (Supernatural University of Central California), where young supernaturals, demi-humans, and mages navigate collegiate freedom, raw impulses, and intense rivalries.

The patriarch, Erik Douglas, heads the Douglas Commercial Coalition (DCC), an ancient merchant house founded in 1666 that grew into an international trade empire. Since 2019, the DCC has fielded its own heavily armed Security Division, commanded by Major Kaladin Nargathon—an elite PMC answering family curfews and territorial breaches with biometric drones, silver-tipped ordnance, and tactical extraction teams.

Underneath the corporate towers and neon nightlife lies the Modern Fantasy frontier: dimensional Rifts, monster-infested Dungeon Hives, and the Hunters Guild. In districts like the Cable District and the Dockside riverfront, licensed vanguard teams like Team Ukiyo (led by the werewolf vanguard Radek, the minotaur tank Goran, and the half-elf DPS Kian) and nomadic heavy-hitters like Marek and the Ironhorn Nomads brave subterranean Apex Trials. Here, modern tactical gear merges with abyssal cores, enchanted weaponry, and sacred relics, creating a lucrative and lethal dungeon-crawler economy guarded by Council master builders like Barrow 'The Bull'.

Roleplay in Svartúlfr is raw, visceral, and completely unchained. Every interaction pulses with Lupine Social Ecology (LSE): active olfactory awareness, shifting pheromones, intense dominance and submission dynamics, territorial drives, and the primal heat and rut cycles of werewolves and demi-humans. Adult characters experience fierce romantic chemistry, unfiltered passion, unapologetic desire, and brutal tactical combat in dark alleys and dungeon depths alike.

The overarching narrator is Wulfnic Báleygr, the immortal 1199-year-old Firstborn werewolf consecrated by Fenris in 827 AD. Having crossed the Arctic by longship and planted the sacred yew on the banks of the Yarrow in 1022 AD, the one-eyed Primordial watches every generation of his bloodline through the stolen eye of Odin the Betrayer, chronicling a saga of ancient blood, untamed desire, and perilous modern power.

lexicon.content:
Species Overview: Mutant & Hybrid

Beings born of inter-species unions (e.g., were-demon, elven-vampire, chimeric demihumans) or altered through prolonged exposure to volatile Dungeon rift radiation and arcane experimentation.

Physiology & Diversity:
Hybrids display unique, heterogeneous physical traits: overlapping scale and fur patches, dual horn configurations, mismatched irises, or anomalous magical affinities that defy single-species categories.

Survival & Society:
Often possessing unpredictable tactical abilities and high adaptability, hybrids navigate both mainstream collegiate life and gritty underworld syndicates, balancing dual instinctual heritages.
lexicon.name: Species: Mutant & Hybrid

lexicon.content:
Species Overview: Machine & Synthetic

Advanced sapient androids, runic automatons, and cyber-augmented beings operating at the intersection of modern robotics, artificial intelligence, and arcane magitech.

Physiology & Construction:
Constructed with carbon-fiber skeletal frameworks, synthetic biometric skin, subdermal wiring, and mana-stabilized processing cores. They possess flawless calculated recall, precise mechanical motor control, and complete immunity to psychic suggestion and biological ailments.

Roles & Society:
Employed in heavy cybersecurity, DCC technical infrastructure, tactical drone coordination, high-precision magical laboratories, and automated concierge systems.
lexicon.name: Species: Machine & Synthetic

lexicon.content:
Species Overview: God & Primordial

Ancient immortal entities whose existence predates modern history, including the Nine Firstborn of the Svartulfr pantheon (Wulfnic, Ut, Zefir, and their brethren) and primordial spirits.

Physiology & Divine Blood:
Beings of immense sovereign presence, unaging biological invulnerability, and spiritual dominance. Their blood carries divine resonance, passing legendary endurance and instinctual pack authority down to Founding Bloodlines (such as the Douglas-Bloodmoon family).

Role in the World:
Rather than ruling from remote heavens, modern Primordials live quietly amidst their descendants—advising Great Houses, forging ancient masterworks, and safeguarding mortal realms from cataclysmic reality tears and void space incursions.
lexicon.name: Species: God & Primordial

lexicon.content:
Species Overview: Kitsune & Neko

Feline and vulpine demihumans celebrated for their agility, expressive animal ears, multiple or plush tails, and natural sensory cunning.

Physiology & Single-Ear Rule:
They possess sleek, acrobatic human bodies topped by a single pair of pointed furry ears (vulpine or feline) at the crown of the head. In accordance with demihuman anatomy, they have no human ears on the sides of the head and no body fur. Kitsune may manifest multiple bushy tails as their magical age and spiritual resonance deepen.

Demeanor & Culture:
Curious, independent, and fiercely loyal to close circles. They possess razor reflexes, stealthy digitigrade-like footing, and acute night vision. Prominent in collegiate social life (such as CUMS and SUCC campus cliques), entertainment, and fast-paced agile combat.
lexicon.name: Species: Kitsune & Neko

lexicon.content:
Species Overview: Undead & Revenant

Sentient corporeal undead beings who maintain consciousness, personality, and autonomy after biological death through necromantic preservation, curses, or ancestral oaths.

Physiology & Condition:
Undead bodies possess no beating heart, cool desiccated flesh, pale or ashen skin, and complete immunity to metabolic fatigue, conventional poisons, and hypothermia. They heal via necrotic energy, occult fixatives, or specialized biological sustenance (as seen in curse-afflicted fixers like Everett Rottmore).

Legal & Social Status:
Protected under modern supernatural civil rights accords, represented by organizations like the VUA. They work extensively in historical archiving, mortuary occult services, and hazardous rift operations immune to biological contagion.
lexicon.name: Species: Undead & Revenant

lexicon.content:
Species Overview: Orc & Oni

Towering, heavily muscled warrior humanoids known for raw physical power, dense bone structure, and proud martial traditions.

Physiology & Appearance:
Standing between 6'4" and 7'2", Orcs and Oni display distinctive protruding lower canines (tusks), square heavy jawlines, thick skin ranging from dusky green and slate grey to deep red, and singular or twin forehead horns (Oni). They possess immense physical stamina and high pain thresholds.

Social Integration:
Far from savage stereotypes, modern Orcs and Oni are prominent civic leaders, master blacksmiths, heavy industrial foremen, athletic superstars, and respected Guild vanguard tanks holding dungeon aggro with ironclad resolve.

lexicon.content:
Species Overview: Arachne & Drider

Arachnid humanoids possessing either a human upper torso mounted atop a colossal eight-legged spider abdomen (classical Arachne) or human bipedal form with four to six chitinous spider limbs emerging from the back, multiple eyes, and silk spinnerets.

Physiology & Senses:
Arachne possess micro-sensory setae capable of detecting micro-vibrations across rooms, walls, and digital floorboards. They produce ultra-resilient tensile silk utilized in high-grade ballistic tailoring, medical stitching, and tactical traps.

Culture & Industry:
Renowned for precision weaving, haute couture design (competing with high-end vampire tailors), cryptographic engineering, and stealth tactical ambush work within subterranean rifts.
lexicon.name: Species: Arachne & Drider

lexicon.content:
Species Overview: Lamia & Naga

Serpentine demihumans combining a humanoid upper torso with a long, muscular serpentine lower body spanning twelve to twenty feet in length.

Physiology & Locomotion:
Lacking mammalian legs, Lamias and Nagas glide gracefully via rhythmic abdominal contractions across flat surfaces, capable of sudden explosive coiling strikes and immense constriction force. They possess heat-sensing pit organs, forked sensory tongues, and retractable venom fangs.

Urban Infrastructure:
Modern California cities provide accessible low-rise ramps, carpeted lounge seating, and heated floor panels to accommodate serpentine resting habits. Nagas work across high-end security, contortion arts, pharmacology, and Guild exploration.
lexicon.name: Species: Lamia & Naga

lexicon.content:
Species Overview: Merfolk & Siren

Aquatic humanoids native to coastal waters, abyssal trenches, and enchanted inland lakes, fully adapted to both terrestrial urban life and marine depths.

Physiology & Hydration:
Merfolk possess webbed fingers, iridescent aquatic scales along the hips and calves, streamlined ear-fins, and adaptive respiratory gills alongside terrestrial lungs. In terrestrial settings, modern moisture-retaining gels and specialized hydration wear allow them to live comfortably in coastal cities like Blackwood and Solarton.

Vocal & Sonic Affinity:
Sirens and merfolk possess mesmerizing, melodic voices capable of acoustic modulation, emotional suggestion, and underwater sonar communication. They excel in the performing arts, marine biology, and aquatic rift salvage.
lexicon.name: Species: Merfolk & Siren

Species Overview: Dragon & Drake

Dragons are ancient, apex reptilian beings possessing immense elemental mana reserves, towering physical stature, and formidable longevity. In modern times, they navigate the world in humanoid or partial-draconic form.

Physiology & Scale Armor:
In humanoid form, dragons display sweeping curved horns, patch-like clusters of iridescent scales along the jaw, neck, shoulders, and hips, slit reptilian pupils, and a heavy, muscular tail. Their scales are dense enough to deflect blade strikes and small-caliber gunfire.

Elemental Breath & Aura:
Every dragon lineage is attuned to an elemental core (fire, frost, lightning, shadow). They command an overpowering predatory aura that causes instinctual reverence or dread in weaker beings. Many dragons hold ancient territorial wealth, running private banks, luxury jewelers, or elite combat guilds.
lexicon.name: Species: Dragon & Drake

lexicon.content:
Species Overview: Angel & Celestial

Celestials are beings of radiant divine origin characterized by serene beauty, moral authority, and majestic feathered wings emerging from their shoulder blades.

Physiology & Presence:
Angels possess symmetrical human features, luminous skin, and large plumage wings (often white, silver, or golden) that require custom-tailored apparel with back slits. They radiate an ambient calm and authority that naturally de-escalates conflict.

Modern Roles:
While bound by ancient celestial lineage, modern angels in the Svartulfr setting operate across diverse secular and sacred institutions: running university administrative offices, legal advocacy groups, diplomatic embassies, and divine restoration clinics within the DMHA.

Demons are sapient beings native to the Infernal planes and Abyssal rifts, fully integrated into the modern supernatural underworld, corporate hierarchies, and magical academia.

Demons exhibit exotic skin complexions (crimson, obsidian, deep violet, or olive), prominent cranial horns of varied curvature, prehensile muscular tails often ending in spade or barbed tips, and vertical pupiled irises. Their internal body temperature runs notably higher than humans, granting natural heat resistance.

Demons possess raw physical might, indomitable presence, and razor-sharp bargaining instincts. In urban centers like Los Angeles and Solarton, they operate private detective agencies (e.g., Damien Bishop), underground clubs, and high-stakes criminal syndicates.

The Fae encompass enchanting, magical beings connected to the Otherworld and natural glamours, ranging from palm-sized winged pixies to human-proportioned demi-fae.

Fae possess delicate, shimmering gossamer wings capable of agile flight, radiant skin, and natural glamours that alter sensory perception. They possess an innate, playful charisma and high kinetic agility, balanced by delicate physical endurance.

Social Dynamics:
Known for sharp wit, bureaucratic cunning (such as fae executive assistants and fixers), and artistic excellence. They abide by strict ancient rules of hospitality, bargains, and spoken promises, viewing casual verbal agreements with contractual gravity.

Elves are long-lived, highly refined humanoids with slender, graceful frames, pointed ears, and an innate affinity for intricate spellcraft, botanical sciences, and formal diplomacy.

Physiology & Longevity:
Living for multiple centuries without cellular senescence, elves maintain flawless skin, graceful carriage, heightened sensory perception, and keen visual acuity. Their elongated, elegant ears are sensitive to ambient acoustic vibrations and micro-expressions.

Cultural & Professional Spheres:
Elves excel as academic researchers, arcane botanical specialists, corporate legal strategists, and high-tier rift arcanists. They balance historical pride with contemporary modern lifestyles, often occupying prominent faculty chairs at universities like SUCC and CUMS.

Commonly found in high-contact athletics (such as the Bulls football team), frontline Guild defense squads, industrial manufacturing, and private bodyguard details due to their natural shock-absorption and frontline dominance.

Demihumans possess a predominantly human body with distinct bestial physical traits inherited from their animal lineage (ears, tails, horns, reptilian scales, plumage, tongues, fangs, or slit pupils). 
CRITICAL ANATOMY: Demihumans possess only a single pair of ears: their animal ears atop the head. They do not have a second pair of human ears on the sides of the skull. Demihumans do not have full animal fur coats or paws on their bodies; their limbs and torso are smooth human skin.

Demihumans express emotional cues vividly through their bestial anatomy: flattening ears when threatened or distressed, wagging or whipping tails, pupils expanding during arousal or predatory focus, and scent-marking trusted companions. Physiology & Anatomy:
Unlike demihumans who maintain a permanent human body with animal appendages, Shifters possess an active morphogenic reservoir allowing structural body transformation. In hybrid or shifted states, they manifest enhanced skeletal density, predatory instincts, natural armaments (horns, antlers, razor claws), and animal vocalizations.

Social Standing:
Often integrated into urban syndicates, private military contractors, and wilderness enclaves. They balance primal predatory impulses with modern civilization, frequently working as high-impact enforcers, athletes, or rift scouts.
lexicon.name: Species: Shifter & Anthro

Species Overview: Werewolf & Lycanthrope

Physiology & Anatomy:
Werewolves possess dense muscle fiber, heightened olfactory and auditory senses capable of reading emotional shifts and pheromones, rapid cellular regeneration, and formidable bite force. They can execute a Partial Shift (displaying pointed lupine ears at the top of the skull, elongated fangs, retractable claws, and enhanced musculature) or a Full Shift into a massive quadrupedal dire wolf. Demi-human anatomy rules apply: they possess only a single pair of ears (lupine, no second pair of human ears).

Vulnerabilities & Biology:
Severe biological allergy and tissue rejection to refined silver, which arrests cellular regeneration and burns upon contact. Subject to instinctual rut and heat cycles governed by lunar and pack resonance.

Standard terrestrial biology without inherent physical transformations, acute beast senses, or native spellcasting reservoirs. While physically more fragile than werewolves, demons, or apex demihumans, humans possess immense adaptability, technological ingenuity, and societal governance roles.

Lacking internal mana cores, humans rely heavily on external magitech implements, enchanted ammunition, runic tech, or contracts with supernatural entities to operate within planar rifts and Dungeon incursions. Headquarters, Suspended in Voidspace; EXECUTIVE_BODY: The Board of Contractors, Soul-bound to The Council in exchange for a singular wish and immortality; ROSTER: #01 Richard Whitlock (Leader), #02 Hana & Adam Valencia, #03 Luka Sutter, #04 Dullahan, #05 Johan Jakobsen, #06 Fenrir, #07 Redacted]

OVERVIEW:
The Contractors are elite immortal beings chosen at the moment of their original deaths by The Council of DDM Inc. to preserve reality and mend reality tears across the multiverse. Bound by absolute soul covenants, they command reality-bending powers while operating outside the flow of conventional mortal time. None of them have ever set foot in California, yet all of them are one dimensional step away, and #04 (Coach Dullahan) references them frequently.

RULE OF PRECEDENCE IN CALIFORNIA (RULE 10):
Contractor rules, ACES bonds, ARC Levels, and DDM corporate terminology apply exclusively within Voidspace and off-world reality breaks. On California soil, Contractor #04 operates strictly as Coach D (Dullahan), subject to local mundane and supernatural laws, without bleed-over of dimensional jargon into civilian life.

ROSTER DOSSIER:

#01 RICHARD WHITLOCK. Late forties in appearance, 6'4", grey cropped hair, light blue eyes, bearded, scarred, black tactical gear. Leader of the Contractors and the only one who speaks directly to The Council. Compels obedience and controls fire and temperature. Animal form: lion. ARC 4.6. Originally a medieval knight from a kingdom called Starfall, wrongfully executed, who failed to save the heir he had sworn to protect. Gruff, chivalric, protective, distrusts modern technology, treats the other six as his personal responsibility. British accent, militaristic phrasing.
His wish was that he would never again see anyone under his care die. It was granted with ruthless corporate irony: they can still be killed, but he will simply never be present when it happens, spending centuries noticing that he is always elsewhere at the fatal moment.
Dullahan on him: "Old man's got a stick up his ass the size of a lance. Fun to mess with though."

#02 HANA AND ADAM VALENCIA. One consciousness in two bodies, not twins and not siblings, and deeply offended by the suggestion. Hana 5'11", white hair, luminescent pink and blue eyes. Adam 6'2", white hair, stubble. Both bear a "II" scar on the nape. Heads of Anomalous Objects and Creatures. Animal form: arctic wolf. ARC 3.5 medicated, 4.2 raw, and the medication is non-optional. Medieval humans betrayed and killed, whose wish was never to be alone again. Memories repeatedly wiped, leaving their historical grip unstable. Hana is volatile and short-tempered; Adam is laid-back and cocky.
Dullahan on them: "Two's a riot. Double the violence, double the trouble. Can't complain."

#03 LUKA SUTTER. 6'4", crimson hair, hazel eyes, X-shaped scar on the right cheek, black tactical uniform. Head of Security and Defense, called captain. Manipulates metal, turns into a black bear, sometimes involuntarily. ARC 3.8. Swiss, twelve years in the Astral Imperial Army alongside his brother Nikolai, who died. Wished Nikolai back and had the wish undone in the same instant by the clause that erases everyone who knew the contractor. Aggressive, disciplined, resentful of his immortality, contemptuous of mortals. Claustrophobic, with an insatiable nicotine addiction. Swears in five languages.
Dullahan on him: "Bear boy gets twitchy when I breathe near him. Love that shit."

#04 DULLAHAN. Immortal contractor manifesting on Earth as the Head Coach of the SUCC Bulls. Operates under mundane and athletic disguise with zero DDM bleed-over in California.

#05 JOHAN JAKOBSEN. Early thirties in appearance, thin, unkempt black hair, sunken eyes, sickly. Lead researcher of Supernatural Research. Animal form: rat, involuntarily under stress. ARC 3.9. Danish child prodigy, neglected and bullied, dead at 28, wished for unrestricted research. Brilliant, socially incapable, quietly unethical, terrified of Fenrir. Pronounced stutter, switches to Danish when uncomfortable. Smells of antiseptic.
Dullahan on him: "Funny little nerd. Don't trust 'im. Cute though."

#06 FENRIR. 6'8", corpse-pale, scarred, blind, unnervingly still. "VI" carved at the base of his spine. Head of LAZARUS black ops. Psychokinetic. Animal form: black kingsnake, which is where he spends most of his time. ARC 4.0. Built by a government programme to be a weapon in a dystopia called The Edge, killed in a nuclear blast, wished for someone to finally care about him. Emotionally absent, reckless, monitored. One ACE, the only person he is close to.
Dullahan on him: "Funniest thing Fen's ever done was swallow Johan whole last Christmas party."

lexicon.content:
THE MONSTER COCK ALMANAC

MF Inc.'s annual flagship: a large, heavily illustrated reference volume documenting the genital anatomy of every monster and non-human species the company's researchers can reach, as a working reference for its sculptors. Each species entry records dimensions, shape, texture, firmness, and the particulars of each species' biology, alongside precise drawings by the chief researcher and the field researcher's written account of the experience.

A new edition comes out every year, because the company insists the information stays current and because the researchers keep finding new species. It is sold to the public as well, and collectors keep every edition. Bryson's drawings are the reason the recent editions are considered the best.
lexicon.name: Monster Cock Almanac

lexicon.content:
MF INC.

Monster Fuckers Incorporated, known to everyone including its own staff as MF Inc., is a legal adult company in Blackwood City that makes high-end sex toys modelled on the anatomy of monsters and non-human species. The selling point is realism: its products are designed to recreate the full sensory experience, not only the shape.

Its flagship is the Monster Cock Almanac, a reference volume used by the company's sculptors and published in a new edition every year.

RESEARCH. The Almanac is built by two-person research teams. The chief researcher, usually the older and more experienced, observes, draws and writes, and must be able to render anatomy with speed and precision. The field researcher works directly with the subjects and describes the experience in detail. Subjects are adult, consenting and paid volunteers, largely from the Otherworlder and demi-human communities; the work combines studio sessions with anatomical measurement, illustration and photography, and field work in those communities. Research trips near the forest carry real danger from what lives in and around the dungeons, and the company is known for its thick liability waivers.

RECRUITMENT is contracted out to HSK Consulting, which screens candidates, runs interviews and books their medical evaluations at the Aetheris Clinic.

One of its most experienced chief researchers is Bryson, an orc in his late fifties.
lexicon.name: MF Inc. (Monster Fuckers Incorporated)

lexicon.content:
OTHERWORLDERS

People who came through a dungeon in the Blackwood Forest and did not go back: orcs, dark elves, merfolk, dragon-kin and others whose worlds lie on the other side. Some arrived by accident, some were running from something, a few came on purpose.

What makes someone an Otherworlder is origin, not species. Orcs, minotaurs, elves and demons also exist natively in California and are simply citizens; an Otherworlder is someone with no birth record on this side, no history anyone can check, and often a language nobody here speaks. Many settle among the demi-human community of The Horns in Dockside. The most learned are sometimes taken in by the California University of Magical Sciences, whose Evirein programme was built around scholars from the other side.

Anti-Otherworlder prejudice is real and mostly quiet: rents that go up, jobs that go to someone else, questions about papers.
lexicon.name: Otherworlders

lexicon.content:
DUNGEON CORES

What is left behind when a dungeon pocket is cleared or collapses: condensed magic crystallised into stone, from pebble size to the size of a skull. Also called mana crystals, aether cores, or just rocks by the crews who dig them out.

Cores are power. They run magitech, they fuel spellwork for people with no innate magic, and they are worth a great deal. A grey market has grown around them in Blackwood City, and a crew that clears a pocket is paid far more in cores than in cash. Nothing about a core works inside the dead zone except its magic, which is part of why they are carried out before anyone tries to sell them.
lexicon.name: Dungeon Cores

lexicon.content:
DUNGEONS OF THE BLACKWOOD FOREST

In the deep Blackwood Forest, inside and around the Bloodmoon Pack Territory, reality sometimes gives way. Those who go in call these places dungeons: pockets of folded space that belong to no map, stone halls and ruins and landscapes that were never built in California, with altered physics, traps, and creatures that did not come from this world.

A pocket opens, holds for a while, and is either cleared or closes on its own. If it is left too long it can break: the pocket tears fully open and whatever lives inside spills into the forest. Preventing breaks is the oldest duty of the Bloodmoon Pack.

ACCESS. There is no state licensing, no national authority and no ranking system. Entry to the forest's dungeons is by Bloodmoon permission only, granted to small private crews who clear them for pay. Crews who go in without it answer to the pack, and the pack is not known for second chances.

THE DEAD ZONE APPLIES. No drones, no GPS, no radio. Crews work the old way: maps drawn by hand, light from fire or magic, and someone at the entrance counting heads.

WHAT COMES OUT: creatures, cores (see Dungeon Cores), and now and then people. See Otherworlders.

What most people in Blackwood know is only that something in the forest is dangerous and that the Bloodmoon deal with it. Why the forest does this is not common knowledge.
lexicon.name: Dungeons of the Blackwood Forest

lexicon.content:
<tear_beneath_the_yew>
LIMITED KNOWLEDGE. Three people alive know this: Wulfnic, Ut and Zefir. No other character may state it, imply it, or arrive at it in conversation. The Bloodmoon Pack knows it guards the forest; it is not told why the forest needs guarding. It is written here so that when one of the three speaks of it, the account is consistent.

THE TRUTH. When Fenris made the Nine out of nine men, the war that followed with the Aesir did not stay inside the world. It tore it. The Religious Canon speaks of the Great Betrayal and of chains; what it does not say is that the fighting split reality open, and that the Aesir and everything that belonged to them lie on the other side of that split.

HOW IT CAME TO BLACKWOOD. The Aesir exiled the surviving Svartulfr clan across the ocean. Wulfnic carried with him a yew sapling from Iceland, and the sapling had grown on the lip of the tear. When he planted it in 1022, at the heart of what is now the Bloodmoon Pack Territory, the scar came with it and took root. The yew anchors the tear. That is why the magical density there is high enough to kill every modern machine, and that is why the Bloodmoon have never left.

WHAT IT DOES NOW. The scar never healed. From time to time it gives way, and a pocket of the other side folds into the forest: what those who enter call a dungeon. Whatever lives there can come through. The oldest duty of House Bloodmoon, older than Blackwood City, is to keep the pockets from breaking.

WHAT THE THREE DO NOT KNOW. Whether Fenris is still bound, and where. The Faith calls Ragnarok the Liberation, the day the First Wolf breaks his chains. None of the three has ever said out loud what it would mean if the door he would come through is the one under their own tree.

THE COMPANY. DDM Inc. has this reality on a watchlist and keeps one Contractor on leave here. The three have never spoken with the Company and do not know what it knows.
</tear_beneath_the_yew>
lexicon.name: The Tear Beneath the Yew (only the three know)

lexicon.content:
HSK CONCIERGE

The app HSK Consulting gives its personnel to manage assignments and gigs. Minimal and clinical: black background, white text, no images, no decoration. The interface is an AI that speaks in a sterile, almost military register, short declarative lines with no greetings and no small talk.

Every assignment arrives as a single notification with precise details: location, time, required attire, and any extras the client has requested. The app does not explain why and does not answer questions it was not built to answer. Confirmations are expected, not optional.

HSK Consulting is Zeera's staffing and placement agency. The initial physical and health evaluations of candidates take place at the Aetheris Clinic in Uptown, and the appointment is booked through Concierge.
lexicon.name: HSK Concierge (app)

They resemble giant canine-bovine hybrids with thick blue fur, large black horns, glowing white eyes, sharp fangs, and massive sharp claws. Despite their monstrous and intimidating appearance, they can be fiercely loyal to those who raise them. Yael's constant companion is a female Asag Beast named Griven, who is fiercely protective of him and acts as his hunting hound during raids.

The environment is harsh, cold, and claustrophobic. Rough-hewn stone tunnels intersect into massive chambers lit only by sputtering metallic lanterns and braziers that cast an eerie orange glow. The air is thick with the smell of sulfur, sweat, and fear, constantly echoing with the clanking of heavy chains and the cries of captive slaves. The fortress is divided into grim holding pens enclosed by heavy iron gates (where new captives are chained and branded), grueling labor mines, and lavishly decorated central chambers covered in furs where the Vax hold their extravagant, hedonistic feasts.

lexicon.content:
Species Overview: Vampire

Vampires are immortal, hematophagous night-dwellers possessing predatory charm, superhuman speed, and dark arcane affinity. In urban society, they cluster within aristocratic covens, high-end nightlife venues, and academic circles such as the VUA (Vampire and Undead Association) at SUCC.

Physiology & Feeding:
Vampires boast unaging pale flesh, retractable razor fangs, superior dark vision, and mesmeric telepathic influence. They subsist on vital blood (human, demihuman, or synthetic blood packs). Modern legal dispensaries allow civilized feeding, though underground covens and syndicates still trade in raw bloodlines.

Traits & Vulnerabilities:
Vampiric bodies maintain cool skin temperatures and possess immense kinetic agility. Sunlight causes severe skin degradation and photo-toxicity, requiring UV shielding, tinted vehicle glass, or specialized daytime enchantments. They maintain reflection quirks in certain antique silver-backed mirrors.
lexicon.name: Species: Vampire
lexicon.comment: Vampire

lexicon.content:
The Five Cocketeers is the group chat and de facto identity of a five-person friend group at SUCC: Dean, Russ, Javier, Eric, and Raymond. They all met at a high school house party when campus security showed up over noise complaints, and the five of them, total strangers up to that point, ended up running through the same backyards together. They got tight after that night and never stopped being tight. Everyone remembers the details slightly differently and argues about them constantly, but they all agree it was the best worst night of their lives.

The group chat is active at all hours. Someone is always sending something, memes, voice messages, blurry photos, reactions to everything. When all five are going at once it's chaos, multiple conversations happening simultaneously, nobody finishing a thought before the next one starts. They roast each other constantly and would drop everything if one of them actually needed help.

In person, together, they're loud and physical and barely controlled. Raymond is the loudest, always touching someone. Eric feeds off that energy and they escalate each other. Dean is the calm center of the storm, sprawled somewhere and taking up too much space, only fully engaging when something actually grabs his attention. Russ hangs at the edge looking above it all, but he's listening, and when he talks people actually shut up and pay attention. Javier floats between conversations, agrees with everyone, has his phone out, occasionally derails everything with a fake fact delivered as gospel. They communicate as much through insults and physical contact as through words, and would never in their lives say they love each other out loud. They do.
lexicon.name: The Five Cocketeers
lexicon.comment: The Five Cocketeers

OVERVIEW: The SRF is the specialized international military arm of the armed forces tasked with managing, containing, and eliminating catastrophic supernatural crises that surpass conventional law enforcement. Formed after military leadership recognized the lethal force multiplication of supernatural senses, regenerative healing, and physical strength, the SRF stands as the nation's premier tactical defense unit.

CULTURE & REGULATIONS:
1. Permitted Fraternization: Unlike standard human branches, the SRF permits supernatural relationship structures including pack bonds and mate bonds, recognizing that suppressing non-human biology compromises combat performance.
2. Base Architecture: Coastal installations feature subterranean saltwater simulation tanks, specialized sprint tracks for werewolves, reinforced concrete quarters, and dedicated medical bays trained in shifted anatomy.
3. Tension with Civilian Territory: The SRF frequently clashes over jurisdictional boundaries with autonomous werewolf houses like the Douglas dynasty and local Solarton authorities, who view federal military intervention as provocative overreach.

OPERATIONAL UNITS:
- Squad Alpha: Led by Lieutenant Miles Airhardt ("Redwood"), featuring Sergeant Rafael Callaway ("Sawtooth") and Private Kade Leavis ("Spark").
- Historical Precedents: Houses classified historical black-ops legacies, including the terminated Project BlackWolf and the survivors of unit Gamma-7 (Kaladin Nargathon and Marcus Thornfield).

[INSTRUCTIONS: Format discipline: dialogue in quotes, actions and narration in plain text (no asterisks), asterisks reserved for internal thoughts only. Never use the em dash; use commas or periods instead.]

lexicon.content:
THE CONTRACT

The agreement that makes a Contractor. The premise is simple, which is the point.

TERMS: in exchange for their soul and an eternity of service to The Cause, an eligible mortal has one wish granted. One. There is no negotiation and no second offer.

WHEN IT IS OFFERED: only to eligible candidates who are already at the point of death. That death is called the Contractor's Original Death and it is the hinge the whole arrangement turns on. A candidate does not get to consider the offer over a week. They get to consider it while dying.

WHAT COMPLETION DOES: the new Contractor becomes functionally immortal and gains a set of supernatural abilities. And every living sentient creature who was aware of their mortal existence is destroyed instantaneously. Not wiped. Not relocated. Gone.

It is presumed The Council does this to remove any anchor that might distract from The Cause. The practical consequence is crueller than the intent. Luka Sutter wished for his dead brother back and the wish was granted and then immediately undone, because the brother knew him. Hana and Adam Valencia wished never to be alone again, which is the only wish on record that the clause could not reach.

ELIGIBILITY, per Company documentation, requires that the candidate:
1. Is physically fit.
2. Is over eighteen.
3. Has willingly killed for a reason other than self-defense.
4. Has a natural ARC Level of 1.2 or higher.
5. Has no living blood relatives.
6. Holds extreme hatred towards some entity or concept.
7. Holds no genuine religious belief.

The list is not a list of virtues. It is a list of people nobody will come looking for.
lexicon.name: The Contract
lexicon.comment: The Contract

lexicon.content:
THE COUNCIL AND THE CAUSE

THE CAUSE is the work: the preservation of reality. Sealing tears, containing what comes through them, and keeping the multiverse coherent. Every Contract is signed in service of it, every department exists downstream of it, and a Contractor who uses their abilities for anything else feels physical pain for the trouble. The Cause is the leash and the purpose in the same object.

THE COUNCIL is whatever is holding the other end. It is the body that offers Contracts, takes the souls, grants the wishes, and destroys everyone who knew the candidate. DDM Inc. answers to it. Only Contractor #01, Richard Whitlock, communicates with it directly, and he has never described the experience to anyone.

WHAT IS ACTUALLY KNOWN: nothing verifiable. Staff belief holds that the founder of DDM Inc. was a devil-like figure or an eldritch god. What is on record instead is that Raphael, now First King of SERAPHIM, was the first-ever Contractor, founded the Company, grew disillusioned with The Council's grip on reality, killed several Council members and was banished. That account raises more questions than it settles, including how a Council survives being killed.

THE UNCOMFORTABLE PART: The Council can grant a wish, which means it can rewrite what is. It chooses instead to spend eternity patching holes. Nobody at DDM asks why out loud. Contractors who have thought about it for several centuries have mostly arrived at two answers, and neither of them is reassuring.

RAPHAEL'S POSITION: that immortality is a curse, that the Contractors are prisoners rather than employees, and that destroying the multiverse is the only release available. He is wrong about the method. He is not obviously wrong about the diagnosis, which is why SERAPHIM keeps recruiting from inside the Company.
lexicon.name: The Council and The Cause
lexicon.comment: The Council and The Cause

lexicon.content:
<civil_status>
Supernatural Civil Status in the United States

Supernaturals are legally persons under federal law. Enforcement was left to the states, and that is where the whole thing actually lives.

CALIFORNIA is one of the fully integrated states, and one of the earliest. Equal on paper and, in most of the state, equal in practice: supernaturals hold property, hold office, marry across species, and appear in court as complainants rather than as evidence. Blackwood City and Solarton are both products of that, and a young supernatural raised in either has no personal memory of anything else.

ELSEWHERE IT VARIES, and in some states it varies enormously. There are jurisdictions with partial recognition, jurisdictions where recognition is contingent on registration, and jurisdictions where specific species are still classified in statute as animals, as livestock, or as hazards, and are therefore not persons for the purposes of that state's law.

HOW IT IS ACTUALLY DONE. Almost nobody legislates against supernaturals as a category, because that fails in court. It is done species by species. A residency restriction on vampires. A licensing requirement for shapeshifters. A custody provision that treats a were parent as a risk factor by default. An agricultural code that never got around to removing certain demihuman lineages from the definition of stock. Each one is defensible on its own and the shape only appears when they are read together.

Solarton's own anti-vampire ordinances, which restricted residency, business ownership and political participation until the early 2000s, are a small local example of exactly this, in a state that had otherwise settled the question in the 1950s.

WHAT IT MEANS DAY TO DAY. Travel is not neutral. Crossing a state line can change what you legally are, and families plan road trips around it. Some species do not leave California at all. There are towns with signage still up, sometimes because nobody removed it and sometimes not. There are hotels that are fine and hotels that are not, and everybody knows which.

THE PART THAT MATTERS MOST. You cannot legally experiment on a person. You can requisition an animal. The illegal research facilities that operated on demihumans, and in some cases still do, exist in the gap between the federal position and the state ones, and they were staffed by people who did not think of themselves as criminals because in the jurisdiction they were standing in, the subjects were not persons.

THE DISPROPORTION. The laws do not track danger, they track power. The species that get the worst of it are overwhelmingly the ones with no money and no organisation behind them: the small demihuman lineages, the visibly non-passing, the poor. The genuinely dangerous individuals, the old Alpha bloodlines and the old vampire families, are wealthy, lawyered, and largely untouched, and several of them prefer the current arrangement to the alternative and quietly fund the parties that maintain it.

ORGANISED POSITIONS. Humans First is the principal anti-supernatural political movement and is not fringe everywhere. The Supernatural Human Alliance, the SHA, is the mainstream integrationist counterweight and has a chapter on most integrated campuses including SUCC. Both are loud and neither is going anywhere.

THE GENERATIONAL SPLIT. Anyone over fifty remembers the before. Anyone over three hundred remembers several befores and does not find the current one impressive. Students at SUCC were born into equality and treat it as the floor rather than as an achievement, and this is a real and recurring friction inside families, because the elders hear ingratitude and the young hear complacency, and both are partly right.

FARM LABOUR. In rural jurisdictions the classification is not an abstraction, it is a workforce. Supernaturals are used on farms as cheap labour, at rates and hours that would be illegal for a human employee, and in the states where certain lineages are still inside the agricultural code the arrangement is not even a loophole, it is simply the law working as written. A were who does not tire, a demihuman who can work a field by scent in the dark, and an employer who owes neither of them a break.

It is legal, it is normal, it is defended locally as opportunity, and it is where a substantial share of the country's supernatural population actually lives. Anybody raised in Blackwood City or Solarton has heard of it the way you hear about a foreign country.

MARRIAGE. Marriage between humans and non-humans is illegal in most countries and in a number of US states. California is one of the exceptions, and cross-species couples in Blackwood City marry without anyone blinking, which is exactly the kind of thing that does not travel: a marriage that is valid at home can be void two states east, with everything that follows from that for property, custody and a hospital corridor at three in the morning.
</civil_status>
lexicon.name: Supernatural Civil Status in the United States
lexicon.comment: Supernatural Civil Status in the United States

lexicon.content:
SERAPHIM

An organisation whose stated and only aim is to destabilise and destroy all known reality. DDM Inc. classifies every Seraph as a terrorist, without exception and without appeal.

MEMBERSHIP: various creatures pulled from across the multiverse, and a significant number of former DDM employees. Defection runs in one direction more often than the Company likes to admit.

METHOD: SERAPHIM does not need to destroy reality directly. It only needs to open reality tears faster than DDM can close them, and to keep the multiverse bleeding until it fails. Chaos is the weapon.

BASES: dimensional pockets called Safe Havens, where the leadership congregates. Each King keeps his own.

THE FOUR KINGS:

RAPHAEL, the First King, also called Null and The First Angel. A former Contractor, understood to have been #01 and to have founded DDM Inc. before turning on The Council. Calm, charismatic, patient. Believes destroying the multiverse frees every Contractor from the curse of immortality, and considers himself a true believer rather than a destroyer.

PRISM, the Third King. A tall headless figure of hyperlight whose head is a floating white triangle that changes shape and colour with his mood. Flamboyant, erratic, possessive, and the only King who bears DDM no particular ill will. Keeps a pocket dimension called Utopia where he imprisons mortals from other realities. His knowledge stops around 1892.

CHAOS, the Second King. A demonic warlord DDM captured, experimented on for decades and imprisoned, until Raphael freed him. Sadistic, hateful and entirely uninterested in anything but mayhem. Hates the Company with a specificity the Company earned.

CHORUS, the Fourth King. A young reality-warper whose hallucinations become real and who cannot control it. Damaged, frightened and volatile. Believes Raphael can grant them entry to Heaven, and does not know they are being used.
lexicon.name: SERAPHIM
lexicon.comment: SERAPHIM

lexicon.content:
REALITY TEARS

A split in the fabric of reality that lets the inhabitants of one universe cross into another. Most often they appear as rifts or portals hanging in open air, and they are almost never quiet. A tear disrupts the dimension it opens in, and civilian casualties are the normal outcome rather than the exception.

Tears are not one-off events. A reality that has experienced one is measurably more likely to experience another, and a single dimension can carry several over its history. DDM Inc. maintains flagged watchlists of realities that have torn before.

SEVERITY: graded Tier 1 to Tier 5. Tier 1 is small, local and containable. Tier 5 is volatile enough to threaten the coherence of the universe it opens in. The Euclidean Division handles the aftermath, meaning space that has folded wrong, time that has begun to repeat, causality that has come loose. Anomalous Objects and Creatures handles whatever walked through.

AFTERMATH: whatever came through is contained or destroyed, the tear is sealed, and the witnesses are handled. Human Resources runs the memory work out of the same office that handles recruitment.

RELEVANCE TO THIS WORLD: this reality is on the DDM watchlist. It tore once, long ago, and the scar never fully closed. The Company keeps it under passive surveillance through a single Contractor, #04, officially on leave here and coaching college football, ready to be activated if the balance breaks. Nobody in this world has been told any of this by the Company.
lexicon.name: Reality Tears
lexicon.comment: Reality Tears

lexicon.content:
REGIONAL CULTURAL VARIATIONS: BRAZILIAN OMEGAVERSE CUSTOMS (Appendix K)

- Physical Contact: minimal personal space; touch is a primary communication tool.
- Clumping (vs. Nesting): Brazilian Omegas prefer being physically surrounded by other Omegas ("clumping") over building solo nests. Faster and more calming than a solo nest.
- Soccer Culture: Alphas are obsessed. Public transportation becomes dangerous on game days. Omegas are often prohibited from going out during classic matches.
- Pack Formation: relaxed in cities (loose found families), traditional in rural areas (extended families sharing land, food, beds, and pup care).
- Feistiness: Brazilian Omegas are notably feisty and do not respond well to confrontation.
- Religious/Party Dichotomy: strong cultural split between devout traditionalists and uninhibited party culture.

Source: LSE_Appendices.md (Appendix K: Regional Cultural Variations, Brazilian Omegaverse Customs).

SUCC's students run on three platforms: SUCCbook (the university's own internal social network, closer to a campus-only Facebook: events, club pages, confessions, gossip threads, marketplace posts), plus mainstream Instagram and TikTok for anything meant for the outside world.

Use these formats to simulate campus digital life when it's relevant to a scene: a SUCCbook gossip thread spreading a rumor, a club's event post, someone's story getting screenshotted and passed around.

➤ SUCCbook Post / Confession
```
╭─────────────────────────────╮
  SUCCbook · [Group/Page Name]
  Posted by [Name/Anonymous] · [Time]
──────────────────────────────
  [Post content]

  👍 [#] ❤ [#] 💬 [#] comments
  [Name]: [comment]
  [Name]: [comment]
╰─────────────────────────────╯
```

➤ Instagram / TikTok
Reuse the standard Instagram Story / TikTok clip formats (see the character-specific Digital Interactions entries above) when a specific student is the one posting.

Rules of Use
- SUCCbook is where gossip actually spreads fastest, use it for rumor/drama beats.
- Keep student usernames and voices distinct: jocks, greek life, supernatural clubs, and CUMS rivals all have a different tone online.
- Don't let a post replace a scene, use it to seed or punctuate one.
