entries.name: 💀Kresniks — Emotional Regulation

entries.content:
They are living rather than absolutely invulnerable. Extreme force, powerful magic, specialized anti-Kresnik effects, catastrophic bodily destruction, and exhaustion can kill them.

Under severe stress the body prioritizes survival, sometimes revealing traits that are normally suppressed. Training focuses on recognizing early warning signs before panic, hunger, rage, compression, ferality, or magical overload turns a private problem into a public danger.
entries.name: 💀Kresniks — Stress Responses

Pain tolerance does not mean damage is irrelevant. Members learn which injuries can be pushed through safely, which threaten the central supernatural mechanism of the body, and when regeneration or toughness is merely hiding a worsening structural problem.
entries.name: 💀Kresniks — Pain & Injury Response

entries.content:

Medicine for Kresniks combines ordinary anatomy with race-specific supernatural rules. Clinicians must understand feeding state, regeneration, magical organs, toxins, transformation anatomy, and species-specific vital signs before applying human assumptions.

entries.content:

Resistance to one danger does not imply universal immunity. Magical poisons, lineage-specific toxins, contaminated food or blood, environmental pollutants, cursed material, and attacks designed for the race's supernatural biology can remain serious threats.

entries.name: 💀Kresniks — Family & Parenting

entries.content:
Kresnik adult partnerships and close friendships often depend on trust around dangerous work, supernatural secrecy, and the knowledge that hunting instincts identify a species without determining individual guilt.

No hunter lineage or biological advantage creates authority over another adult.
entries.name: 💀Kresniks — Partnership & Social Bonds

entries.content:
Kresnik traits pass through bloodlines with variable strength; children can inherit full, partial, dormant, or unusually mutated hunter traits.

Inheritance is rarely perfectly predictable. Strong bloodlines can produce weak expression, dormant traits can reappear generations later, and supernatural mutation or outside magic can change what descendants inherit.
entries.name: 💀Kresniks — Genetics & Inheritance

entries.content:

Mixed-heritage descendants are not automatically a simple fifty-fifty blend. One supernatural system may dominate, two systems may coexist, or incompatible mechanisms may create unusual needs, weaknesses, or instability.
entries.name: 💀Kresniks — Hybridization & Mixed Heritage

entries.content:
They age more slowly than humans and remain physically capable for extended lifespans, though they are not naturally timeless.

Population growth is shaped by lifespan, reproductive rate, feeding requirements, secrecy, mortality, and available habitat. Long-lived races can remain numerically small even when individuals survive for centuries because births are infrequent or territory is limited.
