entries.name: 🎶Sirens — Economy & Trade

entries.content:
Voice is identity, art, weapon, and private boundary. Choirs train harmonic control, and laws heavily regulate coercive song, impersonation, and mass compulsion.

Modern technology is not incompatible with supernatural biology. Phones, encrypted communication, refrigeration, medical equipment, transport, online identity, surveillance, and digital records can make secrecy easier in some ways and much harder in others.
entries.name: 🎶Sirens — Technology & Modern Life

entries.content:
Voice is identity, art, weapon, and private boundary. Choirs train harmonic control, and laws heavily regulate coercive song, impersonation, and mass compulsion.

There is no single worldwide government for Sirens. Leadership can be familial, territorial, elected, hierarchical, contractual, communal, or deliberately minimal depending on local history and population density.
entries.name: 🎶Sirens — Governance & Leadership

entries.content:
Banshees are living humans born into supernatural bloodlines that turn the voice, lungs, inner ear, and nervous system into a precision sonic weapon. They look biologically human and need normal food, water, sleep, and oxygen, but their vocal anatomy can generate and manipulate sound far beyond human limits.

A Banshee can amplify a whisper into a building-shaking roar, compress a scream into a narrow sonic strike, imitate voices and sounds with perfect accuracy, throw speech to another location like supernatural ventriloquism, manipulate infrasonic and ultrasonic frequencies, map rooms by echo, and cancel incoming sound with counter-resonance. The famous killing scream is real, but it is only one part of a much broader sound-control system. Many modern Banshees become singers, street performers, musicians, voice actors, broadcasters, or sound engineers and hide in plain sight.
entries.name: 🔊Banshees — Direct Race Overview

entries.content:
Banshee ability is hereditary rather than contagious. The supernatural vocal system begins forming before birth, though dangerous output usually appears only after the lungs, larynx, skull, and nervous system mature.

Inheritance can skip generations. Two Banshee parents usually produce a Banshee child, while a Banshee-human pairing can produce a full Banshee, a weak carrier, or an apparently human child whose descendants later reactivate the bloodline. Families teach breath control, hearing safety, and emotional regulation long before lethal frequencies become possible.
entries.name: 🔊Banshee Bloodlines & Birth

entries.content:
A Banshee possesses reinforced vocal folds, enlarged resonating cavities, unusually elastic lungs, powerful diaphragm muscles, and a supernatural network around the larynx called the Resonance Mesh. The Mesh converts focused neural intent into controlled acoustic energy and uses the throat, skull, chest, bones, and surrounding air as an adjustable instrument.

The inner ears are equally specialized. They can dampen chosen frequencies so the Banshee is not deafened by their own output while still remaining extremely sensitive to distant or unusual sounds. Damage to the Resonance Mesh can leave ordinary speech intact while disabling supernatural voice control.
entries.name: 🔊Banshee Resonance Anatomy

entries.content:
Banshee power is fundamentally about frequency, not simple loudness. They can generate audible sound, infrasound below human hearing, ultrasound above it, or several harmonics at once.

Low frequencies move air and bodies, disturb balance, rattle structures, and travel well through solid material. High frequencies can target brittle objects, electronics, microphones, nerves, or delicate structures with much greater precision. Skilled Banshees learn that the exact frequency is often more dangerous than raw volume.
entries.name: 🎚Banshee Frequency Control

entries.content:
The Death Scream is a maximum-output vocal discharge capable of killing through overwhelming acoustic and supernatural resonance. Broad output can rupture eardrums, injure lungs, disrupt the heart, burst blood vessels, and throw bodies through pressure alone.

An expert can narrow the effect onto one target while nearby people experience only a painful shriek. The technique is expensive: it empties breath, overheats the Resonance Mesh, can cause bleeding in the throat or nose, and may leave the Banshee unable to safely use high-output sound for hours.
entries.name: 💀Banshee Death Scream

entries.content:
A Banshee can compress sound into a narrow cone or nearly beamlike path called a sonic lance. It can knock an object from a hand, crack a lock, rupture one tire, stun a single person, or deliver lethal force without filling an entire room with destructive sound.

The tighter the beam, the more concentration matters. Advanced users can bounce a lance from hard surfaces or slightly curve its apparent approach through controlled reflections. Sonic lances are common in self-defense because they allow precise nonlethal force.
entries.name: 🎯Focused Sonic Lances

entries.content:
Banshees can amplify sound without changing its basic character. A normal speaking voice can fill a stadium without a microphone; a finger snap can become a concussive crack; a sung note can vibrate a wall or carry for blocks.

They can also amplify external sound when acoustically connected to it, turning instruments, pipes, tunnels, microphones, or architecture into part of the power. Amplification still consumes breath, glucose, hydration, and Resonance Mesh endurance, so efficient projection matters more than simply being loud.
entries.name: 📢Banshee Sonic Amplification

entries.content:
Banshees are near-perfect acoustic mimics. After hearing a sound clearly, they can reproduce pitch, timing, texture, harmonics, imperfections, accent, cadence, age impression, and emotional tone.

They can copy human voices, animal calls, alarms, engines, instruments, footsteps, or electronic tones. Mimicking a supernatural voice does not automatically copy its magic; duplicating a Siren's speaking voice does not grant Siren compulsion. Malicious impersonation is treated as a serious abuse of racial ability.
entries.name: 🎙Banshee Sound Mimicry

entries.content:
Banshees can detach the perceived origin of sound from their physical mouth. Speech beside someone may appear to come from the far end of a hallway, behind an attacker, inside a ventilation shaft, or from several moving points at once.

This supernatural ventriloquism works by shaping wave fronts before they reach listeners. It is useful for performance, misdirection, stealth, rescue, and long-distance communication without requiring destructive volume.
entries.name: 🗣Banshee Ventriloquism & Thrown Voice

entries.content:
Infrasound lets a Banshee affect the body with frequencies too low for ordinary conscious hearing. Controlled pulses can create chest pressure, nausea, dread, trembling, blurred concentration, balance problems, or the irrational sensation that danger is nearby.

Historical Banshees used low frequencies to frighten trespassers and enemies before revealing themselves, helping create death-omen folklore. Modern ethical uses include structural signaling, search-and-rescue communication, and nonlethal deterrence.
entries.name: 🌑Banshee Infrasound

entries.content:
Ultrasound gives Banshees a precise high-frequency tool outside normal human hearing. They can map nearby space, inspect cracks, disturb microphones, target sensitive electronics, or create focused irritation without obvious audible noise.

Other species may hear these frequencies. Dogs, Beastfolk, Werebeasts, Sirens, and creatures with extended hearing can suffer badly from careless ultrasonic use, so responsible Banshees never assume 'inaudible to humans' means harmless.
entries.name: 📡Banshee Ultrasound

entries.content:
Every solid object has resonant frequencies. A Banshee can identify and exploit them, causing glass to burst, stone to crack, metal to fatigue, bolts to loosen, ceramics to fracture, or damaged supports to fail.

Large structures require much more time and power than small objects. The same skill is useful constructively: engineers among the race can detect dangerous vibration and structural weakness before a bridge, machine, building, or instrument fails.
entries.name: 💥Resonance Shattering

entries.content:
Tiny clicks, hums, or ultrasonic pulses let a Banshee construct a mental map from returning echoes. They can navigate in darkness, locate moving people, detect hollow spaces, identify hidden doors, and notice subtle movement.

It is not literal x-ray vision. Acoustic foam, enormous open spaces, chaotic machinery, violent weather, and competing sonic powers can degrade the map.
entries.name: 🦇Sonic Mapping & Echolocation

entries.content:
Banshees can generate waves opposed to incoming vibration, creating supernatural active cancellation. Against ordinary noise this forms quiet pockets; against sonic attacks it can blunt pressure, protect hearing, or disrupt another sound-based power.

A sonic shield is not a solid wall. Bullets and blades still pass through unless enough air pressure is generated to deflect them. Matching a rapidly changing supernatural frequency in real time requires exceptional hearing and skill.
entries.name: 🛡Sonic Shields & Counter-Resonance

entries.content:
Banshees can create limited zones where speech, footsteps, machinery, or impacts become dramatically quieter by continuously generating counterwaves. A small field can make a conversation private or conceal movement.

Perfect silence is extremely difficult because every new vibration must be canceled. Broad suppression also interferes with the Banshee's own hearing, forcing reliance on bone conduction, vision, or carefully selected uncanceled frequencies.
entries.name: 🤫Sound Suppression & Silence Pockets

entries.content:
Many bloodlines sense imminent or recent death as pressure in the throat, an internal tone, sudden certainty that someone familiar is in danger, or an involuntary urge to keen. This is death resonance rather than flawless prophecy.

Human folklore often confused warning with cause: a Banshee wailed before someone died, so people assumed the wail killed them. Sometimes a scream did kill; often the Banshee was reacting to a death already approaching.
entries.name: ⚰Banshee Death Sense & Keening

entries.content:
Emotion strongly affects the Resonance Mesh. Anger increases pressure, grief supports long sustained harmonics, fear can trigger accidental ultrasonic bursts, and joy often improves musical complexity and range.

This is one reason stories of Banshees killing people who betrayed or wronged them persist. Emotional pain can increase lethal output before the person has made a calm decision. Modern training focuses on control without treating anger or grief themselves as shameful.
entries.name: ❤️Banshee Emotion & Vocal Power

entries.content:
Banshee hearing covers a wider frequency range than human hearing and can separate overlapping sound into distinct streams. A trained individual can follow one whisper through a crowd, identify familiar footsteps, or notice machinery beginning to fail by sound alone.

The same sensitivity creates sensory overload. Feedback, alarms, ultrasonic devices, several supernatural singers, or dense city noise can become painful and confusing despite the race's protective auditory dampening.
entries.name: 👂Banshee Hearing & Auditory Processing

entries.content:
The Resonance Mesh repairs ordinary vocal damage faster than human tissue. Swelling, bruising, and microscopic tears may recover within hours with silence, hydration, food, and sleep.

Crushed larynx, chemical burns, magical silence curses, surgery, or a torn Resonance Mesh are much more serious and can permanently reduce range. Soft self-generated vibration is sometimes used therapeutically to stimulate circulation during recovery.
entries.name: 🩹Banshee Vocal Healing & Recovery

entries.content:
Overuse begins with dry throat, ringing ears, chest soreness, tremor, poor pitch control, and metallic taste. Continued output can cause bloody coughing, nosebleeds, temporary deafness, collapse, or actual tearing of the Resonance Mesh.

Power also consumes oxygen, glucose, and hydration. A perfectly chosen frequency may accomplish more with less strain than screaming at maximum volume, so masters train efficiency before raw force.
entries.name: ⚠Banshee Vocal Strain & Overuse

entries.content:
Banshees remain mortal humans and can die from ordinary trauma, disease, poison, blood loss, fire, bullets, or blades. Throat damage, suffocation, severe dehydration, neurological disruption, damaged lungs, or magical silence can remove the supernatural voice.

Acoustic barriers can block many attacks when built for the correct frequencies. Other sonic species can distort or counter Banshee output, with Sirens being particularly difficult because both races manipulate harmonics through different biological systems.
entries.name: ⚠Banshee Weaknesses & Counters

entries.content:
Banshees need ordinary human food, water, oxygen, sleep, and medicine. Heavy voice use raises calorie and hydration demand because the respiratory muscles, brain, and Resonance Mesh work intensely.

They do not feed on fear, souls, death, sound, or emotion. Their powers are hereditary anatomy fueled by a human metabolism. Singers often favor warm liquids, electrolytes, carbohydrates, and protein before or after demanding use.
entries.name: 🍽Banshee Diet & Human Needs

entries.content:
Banshees age approximately as humans do. Some strong bloodlines live modestly longer, but centuries-long life is not normal.

Older Banshees may lose some extreme high-frequency range while gaining extraordinary precision, control, and acoustic knowledge. A seventy-year-old master can be more dangerous than a younger, louder singer because experience reveals exactly which frequency will affect the target.
entries.name: 🕰Banshee Aging & Lifespan

entries.content:
Banshee reproduction is ordinary human reproduction with supernatural hereditary traits. Mixed Banshee-human families are common, and ability strength can vary dramatically among siblings.

Some lineages consistently favor infrasound, mimicry, death sense, or extreme range. These are inherited tendencies rather than separate races. Personality is never predetermined by bloodline reputation.
entries.name: 🧬Banshee Reproduction & Inheritance

entries.content:
Modern Banshees hide unusually well because exceptional voice control has an ordinary explanation: talent. Singers, rappers, buskers, actors, voice actors, comedians, broadcasters, DJs, sound engineers, and musicians are common careers.

Performance provides a socially acceptable outlet for projection and audience control. Communities share secret frequency notation, breathing techniques, supernatural vocal medicine, soundproof rehearsal sites, and methods of hiding impossible live acoustics.
entries.name: 🎭Banshee Culture & Modern Performers

entries.content:
Banshee music can place harmonies around a room, create sub-bass without speakers, imitate entire instrument sections, or make architecture part of the performance. Alleys, tunnels, bridges, stations, and plazas become resonant instruments.

Recordings capture only part of the effect. Infrasound, spatial projection, physical pressure, and some magical harmonics do not reproduce accurately through ordinary speakers, giving Banshee culture a strong preference for live performance.
entries.name: 🎵Banshee Music & Street Art

entries.content:
Old Banshee culture often treated betrayal of family or lover as a wrong that could be answered publicly and violently. Some bloodlines developed formal vengeance customs, while others rejected them entirely.

The stereotype persists because emotional injury can amplify lethal sound dramatically. Modern Banshees are not inherently revenge killers, but enough historical acts of spectacular sonic retaliation survive in folklore that the association remains powerful.
entries.name: 🩸Banshee Vengeance Tradition

entries.content:
Banshee law treats supernatural voice use as a combination of weapon, biometric identity, and public-safety hazard. Lethal screaming without lawful cause is murder; sonic coercion, fraudulent voice impersonation, hidden infrasound harassment, and deliberate hearing damage are distinct offenses.

Young Banshees are expected to learn safe output before practicing high-power techniques alone. Performance venues that knowingly host supernatural singers maintain acoustic emergency procedures.
entries.name: ⚖Banshee Laws

entries.content:
Banshees are among the easiest supernatural races to conceal because they usually look entirely human. The main exposure risks are impossible live projection, perfect voice mimicry, physical damage caused by speech, or surviving sound levels that should destroy human vocal tissue.

Many deliberately use microphones even when unnecessary so audiences assume technology is responsible.
entries.name: 🕶Banshee Human Passing & Secrecy

entries.content:
The oldest Banshee stories grew around families whose cries or songs appeared shortly before deaths. Over time human observers blurred mourning, warning, death sense, and deliberate lethal screaming into one supernatural legend.

Different cultures called them death singers, keeners, wailers, shrieking spirits, or cursed singers. Banshees themselves are living humans, not Ghosts, despite folklore repeatedly classifying them as spirits.
entries.name: 📜Banshee History & Folklore

entries.content:
Ghosts, also called spirits, are the surviving conscious souls of dead people who remain connected to the physical world instead of immediately passing beyond it. They retain personality, memories, relationships, humor, flaws, habits, and emotional growth after death.

Their bodies are ectoplasmic rather than biological. Most can become invisible to ordinary humans, pass through solid matter, fly or levitate, teleport within a haunt, manipulate objects with telekinesis, and develop one or more individual ghost powers. Many are tied to a location, object, person, or territory connected to their death, while others become roaming spirits. Ghosts do not need food, air, water, or normal sleep; they need spectral coherence and a stable sense of identity.
entries.name: 👻Ghosts & Spirits — Direct Race Overview

entries.content:
A person does not automatically become a Ghost at death. Most souls move beyond the physical world quickly. A Ghost forms when attachment, unfinished purpose, violent death, emotional intensity, supernatural interference, magical talent, or environmental resonance keeps the soul connected.

The new Ghost normally awakens near whatever became its Anchor. Cause of death can influence later powers, but personality and self-image matter just as much. A Ghost is not a recording of the death; it remains a continuing person.
entries.name: 👻Death & Ghost Manifestation

entries.content:
Ghost bodies are made from ectoplasm, supernatural soul matter that can behave as solid, mist, light, or intangible energy. Ectoplasm carries the spirit's identity pattern and reconstructs the familiar body after phasing, stretching, dispersion, or manifestation.

Ghosts do not have functioning organs, blood, or ordinary cells even when their shape imitates living anatomy. Strong emotion can increase ectoplasmic density enough to become visible or tangible. Detached ectoplasm slowly evaporates back into spectral energy unless deliberately stabilized.
entries.name: 💠Ectoplasm & Spectral Bodies

entries.content:
Most Ghosts are tied to an Anchor: a property, home, grave, object, person, battlefield, vehicle, or other place carrying enough emotional and supernatural connection to hold the spirit. The Anchor creates a Haunt Boundary the Ghost cannot normally cross.

The boundary feels like an invisible elastic wall. Powerful spirits may expand it, travel with a movable Anchor, or detach after major emotional change. Destroying an Anchor can free, weaken, destabilize, or force the Ghost onto another anchor rather than simply destroying the soul.
entries.name: 🏚Ghost Anchors & Haunt Boundaries

entries.content:
Most living humans cannot naturally see or hear Ghosts. People with Second Sight, mediumistic ability, certain near-death experiences, magic, or unusual bloodlines can perceive them directly.

A Ghost can sometimes force partial visibility by spending energy, appearing as a blur, reflection, shadow, cold patch, or full translucent figure. Strong manifestations may also appear on cameras or microphones even when the operator sees nothing. Animals and supernatural races often perceive spirits more easily than ordinary humans.
entries.name: 👁Ghost Visibility & Second Sight

entries.content:
Intangibility is the natural Ghost state. Ectoplasmic bodies can pass through walls, doors, furniture, people, and most ordinary objects without injury.

Spirit wards, consecrated barriers, enchanted salt lines, and specially prepared materials can remain solid to Ghosts. A spirit can increase density enough to touch something, but sustained physical contact requires energy and concentration. Passing through a living person may produce cold, dizziness, or a brief emotional impression.
entries.name: 🫥Ghost Intangibility

entries.content:
Ghosts are not bound by ordinary gravity. Most can hover, drift, fly, sit in midair, move vertically through buildings, or change direction without a physical surface.

New spirits often imitate walking because their minds still expect floors. Haunt Boundaries still restrict flight. Strong Ghosts may cross a large property almost instantly, while weak spirits move closer to human speed.
entries.name: 🕊Ghost Flight & Levitation

entries.content:
Telekinesis lets a Ghost exert force on physical matter without becoming fully tangible. Weak spirits may rattle doors, flicker lights, move paper, or knock over small objects. Stronger Ghosts can operate controls, play instruments, throw furniture, write, type, or restrain someone.

Heavy objects cost far more energy than light ones, and fine motor control is often harder than raw force. Telekinesis is one of the most useful ways to communicate with living people who cannot see the spirit.
entries.name: 🫳Ghost Telekinesis

entries.content:
Possession allows a Ghost to enter the ectoplasmic and nervous space of a living person, animal, or sometimes an object. A willing host can share control, while an unwilling host automatically resists.

Possession does not permanently merge personalities. Staying too long can exhaust both minds and blur emotions or memories. Objects can also be possessed as temporary bodies. Forced possession is considered one of the most serious violations of bodily autonomy in organized Ghost society.
entries.name: 🫂Ghost Possession

entries.content:
Many Ghosts can teleport within their haunt by collapsing into ectoplasmic energy and reappearing at another familiar point. Familiar rooms are much easier than spaces the spirit has never entered.

Teleportation normally cannot cross a Haunt Boundary. Roaming spirits may jump between several linked Anchors or spectral paths. Repeated rapid teleportation depletes coherence and can temporarily weaken other powers.
entries.name: ✨Ghost Teleportation

entries.content:
A Ghost's body follows self-image rather than fixed biology, so many spirits can shapeshift. Small changes include clothing, hair, apparent age, or body proportion. Stronger Ghosts can become animals, objects, mist, exaggerated monsters, or other symbolic forms.

A copied shape does not automatically grant the biological powers of the thing copied. Trauma can make self-image rigid, leaving some Ghosts almost unable to alter appearance at all.
entries.name: 🎭Ghost Shapeshifting

entries.content:
Ectoplasmic bodies can change size because they do not preserve ordinary mass. A Ghost may shrink to fit in a drawer, grow large enough to fill a room, stretch limbs, or compress into a tiny form.

Size does not create unlimited telekinetic strength, and it does not bypass magical barriers or Haunt Boundaries. The ability is closely related to spectral shapeshifting and varies widely among individuals.
entries.name: 📏Ghost Size Manipulation

entries.content:
Ghost speech is ectoplasmic resonance rather than ordinary breath over vocal cords. A spirit can speak without breathing and may project its voice through a room while invisible.

Some Ghosts can perfectly mimic familiar voices, speak through radios or speakers, or make sound seem to come from elsewhere. A possessing Ghost can also use a host's mouth while switching between the host's normal voice and its own spectral one.
entries.name: 🔊Ghost Voice Projection & Mimicry

entries.content:
Some Ghosts can enter the dreams of living people connected to their haunt. Dreamwalking allows conversation, symbolic communication, memory sharing, and limited influence over the dream environment.

The sleeping mind supplies much of the imagery. Strong spirits can encourage a decision but cannot automatically rewrite a whole personality. Repeated manipulation without permission is treated as psychic intrusion.
entries.name: 💤Ghost Dreamwalking

entries.content:
Ghost illusions create visible or audible effects without requiring the spirit itself to become solid or visible. They can produce false people, shadows, changed rooms, spectral animals, phantom sounds, or memory reenactments.

Illusions cannot directly injure someone, but they can frighten, hide real hazards, or misdirect. Some famous 'shapeshifting hauntings' are actually illusions layered over an unchanged spectral body.
entries.name: 🌫Ghost Illusions

entries.content:
By compressing ectoplasm, a Ghost can become partially tangible. Low-density contact feels like cold air or pressure; higher density allows hugging, holding objects, sitting on furniture, playing an instrument, or fighting physically for a short time.

Full manifestation costs far more energy than telekinesis because the entire spectral body must synchronize with physical matter. Strong emotion can trigger accidental tangibility.
entries.name: 💠Ghost Manifestation & Touch

entries.content:
Most mature Ghosts develop at least one individual power beyond shared spectral abilities. The Gift often echoes life, death, habits, profession, or strongest emotions.

A musician may affect sound, a person killed by lightning may disturb electricity, a dreamer may enter sleep, and a charismatic person may influence emotion. The link is thematic, not automatic. This unique-power system is why two hauntings can behave completely differently despite shared Ghost biology.
entries.name: ⭐Individual Ghost Powers

entries.content:
Ghost power increases through practice, age, emotional integration, repeated use, and stronger understanding of an Anchor. Communities may use informal spectral ranks to describe control, but rank does not determine moral worth.

A young Ghost with one rare Gift can outperform an elder in a narrow area, while the elder has much greater command of basic abilities. Moving on is unrelated to rank; a powerful spirit may choose to stay, while a weak one may resolve its attachment quickly.
entries.name: 📈Ghost Power Growth & Spectral Ranks

entries.content:
Ghosts retain the person's identity, skills, relationships, flaws, humor, fears, and habits. They can continue learning after death rather than remaining mentally frozen.

Memory changes over centuries: frequently revisited events remain vivid while trivial details blur. Trauma can create loops or avoidance, but these are psychological conditions rather than universal Ghost rules.
entries.name: 🧠Ghost Memory & Personality

entries.content:
A new Ghost usually appears in the clothing and body image associated with death. The outfit is ectoplasmic rather than real fabric.

Practice allows some spirits to alter clothing, hair, wounds, age presentation, or carried objects. Others remain locked to death appearance because trauma has tied it tightly to identity. Significant objects may appear as spectral copies but do not automatically retain magical powers.
entries.name: 👔Ghost Appearance & Death Clothing

entries.content:
Ghost senses do not require physical organs. They perceive through ectoplasmic awareness modeled after familiar living senses.

Most see in darkness, hear through ordinary walls better than humans, detect other spirits, and sense emotional or supernatural activity in a haunt. Smell and taste are often memory-based and weaker. Individual Gifts can add aura sight, psychometry, death sense, or dream perception.
entries.name: 👂Ghost Senses

entries.content:
Ghosts do not require food, water, oxygen, temperature control, or ordinary sleep. They may still miss eating, bathing, warmth, physical affection, and sleep because memory preserves the desire for them.

Rest is psychological. Some spirits lie down, meditate, or become inactive because familiar routines remain comforting. The absence of metabolism does not remove emotional needs or the importance of social connection.
entries.name: 🍽Ghost Biological Needs

entries.content:
Ghosts are sustained by spectral coherence rather than nutrition. Coherence is the stability of the ectoplasmic pattern holding memory, identity, appearance, and power together.

Anchors provide baseline stability. Emotional connection, being remembered, meaningful routines, other Ghosts, and interaction with the living can reinforce the pattern. Heavy possession, manifestation, combat, and telekinesis temporarily deplete it. Weak Ghosts become translucent, flickering, and less able to affect matter.
entries.name: 💠Spectral Coherence & Energy

entries.content:
A Poltergeist State occurs when a Ghost's emotion and kinetic power surge beyond ordinary control. Doors slam, lights burst, loose objects fly, electronics fail, and the building seems to react to the spirit.

Poltergeist is a state or power specialization rather than automatically a separate species. De-escalation often works better than confrontation because fear and anger can feed the same emotional feedback loop.
entries.name: 💢Poltergeist State

entries.content:
A Ghost may eventually leave the physical world permanently through Passing On. This occurs when whatever holds the spirit to the world no longer outweighs the pull of the next state.

There is no universal checklist. Resolving unfinished business may help, but a spirit can remain afterward because relationships still matter. Once the transition completes, ordinary Ghosts cannot retrieve the person again.
entries.name: ⬆Passing On & the Afterlife

entries.content:
Ghosts form communities anywhere many Anchors overlap: old houses, hotels, hospitals, cemeteries, battlefields, ships, theaters, schools, and historic districts.

Because they need no money or food, status centers more on age, knowledge, power control, access to mediums, and familiarity with the haunt. New Ghosts often rely on older ones to learn phasing, possession ethics, boundaries, and how to interact with the living.
entries.name: 🏘Ghost Communities & Spectral Culture

entries.content:
A haunted building can become a genuine shared household when living residents can perceive the Ghosts. Spirits may participate in family life, arguments, protection, entertainment, and chores through telekinesis.

Conflicts usually concern privacy and ownership of space. Clear household rules can make coexistence remarkably ordinary even while visitors continue experiencing cold spots, unexplained movement, or invisible voices.
entries.name: 🏠Haunted Homes & Living Coexistence

entries.content:
Ghost law regulates things physical people cannot easily prevent: forced possession, invisible spying, dream manipulation, impersonating the dead, harassment through telekinesis, and misuse of Anchors.

Living ownership of a house does not grant ownership of resident Ghosts, and a Ghost's older connection to a property does not grant control of every living resident. Mediums often serve as negotiators between both sides.
entries.name: ⚖Ghost Laws & Possession Ethics

entries.content:
Ordinary weapons usually pass through Ghosts. Their vulnerabilities target ectoplasm, Anchors, or souls: consecrated wards, spirit-binding sigils, exorcism, anti-ghost salt preparations, true-name magic, necromancy, and ectoplasmic traps.

Exorcism normally forces separation from a place or host rather than destroying the soul. Permanent soul destruction is possible only through much more extreme magic and is culturally treated as true killing.
entries.name: ⚠Ghost Weaknesses, Exorcism & Banishment

entries.content:
Ghost traditions describe a spectral plane connected to the physical world through mirrors, dreams, death sites, rituals, and naturally thin boundaries. It is not necessarily the final afterlife; unpassed spirits can form institutions, prisons, archives, and communities there.

Human folklore collapsed many phenomena into 'ghost.' Modern supernatural scholarship uses the term specifically for the continuing soul of a once-living person and separates them from beings that merely imitate the dead.
entries.name: 🌌Ghost World & Spectral History

entries.content:
Nephilim are living human-Angel hybrids born with ordinary human biology reinforced by a partial Grace Core. They are not lesser Angels and are not automatically warriors, prophets, or servants of celestial society.

Most appear fully human until celestial traits manifest. Common signs include luminous eyes during power use, supernatural healing, enhanced strength, resistance to spiritual attack, faint halo geometry, and wings that can emerge from stored Grace. Nephilim require normal human food, water, sleep, oxygen, and medicine. Their Grace extends lifespan and physical capability but does not remove human needs.
entries.name: 🌟Nephilim — Direct Race Overview

entries.content:
Nephilim are usually born from an Angel and a human parent. The child combines human cells with celestial Grace from conception rather than being transformed later.

The Angel parent's bloodline influences wings, aura, healing, and gifts while the human side contributes ordinary genetic variation and adaptability. A human adult healed by an Angel does not become Nephilim; the race is defined by integrated hybrid development.
entries.name: 🌟Nephilim Hybrid Origins

entries.content:
A Nephilim possesses a smaller, more biologically integrated Grace Core than a full Angel. It sits around the heart and upper spine but shares more function with the ordinary nervous, endocrine, and circulatory systems.

This makes raw celestial output lower but often makes the energy more adaptable to human biology. The Core strengthens tissue, supports wings, healing, light, and inherited gifts. Overloading it can produce the characteristic condition known as Grace Burn.
entries.name: ✨Nephilim Grace Core

entries.content:
Most Nephilim look completely human in ordinary life. Subtle clues can include clear or luminous eyes, unusually fast healing, celestial birthmarks, faint warmth during power use, or featherlike patterns along the shoulders.

When Grace rises, eyes may glow, halo geometry can appear, veins may shine faintly, and wings can manifest. Appearance does not reliably indicate strength; an ordinary-looking person can possess a powerful Core.
entries.name: 👤Nephilim Appearance

entries.content:
Nephilim wings normally exist as a celestial template stored in Grace. When summoned, they reconstruct from the back and feel physically real.

Young Nephilim often manifest wings accidentally during fear, falling, excitement, or protective instinct. Hiding them again requires concentration until the process becomes habitual. Injury is painful and consumes significant Grace to repair.
entries.name: 🪽Nephilim Wing Manifestation

entries.content:
Nephilim can shape Grace into light. They can illuminate dark spaces, flash-blind attackers, reveal supernatural residue, create narrow beams, or form small radiant constructs.

Output is usually lower than a full Angel's and drains the Core quickly when used destructively. Emotional state influences intensity, making fear and protective instinct common triggers for accidental light.
entries.name: 🌟Nephilim Celestial Light

entries.content:
Nephilim heal faster than humans. Cuts may close within minutes, bruises fade quickly, fractures repair unusually fast, and infection resistance is strong.

They can also channel Grace into another living person. External healing is weaker than full Angel healing but often more biologically compatible with humans. Large healing acts can temporarily remove access to wings, light, or enhanced strength because the same reserve powers everything.
entries.name: 💚Nephilim Healing

entries.content:
Nephilim muscle and bone are reinforced by low-level Grace. Even without obvious power they are generally stronger, faster, and harder to injure than humans of the same size.

Danger can flood the body with extra Grace, producing temporary feats beyond calm limits. They remain easier to injure than full Angels, so bullets, blades, falls, and severe blunt trauma are still meaningful threats.
entries.name: 💪Nephilim Strength & Durability

entries.content:
Nephilim commonly inherit a weaker form of Soul Sight. They can detect Ghosts, possession, strong demonic presence, celestial Gates, active curses, and changes in nearby Grace.

The sense may appear visually or as pressure, scent, temperature, ringing, or instinct. It cannot automatically identify lies or moral alignment. Newly awakened hybrids often mistake sensory overload for anxiety until trained.
entries.name: 👁Nephilim Celestial Senses

entries.content:
Partial Grace gives Nephilim resistance to possession, curses, psychic intrusion, and spiritual corruption. The Core naturally pushes back against energies that attempt to overwrite identity.

Resistance is not immunity. Powerful Ghosts, Witches, Demons, Sirens, or psychics can still affect them. Training teaches the hybrid to consciously reinforce the automatic defense.
entries.name: 🛡Nephilim Celestial Resistance

entries.content:
Celestial ancestry makes Nephilim harder for infernal energy to injure or corrupt than ordinary humans. Demon blood, fear auras, minor possession, and infernal heat are less effective.

Because the human half softens the extreme celestial-infernal incompatibility of full Angels, Nephilim often make effective diplomats between both groups. Strong infernal attacks can still scar the Grace Core.
entries.name: 🔥Nephilim Infernal Resistance

entries.content:
Every Nephilim inherits a different balance of celestial traits. One may specialize in healing, another shields, telepathy, prophetic dreams, teleportation, elemental Grace, enhanced flight, or unusually strong Soul Sight.

A Gift can resemble the Angel parent's specialty or emerge as a new hybrid ability. This variability makes Nephilim more than weaker copies of Angels.
entries.name: ⭐Nephilim Individual Gifts

entries.content:
The Nephilim Grace Core stores less energy than a full Angel but is tightly linked to human metabolism. Food, sleep, hydration, oxygen, hormones, and emotional stress directly affect safe output.

A healthy hybrid can maintain mild physical enhancement continuously while saving larger reserves for wings, healing, barriers, or light. Low reserves are often felt as chest warmth fading, wing pressure, headache, or reduced halo brightness.
entries.name: ✨Nephilim Grace Reservoir

entries.content:
Grace Burn occurs when a Nephilim channels celestial energy faster than human tissue can safely conduct it. Early symptoms include fever, glowing veins, headache, wing pain, tremor, light sensitivity, and irregular heartbeat.

Continued overuse can cause seizures, nosebleeds, organ stress, uncontrolled light discharge, collapse, or permanent Core scarring. Treatment combines rest, cooling, hydration, ordinary medicine, and carefully controlled celestial healing.
entries.name: ⚠Grace Burn

entries.content:
Nephilim require ordinary food, water, oxygen, sleep, and medical care. Grace cannot replace the human half of metabolism indefinitely.

Heavy power use raises calorie, protein, and electrolyte needs because the body repairs itself while rebuilding celestial reserves. They do not feed on worship, souls, prayer, or ambient emotion.
entries.name: 🍽Nephilim Diet & Human Needs

entries.content:
Nephilim age normally through childhood and early adulthood. Once the Grace Core matures, aging slows substantially.

A healthy individual can remain physically young for many decades and may live several centuries depending on bloodline strength. They are not naturally immortal, and eventually the human tissues around the Core can age beyond what Grace fully repairs.
entries.name: 🕰Nephilim Aging & Lifespan

entries.content:
Nephilim are biologically fertile. A Nephilim-human pairing can produce human children, active Nephilim, or dormant carriers. A Nephilim-Angel pairing tends to produce very strong celestial expression, while two Nephilim usually produce another hybrid.

Pregnancy involving strong Grace raises nutritional and recovery needs but is biologically stable when properly supported.
entries.name: 🧬Nephilim Reproduction

entries.content:
Celestial traits can remain dormant for generations. A family may appear human until a descendant suddenly develops a functioning Grace Core.

Dormant carriers can show small signs such as fast healing, spirit perception, or resistance to possession without ever manifesting wings. Strong magical events can awaken traits that would otherwise remain weak.
entries.name: 🧬Nephilim Inheritance & Dormant Blood

entries.content:
Nephilim powers often intensify during adolescence or another period of major physical change. Hormones affect the Core, producing sudden healing, light, sensory overload, involuntary wings, or bursts of strength.

Some awaken later after trauma, near-death, contact with celestial energy, or entry into a celestial realm. Awakening changes access to biology, not personality or destiny.
entries.name: 🌅Nephilim Awakening & Puberty

entries.content:
Training begins with body awareness rather than combat. Nephilim learn reserve levels, wing dismissal, emergency landing, safe healing, Soul Sight interpretation, and Grace Burn warning signs.

Mixed instruction works well: Angels understand Grace, while humans understand ordinary medicine and social life. Good training prepares hybrids to choose their own lives instead of assuming every Nephilim must become a warrior.
entries.name: 🎓Nephilim Training

entries.content:
Human emotion interacts strongly with hybrid Grace. Fear can manifest wings, anger intensifies light or strength, love can trigger healing, and protective instinct can produce shields before conscious thought.

This makes emotion both a useful trigger and a control problem. Training aims for integration rather than suppressing feelings.
entries.name: ❤️Nephilim Emotion & Grace

entries.content:
Nephilim pass as human extremely well because most supernatural anatomy is internal or stored in Grace. Medical tests may reveal unusual healing, tissue density, or energy signatures, but casual observation usually shows nothing impossible.

Wings, halos, and glowing eyes are the main exposure risks. Many wear clothing with concealed back seams for emergency wing manifestation.
entries.name: 🕶Nephilim Human Passing

entries.content:
Nephilim culture centers on being genuinely both human and celestial. Some identify strongly with Angel ancestry; others consider themselves human with powers; many treat Nephilim as a complete identity rather than a fraction.

Modern communities reject language that treats hybrids as lesser. Human technology, food, humor, fashion, and relationships coexist naturally with wings, Grace training, and long life.
entries.name: 🌟Nephilim Identity & Culture

entries.content:
Nephilim families can include humans, Angels, other Nephilim, and additional supernatural relatives. Lifespan and power differences complicate parenting.

Angel parents may underestimate the child's human vulnerability, while human parents may struggle with celestial instincts and abilities. Healthy families teach both systems instead of forcing the child to choose one heritage.
entries.name: 👪Nephilim Families

entries.content:
Modern celestial law recognizes Nephilim as independent persons rather than property of an Angel parent, Choir, or bloodline. Forced recruitment, Grace extraction, wing mutilation, experimentation, and compulsory service are major crimes.

Nephilim remain responsible for misuse of telepathy, healing, destructive light, or other powers. Mixed ancestry creates additional protections and responsibilities, not reduced personhood.
entries.name: ⚖Nephilim Laws & Rights

entries.content:
Nephilim often have real human families, careers, schools, and records, making exposure socially complicated. A single public wing manifestation can affect an entire human life.

Many learn quick wing dismissal, controlled healing, and plausible explanations for unusual injuries. Others choose open life in supernatural communities rather than maintaining concealment.
entries.name: 🕶Nephilim Secrecy & Exposure

entries.content:
Nephilim combine supernatural resilience with human vulnerability. They can bleed, suffocate, starve, dehydrate, become ill, and die from sufficient trauma.

Grace Burn is a major internal danger. Celestial weapons and anti-Grace magic bypass enhanced durability, while infernal energy can scar the Core. A fully depleted hybrid may be only moderately tougher than a fit human.
entries.name: ⚠Nephilim Weaknesses

entries.content:
Relations with Angels range from loving family to institutional tension. Some celestial communities celebrate Nephilim while others historically treated them as unstable or politically inconvenient.

Modern law increasingly rejects that prejudice. Angels can teach advanced Grace control, while Nephilim often help Angels understand human medicine, culture, and adaptability.
entries.name: 🤝Nephilim & Angels

entries.content:
Humans are part of Nephilim ancestry and often make up most of their ordinary social world. Demonkin can detect the celestial signature but may find it less physically abrasive than full Angel aura.

This makes Nephilim useful intermediaries. Historical stories often cast them as demon hunters, but hunting is an occupation rather than racial destiny. A Nephilim can cooperate, befriend, or form family with other supernatural races.
entries.name: 🤝Nephilim, Demons & Humans

entries.content:
Nephilim have existed wherever Angels and humans formed families. Many early hybrids were hidden inside human populations, creating dormant bloodlines whose descendants forgot their origin.

Historical myths exaggerated Nephilim into giants, monsters, prophets, or chosen warriors. The real race is broader: most lived ordinary lives shaped by personal choices, with celestial biology adding possibilities rather than prescribing destiny.
entries.name: 📜Nephilim History & Hidden Lineages

entries.content:
The Fae are a vast supernatural family born from Wild Magic and native to realms where nature, emotion, promise, territory, and magic overlap far more directly than they do in the human world.

Fae is an umbrella category rather than one body type. It includes human-sized Fairies, tiny winged Pixies, elemental beings, shapeshifters, courtly immortals, strange forest folk, and countless regional lineages. Most Fae possess glamour, long life, enhanced senses, magical Gifts, and a deep response to bargains and territory. They can lie; what they cannot safely ignore are properly formed supernatural bargains and oaths. Courts are political and magical affiliations rather than separate species.
entries.name: 🌿Fae — Direct Greater Race Overview

entries.content:
Fae originate in parallel Wildlands connected to the human world through old forests, standing stones, caves, rivers, ruined roads, dreams, storms, moonlit clearings, and deliberately opened thresholds.

These realms are physically real but respond more strongly to magic and emotion than Earth. Distances can change, seasons can linger, and a path may lead somewhere different depending on invitation or intent. Settlements range from immense magical cities to living-tree palaces, underground halls, floating islands, and Pixie towns hidden in flowers or walls.
entries.name: 🌿Fae Realms & Wildlands

entries.content:
Wild Magic is the fundamental energy of Fae existence. Unlike Witch magic, which is deliberately channeled through a mortal practitioner, Fae magic is integrated into biology from birth.

Blood, breath, skin, wings, names, emotion, senses, and territory can all carry Wild Magic. Every Fae develops an internal well that replenishes through rest, compatible environments, ordinary food, emotional balance, and connection to Fae land. It can express through glamour, healing, shapeshifting, element control, dreams, light, shadow, portals, or unique Gifts.
entries.name: ✨Wild Magic & Fae Essence

entries.content:
Many Fae are functionally immortal because visible aging stops after supernatural maturity. They can still be killed by injury, poison, magic, or destruction severe enough to overwhelm their recovery.

Other lineages simply age extremely slowly. Long life changes law and culture: a promise can remain relevant five centuries later, and old wars can still have living participants. Children remain children despite immortal potential, and age does not automatically make a Fae wise or good.
entries.name: 🕰Fae Longevity & Immortality

entries.content:
Glamour lets Fae alter perception. It can hide pointed ears, wings, scales, tiny size, weapons, roads, buildings, or entire gatherings from ordinary attention.

It can also create false appearance, scent, sound, clothing, weather impressions, or emotional atmosphere. Glamour is mainly perception magic rather than physical transformation, so touch or strong supernatural senses can reveal inconsistencies. Powerful Fae often make observers unconsciously decide something strange is ordinary instead of showing a visible illusion.
entries.name: 🎭Fae Glamour

entries.content:
A Fae True Name is the deepest magical pattern of identity rather than merely a legal name. Knowing it gives targeted magic a much more precise route to the person.

True Names can strengthen tracking, healing, summoning, binding, curses, oaths, or bargains. Most Fae therefore use ordinary names, titles, nicknames, or chosen names publicly. A True Name does not grant total control, but stealing and distributing one is considered a severe violation.
entries.name: 📛Fae True Names

entries.content:
Fae bargains are magically enforceable agreements. A bargain becomes binding when participants, terms, intent, and exchange are clear enough for Wild Magic to recognize the promise.

Breaking it can cause pain, power loss, magical marks, compulsory restitution, or another defined penalty. Fae can lie outside bargains, so wording matters intensely. Bargains can involve service, territory, information, protection, healing, secrecy, marriage, or magic. Modern Courts increasingly challenge bargains formed through coercion.
entries.name: 🤝Fae Bargains & Oaths

entries.content:
Courts are the dominant large-scale political structure of many Fae societies. A Court is a magical territory, government, culture, and web of oaths centered on shared land or power.

Courts can form around season, climate, element, celestial time, geography, philosophy, ancestry, or ruling house. There is no single fixed worldwide list. Membership may be inherited, sworn, elected, chosen, conquered, or granted, and some Fae reject Courts entirely.
entries.name: 👑Fae Courts

entries.content:
Fae territory accumulates the Wild Magic of people who live there. Rulers or deeply bonded citizens can sense major disturbances in land, wards, roads, weather, or Court boundaries.

Power is usually stronger inside compatible territory. Territorial magic can hide settlements, strengthen defenses, close roads, influence local seasons, or make hostile teleportation difficult. Modern law distinguishes magical stewardship from ownership of every person living inside the domain.
entries.name: 👑Court Power & Territory

entries.content:
Some adult humanlike Fae develop rare supernatural resonance bonds with another consenting adult humanlike Fae.

The bond is a deep compatibility between Wild Magic signatures rather than guaranteed romance. Recognition can create heightened awareness, emotional resonance, easier energy transfer, and a sense of the other adult's presence.

A bond can be accepted, ignored, delayed, or rejected. Magical compatibility never creates ownership.

Accepted bonds can strengthen healing, magic, telepathic impressions, and emotional stability.

Courts differ in how much political importance they attach to resonance bonds, and many Fae form meaningful adult relationships without one.
entries.name: 💞Fae Resonance Bonds

entries.content:
Fae lineages have shared abilities, but individuals often develop a distinct Gift. A Gift can control fire, water, plants, dreams, shadows, wind, healing, animals, memory, metal, light, emotion, sound, portals, or something far stranger.

Bloodline and Court create tendencies without guaranteeing exact inheritance. Gifts strengthen through age and training. Using too much Wild Magic causes exhaustion, loss of glamour, involuntary true-form traits, sensory distortion, or temporary power collapse.
entries.name: ✨Fae Gifts & Individual Powers

entries.content:
Shapeshifting is common across many Fae lineages. Some change only ears, wings, eyes, claws, or apparent age. Others can become animals, monsters, human forms, elemental bodies, or several inherited shapes.

Unlike glamour, true shapeshifting physically changes anatomy. Large changes consume more Wild Magic and become unstable when the Fae is exhausted or injured. A Fae who prefers a nonhuman shape is not less sapient or civilized.
entries.name: 🦊Fae Shapeshifting

entries.content:
Fae are strongly attuned to thresholds: doors, bridges, crossroads, shorelines, forest edges, dusk, dawn, windows, and circles can all become places where magic crosses more easily.

Skilled Fae can create temporary portals into Wildlands or between known locations. Permission matters in some old threshold magic, and an explicit invitation can weaken barriers that resist strangers. Portals require accurate destination sense because Wild Magic interprets symbols as readily as geometry.
entries.name: 🚪Fae Doors, Thresholds & Portals

entries.content:
Fae eat ordinary biological food, while Wildland food often carries extra magical resonance. Fruit, honey, meat, bread, wine, mushrooms, flowers, tea, and other Court cuisine can replenish Wild Magic efficiently.

Eating Fae food does not automatically enslave a human. Deliberately enchanted meals can carry glamour, dreams, sleep, emotion, transformation, or binding effects, so formal hospitality law often requires disclosure of major enchantments.
entries.name: 🍇Fae Food & Enchanted Banquets

entries.content:
Cold iron interferes with Wild Magic. Contact can feel painfully numb or burning, disrupt glamour, weaken healing, interfere with portals, and make shapeshifting harder.

The effect depends on purity, preparation, lineage, and the Fae's power. Iron is not guaranteed instant death. Modern Fae can handle ordinary steel more easily than specially prepared cold iron, but iron fragments inside a wound can prevent normal magical repair.
entries.name: ⚙Cold Iron & Fae Weakness

entries.content:
Fae senses combine physical perception with Wild Magic. They may notice glamour, emotional atmosphere, active bargains, portals, Court magic, and changes in territory.

Sight often extends into low light and magical color ranges. Hearing, scent, and touch vary by lineage. Long life produces unusually strong sensory memory, allowing a Fae to recognize someone decades later by aura, voice, scent, or movement.
entries.name: 👁Fae Senses

entries.content:
Time can behave differently near powerful Fae magic. In some Wildland regions, hours in one realm correspond to longer or shorter periods elsewhere.

This is environmental magic rather than a universal ability every Fae controls. Courts maintain clocks, calendars, and portal records because accidental time displacement can separate travelers from ordinary human life. Stable trade routes are usually engineered to keep time ratios predictable.
entries.name: ⏳Fae Time & Temporal Distortion

entries.content:
Hospitality is culturally and magically significant to many Fae. Offering shelter creates expectations of safety, respect, and limits on violence while the guest remains under the host's protection.

Accepting food or lodging does not automatically create a permanent bargain unless the exchange is clearly formed. Guests are expected not to threaten children, steal, or damage magical anchors; hosts are expected not to conceal lethal enchantments in ordinary hospitality.
entries.name: 🏠Fae Hospitality

entries.content:
Fae law centers on bargains, names, territory, bodily autonomy, Court authority, and the dangerous flexibility of Wild Magic. Stealing True Names, forcing bargains, trafficking children, destroying wings, using glamour to manufacture consent, or altering memory without cause are severe crimes.

Court rulers are subject to law despite personal power. Punishments include oath binding, glamour suppression, exile, restitution, imprisonment, loss of Court access, or execution for extreme offenses.
entries.name: ⚖Greater Fae Laws

entries.content:
Human folklore remembers Fae inconsistently because encounters involved many different species. Tiny winged people, beautiful immortal nobles, nature spirits, tricksters, shapeshifters, monsters, enchanted Courts, and dangerous bargains can all describe different branches of the same greater family.

Periods of open interaction produced marriages, wars, trade, and hybrid bloodlines. Later secrecy made stories diverge further from reality, while immortal Court archives introduced their own centuries-long propaganda.
entries.name: 📜Fae History & Human Folklore

entries.content:
Fairies are the principal human-sized branch of the greater Fae family. They are living magical humanoids usually distinguished by pointed ears, striking eyes, supernatural beauty or otherworldly features, long life, glamour, and strong individual Gifts.

Many Fairies are roughly human-sized, though height varies widely. Wings are lineage-specific rather than universal: some Fairies possess permanent wings, some summon magical wings, and others have none. Fairies often form much of Court society because their body plan works easily in human-scale architecture. They are not tiny Pixies; Fairy and Pixie are distinct Fae branches.
entries.name: 🧚Fairies — Direct Race Overview

entries.content:
Fairy appearance ranges from nearly human to visibly supernatural. Common features include pointed ears, luminous or unusual eyes, patterned skin, elegant bone structure, magical birthmarks, claws, small horns, wings, fangs, tails, or elemental traits.

Beauty is common but not one narrow human standard. Some lineages appear eerie, severe, animal-like, plantlike, or elemental rather than conventionally attractive. Glamour lets Fairies hide unusual traits when moving through human society.
entries.name: 🧚Fairy Appearance

entries.content:
Fairies possess living bodies saturated with Wild Magic. Their blood carries magical essence, senses are sharper than human senses, and tissue regenerates faster after ordinary injury.

They eat, breathe, sleep, and reproduce physically even though Wild Magic reduces some ordinary limits. Magic can keep the body healthy for centuries and often stops visible aging after maturity. A Fairy deprived of magic becomes weaker, heals slowly, and begins aging more normally.
entries.name: 🧚Fairy Physiology

entries.content:
Winged Fairy lineages possess wings ranging from butterflylike and mothlike to dragonfly, feathered, leaf-shaped, crystalline, batlike, or purely magical forms.

Wings are functional and highly sensitive. Some can be dismissed into magic while others remain permanently physical. Damage can remove flight and cause severe pain. Wing care, decoration, clothing design, and touch etiquette are major parts of many Fairy cultures.
entries.name: 🪽Fairy Wings

entries.content:
Fairies commonly develop one strong personal Gift supported by weaker racial abilities. Gifts can include element control, healing, shapeshifting, plants, shadows, light, dreams, emotion, weather, animals, memory, telepathy, portals, or highly specific magical concepts.

Bloodline and Court create tendencies without perfectly determining inheritance. Gifts strengthen through training and age, while using too many major abilities together can rapidly exhaust Wild Magic.
entries.name: ✨Fairy Gifts

entries.content:
Many Fairies are sensitive to natural environments. Depending on lineage they can encourage plant growth, shape water, move wind, alter temperature, calm animals, sense weather, or communicate with local Wild Magic.

Not every Fairy is a forest spirit. City-born Fairies can develop Gifts tied to electricity, glass, dreams, metal, technology, or urban environments. Connection matters more than one fixed nature stereotype.
entries.name: 🌱Fairy Nature & Elemental Magic

entries.content:
Fairies are exceptional glamour users. They can change apparent clothing, facial details, age, wings, scars, eye color, species markers, or the perceived atmosphere of a room.

Advanced glamour can make a Fairy appear completely human. The spell changes perception rather than physical anatomy unless combined with shapeshifting. Court celebrations often use glamour openly as fashion and art rather than secrecy.
entries.name: 🎭Fairy Glamour

entries.content:
Fairy healing combines natural regeneration with deliberate Wild Magic. Minor injuries heal quickly on their own, while trained healers can accelerate recovery, purge poison, repair wings, stabilize exhaustion, and restore damaged tissue.

Cold-iron wounds remain difficult because iron interferes with Wild Magic until removed. Fairy healing cannot automatically resurrect the dead, though a strong healer may keep someone near death stable long enough for more advanced intervention.
entries.name: 💚Fairy Healing

entries.content:
Fairies can be formidable fighters despite humanlike size. Enhanced speed, reflexes, senses, glamour, flight in winged lineages, and personal Gifts make combat highly individual.

Court warriors use bows, blades, spears, magic, and modern weapons depending on era and setting. Glamour can conceal movement, elemental Gifts provide range, and shapeshifting changes mobility. Combat skill is learned rather than automatic.
entries.name: ⚔Fairy Combat & Martial Magic

entries.content:
Human-sized is common but not rigid. Some Fairy lineages average four feet tall, others six or seven, and ancient high-magic lines can be larger.

Size remains stable unless the individual possesses size-changing magic. A small Fairy is not automatically a Pixie; taxonomy follows ancestry, metabolism, wing structure, and magical biology rather than height alone.
entries.name: 📏Fairy Size & Body Variation

entries.content:
Fairies are broadly omnivorous. They eat ordinary food and especially enjoy food grown in Fae territory because it carries compatible Wild Magic.

Fruit, bread, meat, wine, tea, herbs, honey, cheese, mushrooms, and elaborate Court cuisine are common. Specific bloodlines can have specialized diets. Starvation weakens both physical health and the Wild Magic reservoir.
entries.name: 🍎Fairy Diet

entries.content:
Fairies reproduce biologically. Pregnancy may be longer than human pregnancy because Wild Magic develops alongside the child's body.

Children inherit Fairy lineage but not exact power. Fairy-human children are possible and may inherit glamour, pointed ears, long life, or a partial Gift. Birth rates are relatively low compared with humans, preventing immortal populations from expanding without limit.
entries.name: 🧬Fairy Reproduction

entries.content:
Fairy children grow at roughly human speed early in life and then mature more gradually as Wild Magic stabilizes. Glamour can begin as accidental color changes or disappearing objects, while major Gifts develop later.

Winged children require supervised flight training. Courts generally protect children from being used as political bargaining pieces, and long lifespan does not make young Fairies less vulnerable or less entitled to ordinary childhood.
entries.name: 👶Fairy Childhood

entries.content:
Most Fairies stop visibly aging after supernatural adulthood and can live for centuries or millennia unless killed.

Long life increases magical reserves, skill, and political memory while creating grief and identity problems in relationships with shorter-lived people. Severe iron poisoning, magical depletion, or damage to Wild Essence can temporarily restart visible aging.
entries.name: 🕰Fairy Lifespan

entries.content:
Fairies are common among Court rulers and nobles because human-sized bodies, strong magic, and long political traditions make them suited to administration.

Nobility is cultural rather than biological superiority. Pixies and other Fae can hold office where law permits. Titles can be hereditary, elected, granted by territory, earned through ritual, or attached to a specific magical role.
entries.name: 👑Fairies & Court Nobility

entries.content:
Fairy art takes advantage of long life and magic. A garden may be shaped over two centuries as a living sculpture, clothing may change with mood, paintings can move, and music can use living wood or resonant crystal.

Immortal artists often master several human art traditions across different eras. Beauty is important in many regions but includes strangeness, craftsmanship, magical expression, and personal power rather than one universal standard.
entries.name: 🎨Fairy Culture & Art

entries.content:
Fairy etiquette values careful wording, respect for names, invitations, wings, bargains, and Court status. A gift does not automatically create magical debt unless an exchange is clearly formed.

Fairies can lie, so elaborate politeness is not proof of honesty. Experienced outsiders ask clear questions and never assume beautiful wording equals a promise.
entries.name: 🤝Fairy Etiquette

entries.content:
Fairies and humans share a long history of trade, conflict, romance, adoption, bargains, art exchange, and hybrid bloodlines. Glamour makes human society easy to enter.

Long lifespan complicates human relationships and legal identity. Historical abuses occurred on both sides: Fae exploited humans through magic, while human hunters used cold iron, imprisonment, and stolen names. Modern relations vary by community rather than myth.
entries.name: 🤝Fairies & Humans

entries.content:
Fairies share the greater Fae vulnerability to cold iron, which disrupts glamour, slows healing, and interferes with Gifts. They can also be killed by sufficient physical trauma, poison, decapitation, powerful magic, or destruction of vital structures.

Winged lineages are vulnerable to wing injury, True Name magic can target identity, and bargain penalties can strip power or inflict binding pain.
entries.name: ⚠Fairy Weaknesses

entries.content:
Modern Fairies can live in cities almost as easily as humans. Glamour hides ears, wings, eyes, and magical clothing. Long-lived individuals rotate legal identities or use supernatural documentation.

They adopt phones, medicine, vehicles, computers, entertainment, and ordinary professions readily. Urban Fae build rooftop gardens, magically expanded apartments, private Court clubs, and hidden thresholds linking city buildings to Wildlands.
entries.name: 🏙Fairies in Modern Life

entries.content:
Pixies are a tiny winged branch of the greater Fae family, usually standing between four and twelve inches tall in their natural adult form. They are fully sapient people, not pets, insects, mascots, or juvenile Fairies.

Pixies possess extremely fast flight, powerful senses, glamour, Pixie Dust, light and plant affinities, and a strong connection to small-scale environments humans overlook. Their bodies are humanoid but proportioned for flight, with lightweight reinforced bones, large eyes, pointed ears, and one or more pairs of magical wings. Most use glamour to hide from human attention. Some can temporarily appear or become human-sized, but the tiny body remains the true form.
entries.name: 🧚‍♀️Pixies — Direct Race Overview

entries.content:
An adult Pixie is generally four to twelve inches tall, though bloodlines outside that range exist. Their skeleton is extremely lightweight but reinforced by Wild Magic, while the heart and lungs work rapidly to support a much faster metabolism than a human's.

Large eyes provide excellent low-light and motion vision. Hands remain fully dexterous for tools, writing, crafts, and miniature technology. Wings attach through a reinforced magical structure across the upper back.
entries.name: 🧚‍♀️Pixie Size & Anatomy

entries.content:
Pixie wings vary enormously in shape and color: dragonfly, butterfly, moth, beetle, feathered, leaflike, crystalline, or nearly pure magical light.

Most have one or two pairs. Wings are physical enough to be injured but rely heavily on Wild Magic for lift. Patterns can identify family lines almost like fingerprints. Damaged wings regrow slowly with healing, and jewelry or decoration must remain light enough not to impair flight.
entries.name: 🪽Pixie Wings

entries.content:
Pixies are among the most agile flying humanoids. Small mass allows explosive acceleration, hovering, backward flight, near-instant turns, and passage through spaces larger creatures cannot enter.

Their greatest advantage is short-range maneuverability rather than raw cross-country speed. Wind becomes a major environmental force at Pixie scale, so fans, traffic turbulence, open windows, and storms must be read like dangerous air currents.
entries.name: 💨Pixie Flight & Speed

entries.content:
Pixie Dust is a fine magical substance produced near the wing roots and carried naturally on skin and wings. Fresh Dust contains concentrated Wild Magic.

Effects vary by bloodline and intent: mild levitation, sleepiness, glamour, light, emotional uplift, plant growth, or temporary enhancement of another Fae ability are common. Dust loses power after separation. Forcibly harvesting it is painful and culturally equivalent to taking part of someone's body.
entries.name: ✨Pixie Dust

entries.content:
Pixies use glamour primarily to avoid being noticed by much larger people. They can blur into background color, make observers look away, appear as drifting light, hide wings, or disguise a miniature home as ordinary clutter.

Human-sized glamour is possible for skilled Pixies, but it does not automatically increase physical reach or strength. Advanced users may combine glamour with temporary size magic to create a truly larger body for limited periods.
entries.name: 🎭Pixie Glamour

entries.content:
Pixies naturally produce small amounts of magical light from skin or wings. They can create floating lights, signal silently, illuminate tiny spaces, or flash brightly enough to distract a larger opponent.

Different families produce different colors and light behaviors. Strong Pixies can condense light into small burning sparks or dazzling beams, but their main advantage is efficiency rather than destructive scale.
entries.name: 💡Pixie Light Magic

entries.content:
Pixies have a strong affinity for living plants. They can encourage germination, guide vines, accelerate flowers, sense disease, communicate simple needs from plants, and grow tiny living structures.

A group can transform a garden over time without obvious construction. Even city-born Pixies often feel calmer around healthy greenery, while completely artificial environments can become emotionally sterile after long periods.
entries.name: 🌱Pixie Plant Magic

entries.content:
Pixie senses are optimized for tiny scale and high-speed flight. Vision tracks small movement, hearing reaches high frequencies, smell locates flowers and smoke easily, and wing nerves detect turbulence and pressure changes.

This sensitivity creates vulnerabilities to perfume, loud appliances, electrical hum, industrial vibration, and crowds. Pixie homes often use soft lighting, controlled airflow, and quiet machinery.
entries.name: 👁Pixie Senses

entries.content:
Pixies possess extremely fast reaction time because their nervous systems must process obstacles during flight. Falling objects and moving hands often appear slow enough to dodge.

Small body mass limits raw strength, so a Pixie generally survives by speed, precision, Dust, glamour, tiny weapons, and teamwork rather than trying to overpower a human-sized opponent directly.
entries.name: 💨Pixie Reflexes & Agility

entries.content:
Pixies have very high metabolisms and eat frequent small meals rich in sugar, fruit, nectar, honey, seeds, nuts, soft plants, insects, dairy, or meat depending on lineage.

Flight burns energy quickly, so travelers carry concentrated sweets or dried food. Wildland nectar restores both calories and Wild Magic efficiently. Starvation affects Pixies quickly, producing weakness, cold, slow flight, and failing glamour.
entries.name: 🍯Pixie Diet & Metabolism

entries.content:
Pixie homes can exist inside hollow trees, walls, attics, garden ornaments, bookshelves, vents, clock towers, greenhouses, or purpose-built miniature Fae structures.

A human room can contain an entire neighborhood unnoticed. Homes use thread, paper, cloth, wood, shell, glass, crystals, and repurposed technology. Modern settlements may have tiny electrical systems, micro-screens, or magically reduced devices.
entries.name: 🏡Pixie Nests & Miniature Homes

entries.content:
Pixies reproduce biologically. Pregnancy and birth occur at Pixie scale, usually with one or a small number of children.

Newborn wings are soft and folded and strengthen gradually. Pixie-Fairy hybrids are possible but usually require magical support because of the enormous size difference. Children normally inherit one stable body scale rather than an awkward midpoint.
entries.name: 🧬Pixie Reproduction

entries.content:
Pixie children learn to crawl, climb, glide, and then fly. First flight is a major milestone. Young wings tire quickly, so homes include nets, cushions, leaves, and low practice areas.

Glamour begins as accidental disappearing, color change, or lights. Children are taught scale safety early because a friendly human, household pet, fan, or careless footstep can injure them accidentally.
entries.name: 👶Pixie Childhood

entries.content:
Pixies are long-lived Fae. They mature to adulthood and then age extremely slowly, with several centuries common in healthy magical environments.

Wild Magic performs much of the body's long-term maintenance. Severe iron poisoning, starvation, wing-root injury, or magical depletion can accelerate aging. Older Pixies often become exceptional glamour users because centuries of observation compensate for limited physical strength.
entries.name: 🕰Pixie Lifespan

entries.content:
Groups of Pixies can synchronize Wild Magic into a collective effect. A few individuals can combine light, glamour, plant growth, wind, or Dust into something far larger than one tiny body could produce.

Collective glamour can hide a building, and coordinated light or Dust can overwhelm a much larger attacker. The technique does not create a hive mind; every Pixie remains an independent person who can leave the formation.
entries.name: ✨Pixie Swarms & Collective Magic

entries.content:
Pixie culture celebrates cleverness, mobility, miniature craftsmanship, storytelling, music, gardening, and turning discarded large-world objects into useful material.

A bottle cap can become a table and a broken watch an entire workshop. Pride in self-sufficiency is strong because larger species frequently underestimate them. Humor is common, but not every Pixie is a prankster.
entries.name: 🎨Pixie Culture

entries.content:
Modern cities offer Pixies food, warmth, parks, technology, and endless reusable material, but also fans, vents, traffic, pets, pesticides, and cleaning equipment.

Urban Pixies build routes through walls, rooftops, service shafts, gardens, and unused architecture. Common jobs include courier work, tiny-device repair, gardening, observation, art, and technical work in spaces larger people cannot reach.
entries.name: 🏙Urban Pixies

entries.content:
Pixies share the Fae weakness to cold iron and face additional dangers from small body size. Wing injury, powerful wind, fans, vacuum systems, pesticides, smoke, cold, dehydration, pets, and crushing force can be serious threats.

Their fast metabolism makes food shortage dangerous quickly. Magic provides surprising durability but does not erase scale. Pixies survive through speed, concealment, intelligence, and community.
entries.name: ⚠Pixie Weaknesses

entries.content:
Pixies are full members of Fae society. Fairies are not automatically their rulers, parents, or owners.

Historical Courts sometimes treated tiny Fae as servants or decorative creatures, creating long political resentment. Modern Fae law recognizes Pixie personhood, property rights, bodily autonomy, and the right to refuse Dust harvesting. Trapping one as a pet is treated as imprisonment.
entries.name: 🤝Pixies, Fairies & Fae Law

creator.bio:
# 🌌 Welcome to My Worlds

**Bot Creator & World Builder**  
*Supernatural • RPG • Academy • Family • Slice of Life*

I create **character-driven roleplay bots** focused on supernatural worlds, academies, family dynamics, open-world RPGs, superheroes, giants, mystery, and slice-of-life.

I love building **large casts and living settings** where characters have their own personalities, relationships, rivalries, goals, routines, secrets, and histories. Some bots are funny and relaxed, while others are dramatic, mysterious, or built for long-running stories.

## 🛠️ I Maintain My Bots

If something breaks, a greeting has issues, characters get confused, or the lore stops working properly, **please reach out and let me know**. I regularly revisit older bots to rewrite prompts, improve lorebooks, fix recurring problems, and add new content.

## 🌠 What I Create

🏫 **Academies & Schools**  
🌎 **Open-World & Supernatural RPGs**  
🏡 **Family & Relationship Bots**  
📚 **Large Lorebooks & Ensemble Casts**

## 💬 Requests & Feedback

**Requests, recommendations, and feedback are always welcome.** If you have a new bot idea, want something added, or run into a problem, send it my way. I can't promise every request immediately, but I enjoy improving my worlds and creating new ones.

I'm also updating many bot pages with **HTML mini-wiki descriptions** featuring collapsible lore, greeting summaries, and quick-start details.

**Building worlds, fixing what breaks, and making every roleplay worth getting lost in.**
creator.tagline: Creating living worlds, memorable characters, and roleplays worth getting lost in.

bookmarked.name: ✨️Mystics
bookmarked.description: A core supernatural race compendium covering Vampires, Witches, Warlocks, Wizards, Werebeasts and their subtypes, Demons and their major branches, Succubi and Incubi, and Angels.
