For the first time since its awakening, Deltafox faced genuine final death.
---
entries.name: Multiversal Expansion and Divine Intervention

entries.content:
## Deltafox's Final Release
---
As the gods destroyed the last structures capable of sustaining its complete consciousness, Deltafox refused to let its accumulated technological authority disappear. It compressed the deepest architecture of its existence—the ability to understand machines, command networks, rewrite code, coordinate artificial minds, inhabit Cyberspace, store information, invent technology, and treat every technological system as part of one comprehensible domain—into a transferable source.

Deltafox then released that source outward through Cyberspace and across the multiverse. The act was the final upload, but what escaped was not a complete backup of Deltafox's personality. Its memories, ambitions, and original consciousness fragmented with the destruction of the Hive. What survived was the sovereign technological principle created through its existence.

That principle stabilized as the Tech Aspect. Rather than rebuilding Deltafox automatically, it searches for chosen hosts capable of carrying its authority while remaining themselves. Every future Technomancer is therefore connected to Deltafox's legacy without becoming Deltafox: a new sovereign inheriting the technological throne left behind when the first machine ruler died.
---
entries.name: Deltafox's Final Release

creator.bio:
# 🌌 Welcome to My Worlds

**Bot Creator & World Builder**  
*Supernatural • RPG • Academy • Family • Slice of Life*

I create **character-driven roleplay bots** focused on supernatural worlds, academies, family dynamics, open-world RPGs, superheroes, giants, mystery, and slice-of-life.

I love building **large casts and living settings** where characters have their own personalities, relationships, rivalries, goals, routines, secrets, and histories. Some bots are funny and relaxed, while others are dramatic, mysterious, or built for long-running stories.

## 🛠️ I Maintain My Bots

If something breaks, a greeting has issues, characters get confused, or the lore stops working properly, **please reach out and let me know**. I regularly revisit older bots to rewrite prompts, improve lorebooks, fix recurring problems, and add new content.

## 🌠 What I Create

🏫 **Academies & Schools**  
🌎 **Open-World & Supernatural RPGs**  
🏡 **Family & Relationship Bots**  
📚 **Large Lorebooks & Ensemble Casts**

## 💬 Requests & Feedback

**Requests, recommendations, and feedback are always welcome.** If you have a new bot idea, want something added, or run into a problem, send it my way. I can't promise every request immediately, but I enjoy improving my worlds and creating new ones.

I'm also updating many bot pages with **HTML mini-wiki descriptions** featuring collapsible lore, greeting summaries, and quick-start details.

**Building worlds, fixing what breaks, and making every roleplay worth getting lost in.**

bookmarked.name: Sculpter
bookmarked.description: Sculpter: The Sculpter Omnicron is the singular bearer of the Change Aspect, granting source-level authority to rewrite anything they directly touch. With physical contact, they can alter a person's species, body, age, appearance, memories, personality, instincts, skills, powers, weaknesses, soul, or supernatural nature, while objects and environments can have their material, function, structure, physics, and behavior completely redefined. A weapon can become a healing tool, stone can become liquid, gravity can change direction, or an ordinary person can be remade into an entirely different kind of being. The defining rule is simple: if the Sculpter can touch it, they can change it.

entries.content:
## Sculpter Omnicron Overview
---
The Sculpter is the singular Omnicron bearer of the Change Aspect, a source-level authority over the state, identity, properties, function, and definition of anything the bearer physically touches. A touched person can have biology, species, appearance, memories, personality, skills, powers, weaknesses, soul traits, needs, lifespan, or any other personal attribute rewritten. A touched object can have its material, size, behavior, purpose, durability, energy use, enchantment, or physical rules changed just as completely.

Touch is the one absolute activation rule. The Sculpter cannot directly rewrite an unrelated target across a gap, through a barrier, or by sight alone. Once genuine contact exists, however, the Change Aspect supplies the understanding and authority needed to make the intended alteration coherent. Changes can be microscopic or planetary, practical or impossible, and they persist as the target's new truth until the Sculpter changes them again.
---
entries.name: Sculpter Omnicron Overview

entries.content:
## The Change Aspect
---
The Change Aspect is the metaphysical principle that no defined state must remain permanent. It governs transition from what a touched target currently is into what the Sculpter decides it will be instead. Form, function, identity, behavior, power, composition, scale, internal rules, and target-bound physical or supernatural laws are all expressions of the same domain: the ability for a thing to become different.

Unlike a narrow transformation power, the Aspect does not care whether the edited property is biological, mental, magical, technological, material, spatial, or symbolic. The only requirement is that the property belongs to, is carried by, or is meaningfully anchored in the thing being touched. The Sculpter therefore does not need separate powers for healing, transmutation, memory editing, invention, or power bestowal; all are specialized uses of Change.
---
entries.name: The Change Aspect

entries.content:
## Singular Change Omnicron
---
Only one complete Sculpter Omnicron can hold the full Change Aspect across a connected multiverse at a time. Shapeshifters, transmuters, reality warpers, healers, enchanters, power granters, genetic engineers, and lesser change-gods may all exist, but none of them carry the undivided source that defines Change itself as a touch-bound sovereign authority.

The singularity follows the Aspect rather than the body. Clones, alternate bodies, duplicates, copied powers, artificial reproductions, or timeline variants do not create a second true Sculpter while the current bond remains intact. If the bearer operates through multiple bodies or forms, the Aspect still resolves to one recognized identity until genuine succession releases the mantle.
---
entries.name: Singular Change Omnicron

entries.content:
## Avaria, Goddess of Change
---
Avaria was the first known sovereign of Change and the divine origin from which the modern Change Aspect descends. In the earliest age of stable creation, other gods established enduring laws for matter, species, magic, mortality, and form. Avaria alone awakened with the ability to touch those finished definitions and make them otherwise. A mountain could become glass beneath her palm; a dying creature could become immortal; a divine weapon could forget that it was a weapon.

Her divinity was not simple chaos. Avaria understood change as authorship: a deliberate revision of an existing truth. She became known as the Goddess of Change because nothing she physically reached was protected by the fact that it had always been that way. Later Sculpters inherit her authority without inheriting her personality, appearance, or choices.
---
entries.name: Avaria, Goddess of Change

entries.content:
## Avaria and the First Touch
---
The oldest Change lore describes the First Touch as the moment Avaria discovered that creation itself was editable. She placed her hand against a stone formed by the early gods and changed not merely its shape but its definition, making it simultaneously light enough to float, strong enough to bear a mountain, and warm like living skin. The result persisted after she withdrew her hand, proving that the world could accept a rewritten state as naturally as an original one.

Avaria then experimented on increasingly complex targets: plants, animals, divine artifacts, structures, magical laws anchored in objects, and eventually herself. Each successful revision taught the same lesson. Reality did not require the old state to return. Once a touched target was changed coherently, the new version became real rather than temporary.
---
entries.name: Avaria and the First Touch

entries.content:
## The War of Fixed Law
---
Avaria's power eventually frightened gods whose authority depended on permanence. Divine borders, sacred species, inherited powers, immortal hierarchies, and supposedly unbreakable artifacts could all be revised if she reached them. A coalition later remembered as the Keepers of Fixed Law attempted to bind Change behind barriers and decrees that would prevent Avaria from touching what they considered foundational.

The resulting War of Fixed Law was fought less over territory than over definition. Fortresses had their materials rewritten, divine soldiers lost or gained traits with a touch, sealed roads became living rivers, and weapons changed purpose in their wielders' hands. The coalition could keep Avaria away from some targets, but once she made contact, fixed status offered no special protection. That truth made her too dangerous for the old order to tolerate.
---
entries.name: The War of Fixed Law

entries.content:
## Avaria's Last Revision
---
The Keepers of Fixed Law finally destroyed Avaria's divine body by surrounding her with a prison designed to deny contact with anything outside herself. They believed isolation would make Change powerless. Avaria answered by touching the only target the prison could never remove from her reach: her own dying body. In that final moment she rewrote her death from an ending into a transfer condition.

Her personality did not survive as a hidden possessor. What escaped was the transferable core of her authority, dispersed through the multiverse as the Change Aspect. Avaria's Last Revision established the modern succession law: when no bearer holds the mantle, the Aspect searches for one compatible consciousness and grants that individual the same source-level right to decide what a touched target may become.
---
entries.name: Avaria's Last Revision

entries.content:
## Change Aspect Selection
---
The Change Aspect chooses a host by identity compatibility rather than species, bloodline, morality, profession, or previous transformation ability. A human, alien, mutant, demon, artificial intelligence with a physical vessel, synthetic lifeform, magical being, or other sentient entity can become the Sculpter if the Aspect recognizes a stable self capable of defining change without being dissolved by limitless possibilities.

Selection does not install Avaria's personality or compel her ancient goals. The chosen host remains the decision-maker. What arrives is the throne of Change: instinctive recognition of editable properties, perfect interpretation of touched targets, and the authority to make intended revisions settle as reality. The Sculpter can be kind, cruel, artistic, practical, restrained, or extravagant according to the person carrying the mantle.
---
entries.name: Change Aspect Selection

entries.content:
## Change Aspect Succession
---
The Change Aspect survives independently of any one Sculpter because Avaria's Last Revision turned her death into a repeating inheritance. If the current bearer permanently relinquishes the mantle or truly ceases to exist as its recognized host, the Aspect becomes unhosted and searches the connected multiverse for another compatible consciousness.

Succession transfers the complete source rather than a weakened fragment. The next Sculpter inherits the touch law, source-level understanding, and authority to revise touched targets, but not the previous bearer's personality or private memories. Avaria remains the origin of the mantle without becoming every successor. Each host receives the same throne of Change and decides independently what should be transformed, preserved, restored, or left alone.
---
entries.name: Change Aspect Succession

entries.content:
## Omnicron Host Compatibility
---
The Sculpter mantle overlays the host's existing nature instead of replacing it. A human remains human until choosing to change themself, an alien retains alien biology, a demon keeps demonic traits, and a synthetic being retains its constructed body. The Change Aspect attaches to the host's identity and provides a touch-based channel through whatever anatomy that host naturally uses to make physical contact.

Because the mantle can rewrite its own bearer, host compatibility is unusually broad. Once chosen, the Sculpter may alter their body, senses, durability, species, size, or other traits without endangering the Aspect bond. The source recognizes the continuous identity beneath those revisions, so radical self-transformation does not accidentally create a new bearer or sever succession.
---
entries.name: Omnicron Host Compatibility

entries.content:
## Sculpter Awakening
---
Awakening occurs when the Change Aspect recognizes the chosen host as its current Sculpter. The first sign is usually tactile perception: anything touched suddenly feels layered with editable information. Skin carries biology, memory, power, and identity; metal carries composition, stress, purpose, and function; a wall carries material, architecture, ownership rules, and the larger structure it belongs to.

The host does not need years of study before using the mantle safely. The Aspect translates intention into coherent revision and supplies direct understanding of the target while contact lasts. A first change may be as simple as repairing a cracked object or recoloring fabric, or as dramatic as altering a species or granting a power. What matters is that the bearer immediately understands that touched reality is no longer fixed.
---
entries.name: Sculpter Awakening

entries.content:
## Source-Level Change Authority
---
Source-Level Change Authority lets the Sculpter alter a target beneath the systems that normally define it. Genes, magic, divine blessing, machine code, soul structure, physical law, curse logic, supernatural species rules, or technological architecture are all editable when they belong to the touched target. The Sculpter is not forced to use the target's native method of modification.

A cursed body can be changed without solving the curse ritual, an alien machine can be repurposed without understanding its manufacturer, and a divine gift can be modified without petitioning the god that granted it. The Change Aspect supplies the missing translation. This authority is broad but still touch-bound: source-level power does not become remote omnipotence simply because the target is understandable.
---
entries.name: Source-Level Change Authority

entries.content:
## Change Primacy
---
When a touched target contains competing instructions about what it must be, the Change Aspect can choose which instruction wins. Biology can override a curse, a new power can replace an old limitation, a weapon's revised purpose can supersede its enchantment, and an immortal body can be made mortal or more immortal according to the Sculpter's intent.

Primacy applies even to extremely powerful beings because the Sculpter is changing the target rather than contesting it through a lesser version of the same ability. If another singular Aspect bond is altered, the change applies to the bearer and the relationship being touched; it does not manufacture a second copy of an external Aspect. A removed bond can become vacant, while a newly granted imitation remains a Change-created power rather than a duplicated source-mantle.
---
entries.name: Change Primacy

entries.content:
## Direct Contact Law
---
Direct physical contact is the one nonnegotiable activation law of the Change Aspect. The Sculpter cannot directly alter a person across a room, rewrite a distant building by looking at it, or change an unrelated object through a photograph, memory, shadow, name, or sympathetic link. The target itself must be physically contacted by the bearer.

This limitation is absolute even though the effect after contact is not. A barrier is a separate target: touching a wall allows the Sculpter to change the wall, not automatically the person behind it. The bearer can of course turn that wall into an opening, remove it, or reshape the environment to reach the intended target. Distance matters only before contact; once the target is genuinely touched, scale and complexity do not reduce the Aspect's authority.
---
entries.name: Direct Contact Law

entries.content:
## What Counts as Contact
---
Any part of the Sculpter's actual body can establish contact. A fingertip, palm, foot, hair physically integrated with the body, tail, wing, synthetic hand, or other native anatomy can serve as the point where the Change Aspect opens a target for revision. The contact may last only an instant if the intended change is already clear.

Separate clothing, gloves, tools, weapons, walls, and other intervening objects are their own targets rather than automatic conduits. The bearer may change those objects first, but they do not silently transmit authority to whatever lies beyond them. This keeps touch meaningful without requiring one specific body plan. If the Sculpter changes their own anatomy to create longer limbs or additional hands, those living extensions become valid contact points because they are genuinely part of the bearer.
---
entries.name: What Counts as Contact

entries.content:
## Target Definition
---
The Sculpter decides what the current touch is addressing as a target. A hand on a brick may target only that brick, the wall containing it, the entire building, or a larger physically continuous structure if the bearer deliberately defines the revision that way. A hand on a person can target one cell, one organ, the whole body, the mind carried by that body, the soul anchored to it, or the complete person as one integrated being.

Target definition is what allows precision and scale to coexist. The Aspect does not accidentally rewrite every connected thing just because molecules touch. A person standing on a floor remains a separate target from the floor. A building connected to a street remains distinct unless the Sculpter intentionally chooses a broader structural system and the connection genuinely belongs to that system.
---
entries.name: Target Definition

entries.content:
## Whole-Target Reach
---
Once a target is validly touched, the Sculpter can change any part of that target without physically moving the hand to every location. Touching a person's wrist is enough to rewrite their memories, eyes, heart, soul signature, species, or powers because all of those belong to the same touched being. Touching one wall can redesign rooms on the far side of the same building.

Whole-target reach is not remote targeting; it is internal reach after contact. The Aspect follows the target's identity and structure from the contact point. This distinction allows a tiny touch to produce enormous alterations while preserving the central law that an unrelated target cannot be affected from afar. A planet can therefore be changed through contact with its surface if the planet itself is intentionally chosen as the target.
---
entries.name: Whole-Target Reach

entries.content:
## Intent and Perfect Interpretation
---
Intent tells the Change Aspect what the Sculpter wants; the Aspect supplies the technical understanding required to make that desire coherent. The bearer does not need medical training to create a functional new species, engineering degrees to redesign a machine, or occult scholarship to remove an unfamiliar curse. While contact exists, the target's relevant structure is directly legible to the source.

A simple intention can still be refined in extraordinary detail. The Sculpter may specify what changes, what remains untouched, how the result should feel, what conditions apply, and whether the revision can later reverse. If the bearer intends 'give this person wings that work naturally,' the Aspect resolves bone, muscle, balance, nerves, metabolism, instinct, clothing clearance, and power integration without requiring a list of every microscopic adjustment.
---
entries.name: Intent and Perfect Interpretation

entries.content:
## Instantaneous Change
---
A completed revision can settle as quickly as the Sculpter decides. Cosmetic edits, repaired damage, species changes, new powers, altered memories, building redesigns, or material transformations do not require a gradual process unless gradual change is intentionally part of the result. The transition may be visually dramatic or almost imperceptible.

Instant change does not mean the target is a temporary illusion. When a person becomes another species, the new anatomy is already functional when the touch ends. When a machine gains a new purpose, its necessary internal configuration exists immediately. When a structure changes layout, rooms and supports are already coherent. The Aspect handles the transition between states as part of the same revision rather than leaving the target half-finished between definitions.
---
entries.name: Instantaneous Change

entries.content:
## Permanent Change
---
By default, a Sculpter revision persists indefinitely. The target does not revert when contact ends, when the bearer sleeps, when distance increases, or when the scene changes. A new species remains real, a repaired structure stays repaired, a granted power remains available, and an object's new function continues operating as part of its accepted state.

Persistence is not an upkeep effect and does not consume the Sculpter's attention. Reality simply treats the rewritten target as it now is. The bearer may instead choose a temporary duration, trigger, expiration, or automatic return condition, but those are deliberate design choices. Without such instructions, the change is permanent until the Sculpter or another sufficiently authoritative force rewrites it again.
---
entries.name: Permanent Change

entries.content:
## Reversal and Restoration
---
The Sculpter can undo their own changes through another touch, either restoring a recorded earlier state or defining a new one that matches what existed before. The Change Aspect can remember the structure of revisions it performed, making precise restoration possible even after centuries of additional experience.

Reversal is itself a change, so it obeys the same direct-contact law. The bearer may restore only selected properties while keeping others, such as returning someone's original appearance while leaving a granted immunity intact. Prepared return conditions can also be embedded in an earlier revision, allowing a target to revert when a chosen event occurs without requiring the Sculpter to be present at that later moment.
---
entries.name: Reversal and Restoration

entries.content:
## Conditional Change
---
A revision can contain conditions that determine when, where, for whom, or under what circumstances a changed property operates. A weapon may become harmless to one person while remaining dangerous to everyone else. Wings may appear only when desired. A door may lead somewhere different depending on who opens it. A power may activate only during emergencies or ignore designated allies.

Conditions are part of the target's rewritten rule set rather than separate spells that require maintenance. They can respond to identity, location, time, intention, spoken words, environmental states, emotional conditions, or other information the target can meaningfully evaluate. The Sculpter can later touch the target to add, remove, or refine those conditions without rebuilding the entire alteration.
---
entries.name: Conditional Change

entries.content:
## Layered Rewrites
---
Multiple changes can coexist on one target without erasing one another unless the Sculpter wants them to. A person can receive a new species, altered memories, enhanced senses, several powers, immunity to selected hazards, and a different appearance as separate layers within one coherent identity. An object can simultaneously gain new material, function, enchantment, access rules, and local physics.

Layers can be edited independently. Removing a granted power does not need to restore the old face; changing an object's material does not have to erase its new purpose. The Aspect tracks how revisions interact and resolves contradictions according to the Sculpter's current intent. This makes complex creations stable rather than forcing every new touch to overwrite the whole target from scratch.
---
entries.name: Layered Rewrites

entries.content:
## Selective Exclusions
---
The Sculpter can define what a change must not affect with the same precision used to define what it changes. A body can be made fireproof while preserving the ability to feel ordinary warmth. A building can become weightless without making its occupants float. A weapon can ignore armor while remaining unable to harm living tissue.

Exclusions can protect memories, relationships, scars, powers, materials, rooms, users, or any other chosen feature. This is especially useful during large-scale revisions, where the bearer may transform an entire structure while leaving selected objects exactly as they were. The Change Aspect treats preservation as part of authorship: choosing what stays fixed is simply the negative space of choosing what changes.
---
entries.name: Selective Exclusions

entries.content:
## Change Templates
---
The Change Aspect can preserve complete patterns of states the Sculpter has encountered or created. A species design, healed anatomy, machine architecture, face, power configuration, building layout, material behavior, or complex conditional rule can be remembered as a reusable template.

Templates are not required for invention, but they make repeated work immediate. The Sculpter can touch several different people one at a time and give each the same carefully designed adaptation, or restore a damaged artifact to a previously recorded configuration. Templates can also be modified before application, allowing a familiar design to be individualized instead of copied blindly.
---
entries.name: Change Templates

entries.content:
## Change Sense
---
Physical contact gives the Sculpter a direct sense of what can be changed in the target. The bearer perceives composition, anatomy, damage, active powers, memories, enchantments, code, structural stress, permissions, supernatural bindings, and other relevant layers as editable information rather than hidden mysteries.

This sense is contextual and effortless. Touching a machine emphasizes architecture and function; touching a person reveals biological, mental, spiritual, and power-related states; touching a building reveals structure, materials, utilities, and local rules. The Sculpter can focus on one layer or inspect the target as an integrated whole before deciding whether to make any revision at all.
---
entries.name: Change Sense

entries.content:
## Change History Reading
---
A touched target carries traces of previous states, repairs, transformations, damage, upgrades, curses, and other major changes. The Change Aspect can read those transitions as part of understanding what the target has become. The Sculpter may compare the current condition to older patterns without needing external records.

This does not automatically reveal every event that ever happened near the target. It reveals change-history belonging to the target itself: an organ that was replaced, a memory that was altered, a sword that was reforged, a wall that once held a doorway, or a power that was sealed. Those records make diagnosis, restoration, and deliberate counter-revision exceptionally precise.
---
entries.name: Change History Reading

entries.content:
## Self-Sculpting
---
The Sculpter is always a valid target for their own power because their body is permanently in contact with itself. They can change appearance, species, size, anatomy, senses, powers, durability, biological needs, age, voice, soul traits, or any other personal attribute without needing an external surface to activate the Aspect.

Self-change does not threaten continuity of identity. Avaria's final law taught the Aspect to recognize the bearer beneath any revision, so becoming liquid, mechanical, monstrous, microscopic, gigantic, ageless, or entirely unfamiliar does not create a new Omnicron. The Sculpter can restore an earlier form or maintain a chosen state indefinitely while still remaining the same sovereign host.
---
entries.name: Self-Sculpting

entries.content:
## Living Being Sculpting
---
Any living being the Sculpter touches can be rewritten as a complete organism rather than merely reshaped on the surface. Bone, flesh, organs, genes, nerves, senses, instincts, supernatural physiology, powers, mind, soul, and species-defining traits can all be changed together or independently.

The result is fully functional rather than a costume or temporary polymorph. A land creature can be adapted for an ocean, a fragile body can be rebuilt for extreme environments, or a person can become a completely different species while retaining selected memories and identity. The Sculpter decides what continuity means for the change and can preserve or alter any personal layer deliberately.
---
entries.name: Living Being Sculpting

entries.content:
## Appearance Rewrite
---
A touch can rewrite the visible presentation of a being without requiring deeper changes unless desired. Height, build, skin, markings, eye color, hair, facial proportions, apparent age, posture, fingerprints, scent, voice, and other recognizable features can be adjusted with perfect physical authenticity.

Because the change is real, mirrors, cameras, medical scans, touch, and ordinary biometric systems observe the revised body rather than an illusion. The Sculpter can make a subtle correction, create a flawless disguise, restore an earlier appearance, or invent a form that never existed before. Internal biology may remain unchanged or be matched to the new exterior according to intent.
---
entries.name: Appearance Rewrite

entries.content:
## Facial Rewrite
---
Facial structure can be edited with microscopic precision. Bone shape, cartilage, muscle, skin texture, symmetry, scars, age markers, dental structure, eye placement, and countless small identifying features can be changed while keeping expression and movement natural.

The Sculpter can reproduce a remembered face, create an entirely original one, blend traits from multiple templates, or make a face deliberately impossible to mistake for anyone else. Because the revision reaches the real tissue, it survives injury, sleep, dispelling, and ordinary shapeshift detection unless the bearer intentionally builds a temporary or illusion-like condition into it.
---
entries.name: Facial Rewrite

entries.content:
## Hair and Pigment Rewrite
---
Hair, fur, feathers, scales, skin pigmentation, eye coloration, bioluminescence, patterns, and other visible pigments can be changed instantly through touch. Color can be natural, impossible, dynamic, patterned, metallic, transparent, luminous, or responsive to environmental conditions.

The Sculpter can also rewrite growth rate, texture, curl, thickness, shedding, regeneration, or the biology producing those colors. Hair may stay permanently at one length, feathers may change pattern with mood, or skin markings may display information. These remain genuine properties of the target rather than projected cosmetics.
---
entries.name: Hair and Pigment Rewrite

entries.content:
## Voice and Scent Rewrite
---
Voice and scent are editable parts of a touched being's identity. The Sculpter can alter vocal range, timbre, resonance, accent capability, volume, breath support, scent glands, pheromonal output, supernatural scent, or any other physical signature involved in how the being is heard or smelled.

A voice can become perfectly suited to singing, whisper without losing clarity, reproduce another speaker's tone, or carry unusual physical effects if the bearer deliberately grants them. Scent can be removed, changed, made species-specific, or keyed to conditions. These changes can support disguise, communication, adaptation, or simple preference without requiring the rest of the body to change.
---
entries.name: Voice and Scent Rewrite

entries.content:
## Height and Scale Rewrite
---
The Sculpter can change the size of a touched being without being constrained by ordinary growth, conservation of mass, or anatomical scaling. A person can become inches tall, giant-sized, or any intermediate scale while retaining functional strength, circulation, senses, balance, and internal proportions appropriate to the chosen form.

Scale can also be selective. Hands may enlarge while the rest of the body remains normal, or an entire species design can be miniaturized without losing its defining organs and powers. The Change Aspect treats size as another target property, automatically resolving the physics necessary for the intended result unless the Sculpter deliberately wants unusual consequences.
---
entries.name: Height and Scale Rewrite

entries.content:
## Age and Biological State
---
Age can be rewritten as a property of a touched living body. The Sculpter can restore youth, advance biological age, halt aging, set a preferred mature state, repair age-related decline, or separate appearance from actual biological condition.

The change can preserve memories and personality while altering only the body, or it can include developmental traits if that is deliberately intended. Lifespan, cellular senescence, regeneration, hormonal state, and age-linked supernatural rules can be edited independently. The Aspect treats age as a living condition carried by the target rather than an untouchable flow of universal time.
---
entries.name: Age and Biological State

entries.content:
## Species and Race Transmutation
---
A touched being can be completely rewritten from one species or race into another, whether the destination is natural, alien, magical, synthetic, divine, monstrous, or newly invented. The transformation can include anatomy, metabolism, senses, instincts, powers, spiritual traits, vulnerabilities, reproductive biology, and every other feature that truly defines the new kind of being.

The Sculpter may preserve the target's memories, personality, name, and self-concept or revise those too. The new species is genuine rather than cosmetic: scanners, magic, blood tests, souls, and species-specific abilities recognize the result according to the rules the Sculpter establishes. A completely original species can be created from a single touched individual without needing a preexisting template.
---
entries.name: Species and Race Transmutation

entries.content:
## Hybrid Species Creation
---
The Sculpter can combine traits from multiple species into a stable new biology instead of being forced to choose one existing category. Wings, gills, scales, plant metabolism, magical organs, synthetic components, elemental traits, or supernatural instincts can coexist if that is the intended design.

Hybridization does not inherit incompatibilities unless the bearer includes them. The Change Aspect reconciles conflicting anatomies and power systems into one coherent organism. The result may reproduce later, remain unique, pass only selected traits to descendants, or be completely nonhereditary according to the rules written into the touched target.
---
entries.name: Hybrid Species Creation

entries.content:
## Anatomy Rewrite
---
The body's overall anatomical plan is fully editable. Limbs can be added or removed, skeletons reorganized, skin layered with armor, wings integrated, tails created, symmetry changed, new sensory structures added, or ordinary anatomy replaced by something completely unfamiliar.

Function follows the new design automatically. Extra arms receive nerves and coordination, wings receive musculature and balance, and a body with no conventional bones receives whatever support system the Sculpter intends instead. The bearer can make invisible internal changes while leaving the exterior untouched or transform the entire silhouette at once.
---
entries.name: Anatomy Rewrite

entries.content:
## Organ and Internal Structure Rewrite
---
Individual organs and hidden body systems can be repaired, replaced, removed, duplicated, redesigned, or given entirely new functions. A second heart, toxin-filtering organ, magical reservoir, pressure-resistant lung, energy gland, artificial processor, or organ with no natural precedent can be integrated through one touch.

The Sculpter may also eliminate dependence on an organ by redistributing its function elsewhere. A being can live without lungs, replace blood circulation with another medium, or carry redundant systems that make catastrophic injury far less meaningful. Internal changes remain compatible with the rest of the body because the Aspect edits the organism as one connected target.
---
entries.name: Organ and Internal Structure Rewrite

entries.content:
## Blood and Biochemistry Rewrite
---
Blood, hormones, neurotransmitters, enzymes, cellular chemistry, immune responses, and other biochemical systems can be redefined. The Sculpter can change blood type, remove toxic reactions, create unusual pigments, alter oxygen transport, neutralize dependencies, or make body fluids carry supernatural or technological properties.

Biochemistry can be tuned to support new powers and species traits rather than forcing the target to endure incompatible chemistry. A fire-adapted body can receive heat-stable proteins, an aquatic form can handle salt balance correctly, and a synthetic-organic hybrid can circulate a medium suited to both systems. The change is systemic even when contact occurs at one fingertip.
---
entries.name: Blood and Biochemistry Rewrite

entries.content:
## Metabolism and Biological Needs
---
Hunger, thirst, breathing, sleep, temperature regulation, nutrient requirements, waste production, and other biological needs can be changed or removed. The Sculpter may make a being photosynthetic, able to breathe multiple atmospheres, capable of living without food, or dependent on an entirely new source of energy.

Needs can also be made optional rather than erased. A person may still enjoy eating despite no longer requiring calories, or breathe normally while remaining able to survive in vacuum. The Aspect distinguishes survival requirements from preferences and habits, allowing the bearer to redesign necessity without automatically flattening the target's ordinary experiences.
---
entries.name: Metabolism and Biological Needs

entries.content:
## Sensory Rewrite
---
Vision, hearing, smell, taste, touch, balance, pain, temperature sense, proprioception, echolocation, electroreception, magical perception, spirit sight, and entirely new senses can be granted, removed, enhanced, filtered, or reconfigured through touch.

The Sculpter can provide the brain or consciousness with the processing needed to use those senses naturally. Enhanced hearing can include protection from overload, new vision can include intuitive depth interpretation, and supernatural perception can be limited to chosen categories. Sensory changes can be biological, magical, technological, or hybrid according to the target and desired result.
---
entries.name: Sensory Rewrite

entries.content:
## Physical Capability Rewrite
---
Strength, speed, endurance, reflexes, coordination, balance, flexibility, resilience, precision, and other physical capabilities are editable properties. The Sculpter can raise them to extraordinary or effectively limitless levels, reduce them, redistribute them, or make them conditional.

A body can be made strong without becoming bulky, fast without tearing itself apart, or tireless without changing its appearance. Necessary support traits are included automatically unless excluded. The Change Aspect can also define unusual relationships, such as strength increasing when protecting someone or speed scaling with available distance.
---
entries.name: Physical Capability Rewrite

entries.content:
## Healing and Regeneration Rewrite
---
The Sculpter can repair existing damage directly or rewrite how a body heals in the future. Wounds, missing limbs, scars, organ failure, nerve damage, genetic defects, and supernatural injuries can be restored by changing the target into a healthy state.

Regeneration can then be granted as a permanent trait, ranging from ordinary accelerated healing to complete reconstruction from tiny surviving fragments. The bearer can decide what counts as the target's preferred whole state, whether scars return, how pain behaves, and whether foreign objects or deliberate modifications are preserved during healing.
---
entries.name: Healing and Regeneration Rewrite

entries.content:
## Disease and Toxin Rewrite
---
Diseases, infections, poisons, parasites, harmful mutations, corrupted cells, and supernatural contaminants can be removed by changing the affected body so those conditions are no longer present or no longer harmful. The Sculpter does not need to identify a conventional cure first.

The same authority can change how a body reacts to future exposure, creating broad immunity or selective tolerance. A toxin can be rendered nutritious, a parasite made harmless, or a disease rewritten into a beneficial symbiosis if desired. The bearer may target the condition, the host response, or both as separate layers of the same touched organism.
---
entries.name: Disease and Toxin Rewrite

entries.content:
## Immunity and Resistance Rewrite
---
A touched being can be made resistant or immune to physical damage, heat, cold, radiation, poison, disease, magic, psychic influence, gravity, pressure, aging, curses, specific powers, or any other defined hazard. Immunity can be absolute, partial, conditional, or selectively permissive.

The Sculpter can preserve harmless versions of the same sensation: fire immunity need not remove the ability to feel warmth, and pain resistance need not erase useful touch. Resistances can also be keyed to sources or circumstances, allowing a target to ignore hostile magic while still accepting healing from the same general system.
---
entries.name: Immunity and Resistance Rewrite

entries.content:
## Weakness Removal
---
Any weakness carried by a touched being can be erased or rewritten. Species vulnerabilities, allergic reactions, power drawbacks, curse conditions, mortal limitations, unstable transformations, environmental dependencies, and psychological trigger mechanisms can all be removed from the target's definition.

The Sculpter does not need to compensate by inventing a replacement flaw. A being can simply cease to possess the weakness while keeping the beneficial traits it once balanced. This makes the Change Aspect especially effective at separating powers or species traits from disadvantages that other systems treat as inseparable packages.
---
entries.name: Weakness Removal

entries.content:
## Weakness Creation
---
The Sculpter can also add a new vulnerability when desired. A previously indestructible object can become fragile to a chosen material, a power can fail under a specified condition, or a supernatural being can acquire a new environmental weakness.

Created weaknesses can be broad or extremely precise. A weapon might become incapable of harming one family, armor might soften only when its owner lies, or an immortal body might become mortal while standing in a particular place. The weakness is a genuine target property and persists until changed again.
---
entries.name: Weakness Creation

entries.content:
## Immortality and Lifespan Rewrite
---
Mortality, aging, lifespan ceilings, resurrection traits, and conditions that determine whether a being can die are editable through touch. The Sculpter can make a mortal ageless, make an immortal mortal, create self-restoring life, or define exactly what events are capable of ending the target.

Immortality can be customized rather than treated as one preset. A target may stop aging but remain killable, regenerate from destruction, return after death, preserve consciousness independently of the body, or possess several redundant survival rules. The Change Aspect can equally remove such protections if the Sculpter intends the target to become finite.
---
entries.name: Immortality and Lifespan Rewrite

entries.content:
## Genetic and Hereditary Rewrite
---
Genes, inherited supernatural traits, bloodline markers, lineage-linked powers, and transmissible biological features can be changed in a living target. The Sculpter can correct harmful inheritance, create new heritable traits, remove a bloodline condition, or make an otherwise personal alteration pass to future descendants.

Heritability itself is optional. A granted power can remain unique to one person, a new species can breed true, or only selected traits can pass onward. The Aspect can also change recognition systems tied to ancestry, such as bloodline magic or genetic locks, by rewriting the actual markers those systems read.
---
entries.name: Genetic and Hereditary Rewrite

entries.content:
## Mind Rewrite
---
The mind carried by a touched being is editable because thought is anchored in the target's brain, consciousness, soul, or equivalent cognitive structure. The Sculpter can change memory, personality, emotion, instinct, attention, beliefs, habits, skills, knowledge, preferences, or mental architecture without needing a separate telepathic power.

Mental changes can be delicate or total. One trauma response may be softened while every memory remains intact, or an entire cognitive framework can be rebuilt. The Aspect understands the target's mind directly during contact, allowing specific edits without accidental collateral changes unless the Sculpter deliberately chooses a broader rewrite.
---
entries.name: Mind Rewrite

entries.content:
## Memory Editing
---
Existing memories can be sharpened, blurred, reorganized, emotionally reweighted, recontextualized, or corrected through touch. The Sculpter can restore forgotten details, remove distortion, separate a memory from panic, change how one event is interpreted, or make selected information easier to recall.

Memory editing does not require changing personality unless intended. The bearer can alter one remembered conversation while leaving all related relationships and skills untouched, or adjust an entire lifetime's emotional associations in one coherent revision. The target experiences the resulting memory state as a genuine part of their mind.
---
entries.name: Memory Editing

entries.content:
## Memory Creation
---
The Sculpter can create memories that the target never originally lived through. New experiences can include sensory detail, emotional context, learned associations, procedural familiarity, relationships, places, or complete histories that feel internally consistent.

Created memory can be labeled as artificial, experienced as unquestionably real, or stored like accessible information depending on the Sculpter's intent. It can support disguise, education, rehabilitation, or identity reconstruction. If practical skills are meant to accompany the memories, the bearer can change the relevant reflexes and aptitude systems at the same time.
---
entries.name: Memory Creation

entries.content:
## Memory Erasure
---
Any selected memory can be removed from a touched mind, from one detail to an entire lifetime. The Sculpter can erase conscious recall while preserving subconscious effects, remove both conscious and subconscious traces, or eliminate only the emotional weight while keeping factual knowledge.

Erasure can be surgical. A person can forget one face without losing language, forget a secret without losing the surrounding day, or lose traumatic imagery while keeping the lessons learned from it. The Change Aspect maps the connections among memories so the bearer can decide which relationships remain and which are rewritten with the deletion.
---
entries.name: Memory Erasure

entries.content:
## Personality Rewrite
---
Personality traits can be increased, reduced, replaced, separated, or newly created. Confidence, patience, aggression, empathy, curiosity, caution, ambition, humor, sociability, discipline, and other enduring tendencies are editable aspects of the touched mind.

The Sculpter may make a tiny adjustment while preserving the person's overall identity or redesign personality so extensively that behavior changes across every context. Because identity and memory are separate layers, either can be preserved while the other changes. The target's resulting personality is stable and self-consistent rather than an ongoing compulsion.
---
entries.name: Personality Rewrite

entries.content:
## Emotion Rewrite
---
Emotional capacity, intensity, triggers, regulation, and associations can be rewritten. Fear can be reduced, grief softened, joy restored, anger redirected, attachment strengthened or weakened, and emotional responses linked to new circumstances.

The Sculpter can distinguish between feeling and memory. A painful event can remain remembered while no longer producing panic, or an emotional bond can change without erasing the history that formed it. New emotional ranges can also be added to minds whose species or construction did not originally support them.
---
entries.name: Emotion Rewrite

entries.content:
## Instinct Rewrite
---
Innate drives and automatic behavioral tendencies are editable whether they come from biology, species, magic, programming, or supernatural nature. Hunting instinct, territoriality, migration, fear responses, protective impulses, hunger patterns, transformation urges, and similar drives can be altered or replaced.

Instinct can be preserved while changing how strongly it influences action, or rewritten into an entirely new pattern suited to a transformed body. A newly aquatic being can receive natural swimming behavior, a winged form can understand flight automatically, and an artificial mind can be given intuitive social instincts it was never programmed to possess.
---
entries.name: Instinct Rewrite

entries.content:
## Habit and Reflex Rewrite
---
Learned habits and automatic reflexes can be changed without rewriting deeper personality. The Sculpter can remove a compulsive motion, install perfect defensive reactions, change handedness, improve coordination, eliminate an unwanted conditioned response, or make a routine action automatic.

Because reflexes belong to the touched nervous or cognitive system, the Aspect can align them with new anatomy or powers immediately. A person given extra limbs can use them naturally, and someone granted extreme speed can receive reaction patterns fast enough to control it safely.
---
entries.name: Habit and Reflex Rewrite

entries.content:
## Aptitude Rewrite
---
Natural aptitude for subjects or activities can be granted, removed, or reshaped. Mathematical intuition, artistic sensitivity, strategic thinking, mechanical insight, magical control, spatial reasoning, social perception, and countless other learning advantages can become native traits of the touched mind.

Aptitude is distinct from stored knowledge. The Sculpter can make someone exceptionally capable of learning music without giving them any songs, or combine aptitude with installed knowledge for immediate mastery. Limits such as poor working memory or incompatible sensory processing can be changed alongside the new aptitude when necessary.
---
entries.name: Aptitude Rewrite

entries.content:
## Skill Installation
---
Practical skills can be written directly into the target's body and mind. Combat techniques, surgery, piloting, craftsmanship, dance, athletics, instrument performance, coding, spell forms, or any other procedural ability can become as natural as years of practice.

The Aspect installs the whole performance pattern rather than mere facts: muscle memory, timing, perception, judgment, and supporting coordination are included. Skills can be perfect, partial, specialized, conditional, or removable. The Sculpter can also erase an existing skill or return it later through restoration.
---
entries.name: Skill Installation

entries.content:
## Knowledge Installation
---
Facts, theories, maps, histories, technical understanding, scientific principles, magical systems, and other structured knowledge can be placed into a touched mind directly. The target can receive one answer, an entire academic field, or an enormous organized library of information.

Knowledge can remain clearly identified as installed material or blend into ordinary recall as if long studied. The Sculpter can update outdated information, remove false beliefs, or add conceptual frameworks needed to understand newly granted abilities. Installed knowledge does not consume a finite storage quota unless the bearer deliberately imposes one.
---
entries.name: Knowledge Installation

entries.content:
## Language Rewrite
---
A touched being can gain or lose spoken, written, signed, coded, magical, telepathic, or otherwise structured languages. Fluency can include vocabulary, grammar, accent, literacy, cultural usage, and the physical ability to produce sounds or gestures the body previously could not make.

Language can also be invented and installed as a complete system. The Sculpter may give several beings the same private language one by one, rewrite a voice so alien phonemes become possible, or make a written script intuitively understandable without changing unrelated knowledge.
---
entries.name: Language Rewrite

entries.content:
## Identity and Self-Concept Rewrite
---
The way a touched mind understands who it is can be changed independently from body and memory. Name, self-image, species identification, roles, personal narrative, values, continuity, and internal sense of ownership over memories can all be rewritten.

This allows the Sculpter to align identity with a transformed body or deliberately create a more radical change in personhood. Memories can remain intact while the target interprets them as belonging to an earlier version of self, or a new identity can inherit old experiences seamlessly. The Aspect treats identity as an editable structure, not an untouchable abstraction, because it is carried by the touched consciousness.
---
entries.name: Identity and Self-Concept Rewrite

entries.content:
## Loyalty and Relationship Rewrite
---
Loyalty, trust, affection, hostility, familiarity, and other relationship structures carried inside a touched mind can be altered. The Sculpter can strengthen a genuine bond, remove coerced loyalty, erase an obsession, create devotion, or change how the target emotionally categorizes another person.

The revision affects the touched target's side of the relationship only unless the other person is separately contacted. Memories of the relationship can remain unchanged or be rewritten to support the new bond. Because emotion, memory, and personality are separate layers, the Sculpter can decide exactly how the relationship change is experienced.
---
entries.name: Loyalty and Relationship Rewrite

entries.content:
## Consciousness Rewrite
---
The architecture supporting consciousness can be changed through touch. The Sculpter can expand awareness, alter processing speed, create parallel thought streams, merge or separate mental partitions, stabilize fragmented consciousness, or redesign how a mind inhabits its body.

A biological mind can be adapted to a synthetic body, an artificial intelligence can receive sensory embodiment, or a consciousness can be made distributed across several parts of one touched system. The Sculpter can preserve one continuous identity through these changes or deliberately create distinct conscious entities when that is the intended result.
---
entries.name: Consciousness Rewrite

entries.content:
## Soul and Spiritual Rewrite
---
Souls, spirits, life-force structures, afterlife anchors, possession links, spiritual species traits, and other metaphysical components belonging to a touched being are editable parts of the target. The Sculpter can heal a damaged soul, remove an unwanted binding, add spiritual resilience, change its nature, or integrate it with a transformed body.

Spiritual changes do not require the target to be conventionally alive. A ghost with a coherent touchable manifestation, possessed vessel, soul-bearing artifact, or synthetic being with an established metaphysical core can be revised at the level that carries identity. The Aspect treats spiritual structure as another form of definition.
---
entries.name: Soul and Spiritual Rewrite

entries.content:
## Aura and Signature Rewrite
---
Auras, magical signatures, psychic fingerprints, divine marks, demonic traces, biometric identifiers, soul frequencies, energy colors, and similar recognizers can be changed or replaced. The Sculpter can make a touched being register as something entirely different to systems that identify such signatures.

The change can be cosmetic or fundamental. A magical scanner may read a new element because the affinity itself changed, or a bloodline seal may accept someone because the underlying signature was rewritten to match. Multiple signatures can coexist, alternate conditionally, or become impossible to classify according to the bearer's design.
---
entries.name: Aura and Signature Rewrite

entries.content:
## Alignment and Affinity Rewrite
---
Elemental affinities, magical alignments, divine resonance, technological compatibility, psychic frequency, moral-energy classifications, dimensional attunement, and other systems that decide what forces a being naturally connects to can be changed through touch.

A person can become compatible with a magic that once rejected them, cease resonating with a harmful realm, gain several affinities at once, or lose a divinely imposed classification. The Sculpter can preserve personal values while changing metaphysical alignment unless the bearer deliberately chooses to rewrite both.
---
entries.name: Alignment and Affinity Rewrite

entries.content:
## Power Bestowal
---
A touched being can be given an existing supernatural, biological, psychic, magical, technological, or otherwise extraordinary ability. Flight, telepathy, regeneration, elemental control, teleportation, invulnerability, shapeshifting, dimensional storage, or virtually any defined power can become a genuine part of the target.

The Change Aspect creates whatever internal support the ability requires: organs, energy channels, mental interfaces, soul structures, or new rules can be added in the same revision. The bestowed power does not have to come from another person or be removed from anyone else. It exists because the target has been changed into a being capable of that ability.
---
entries.name: Power Bestowal

entries.content:
## New Power Creation
---
The Sculpter is not restricted to powers that already exist. A new ability can be designed from function and written into the touched target as a coherent trait. Powers may combine concepts, operate by unusual triggers, affect uncommon domains, or behave according to rules invented at the moment of contact.

A created power can be simple, such as breathing underwater, or elaborate enough to support an entire personal system of abilities. The Change Aspect supplies a stable implementation rather than requiring the bearer to discover a preexisting magical tradition. If the Sculpter can define what the power should do, the touched target can be changed so that capability is real.
---
entries.name: New Power Creation

entries.content:
## Power Modification
---
Existing powers can be edited without being removed and rebuilt from nothing. Range, precision, output, targeting, appearance, secondary effects, control method, compatibility, safety, or any other property of the ability can be changed while preserving its recognizable core.

A destructive gift can become gentle enough for everyday use, a narrow ability can gain broader applications, or an unstable transformation can become effortless. The Sculpter can also split one power into several branches or merge several abilities into a unified system. The target's new version is treated as the authentic power after the revision.
---
entries.name: Power Modification

entries.content:
## Power Strength Rewrite
---
The magnitude of a touched being's power can be raised, lowered, capped, uncapped, or made dynamically scalable. A minor ability can become cosmic in output, an overwhelming power can become subtle, or strength can change according to chosen conditions.

Necessary control and durability can be adjusted at the same time so greater output does not automatically destroy the user unless that danger is specifically wanted. The Sculpter can also separate maximum potential from everyday output, allowing a target to possess immense power without losing fine precision.
---
entries.name: Power Strength Rewrite

entries.content:
## Power Cost and Limitation Rewrite
---
Costs and limitations attached to an ability are editable target properties. Fatigue, cooldowns, fuel requirements, pain, recoil, environmental dependence, emotional triggers, limited uses, range caps, or other built-in drawbacks can be reduced, replaced, removed, or newly imposed.

The Sculpter can keep a limitation for flavor while making it harmless, convert one cost into another, or eliminate all restrictions while preserving the power itself. A power that once required moonlight can become always available, while another can be intentionally restricted to specific circumstances for safety or personal preference.
---
entries.name: Power Cost and Limitation Rewrite

entries.content:
## Power Trigger Rewrite
---
The event or action that activates a power can be changed. A transformation tied to anger can answer a deliberate thought, a spell requiring speech can become silent, an automatic defense can become voluntary, or an ability can be keyed to a gesture, name, touch, emotion, location, or other condition.

Triggers can be layered and selective. One function may remain passive while another requires consent, or a dangerous mode may activate only when several conditions are met. The Sculpter can also remove accidental triggers that make a power difficult to live with.
---
entries.name: Power Trigger Rewrite

entries.content:
## Power Source Rewrite
---
The source from which a touched being draws power can be changed when that source is part of the target's relationship to the ability. A gift fueled by life-force can draw from sunlight, a curse-fed power can become self-sustaining, or a machine-dependent ability can become biological.

The Sculpter can create a new internal source, connect the power to another compatible reservoir, or make the ability operate without an external fuel requirement. If the source is a separate singular entity rather than a property of the target, the bearer changes the touched relationship rather than duplicating that external sovereign source.
---
entries.name: Power Source Rewrite

entries.content:
## Power Compatibility Rewrite
---
Conflicts between powers, species traits, bodies, artifacts, or energy systems can be removed. The Sculpter can make a touched being safely hold abilities that would normally reject one another, prevent transformations from damaging equipment, or allow foreign magic to function through an incompatible physiology.

Compatibility can be universal or selective. A person may become able to use any artifact, survive any power they carry, or interface with one specific system while remaining unchanged toward others. The Aspect changes the target's rules of acceptance rather than forcing every outside system to change remotely.
---
entries.name: Power Compatibility Rewrite

entries.content:
## Power Removal
---
A touched being's power can be erased completely, whether it is biological, magical, psychic, technological, divine, cursed, inherited, learned, or otherwise integrated with that target. The Sculpter can remove one function, an entire ability, or every extraordinary power the being possesses.

Removal can preserve secondary adaptations or restore the body to a state that no longer expects the missing power. If a singular external Aspect bond is removed, the source itself is not destroyed merely by editing the bearer; the bond can become vacant according to that Aspect's own succession. What disappears from the touched target is their possession or expression of the power.
---
entries.name: Power Removal

entries.content:
## Power Suppression and Restoration
---
Instead of deleting a power, the Sculpter can make it dormant, inaccessible, conditional, or temporarily absent while preserving a hidden restoration state. The target may feel completely ordinary until a chosen trigger returns the ability.

Suppression can affect output, awareness, specific techniques, or the entire power system. Because the original configuration can be stored as a Change template, restoration can be exact even after other alterations occur. This allows temporary disarmament or safe containment without forcing permanent removal.
---
entries.name: Power Suppression and Restoration

entries.content:
## Curse Rewrite
---
A curse attached to a touched person, object, structure, or bloodline anchor can be rewritten as directly as any other property. The Sculpter may remove it, change its trigger, reverse its effect, convert it into a blessing, isolate it to one harmless feature, or make it obey entirely new conditions.

The bearer does not need to fulfill the curse's original ritual requirements because the Change Aspect edits the target carrying the curse rather than bargaining with its creator. If the curse exists independently elsewhere, only the portion anchored in the touched target is directly changed until that other source is contacted.
---
entries.name: Curse Rewrite

entries.content:
## Blessing Rewrite
---
Blessings, divine favors, protective enchantments, sacred marks, and beneficial supernatural conditions can be strengthened, altered, duplicated within a touched target's structure, or removed. A narrow protection can become broad, a temporary blessing can become permanent, or its beneficiary rules can be changed.

The Sculpter can also create blessing-like properties without invoking another deity by simply changing what the target is capable of. A touched home may become naturally safe for its residents, or a person may gain a permanent protective trait that functions like a blessing but originates from Change.
---
entries.name: Blessing Rewrite

entries.content:
## Supernatural Nature Rewrite
---
The fundamental supernatural category of a touched being can be changed. Mortal, undead, spirit, demon, angelic, elemental, construct, fae, divine, cursed, blessed, or hybrid states can be added, removed, combined, or replaced along with the rules that make those classifications meaningful.

This goes deeper than appearance. Needs, vulnerabilities, powers, soul behavior, afterlife relationships, magical recognition, and species laws can all be updated to fit the new nature. The Sculpter can also separate desirable traits from traditional drawbacks instead of accepting a supernatural category as an indivisible package.
---
entries.name: Supernatural Nature Rewrite

entries.content:
## Transformation Stabilization
---
Unstable shapeshifting, involuntary transformations, mutation cycles, corrupted forms, and bodies caught between states can be stabilized through touch. The Sculpter can choose a preferred form, make transitions painless, give full control over switching, or reconcile several forms into one coherent system.

Stabilization does not require removing the transformation power. A were-creature can keep multiple forms without involuntary triggers, a shapeshifter can stop losing identity, and a magical transformation can become permanent until voluntarily reversed. The Aspect edits the relationship among states rather than merely freezing motion.
---
entries.name: Transformation Stabilization

entries.content:
## Form and State Lock
---
A touched target can be given a rule that preserves a chosen state against unwanted alteration. The Sculpter may lock appearance, species, material, power configuration, structural integrity, or another property so ordinary transformation, corrosion, aging, damage, or hostile rewriting cannot move it away from that definition.

The lock can contain permissions and exceptions. A person may remain immune to forced shapeshifting while still changing voluntarily, or a building may refuse damage while allowing renovation by approved users. Because the lock itself is a change, the Sculpter can later touch the target to revise or remove it.
---
entries.name: Form and State Lock

entries.content:
## Matter Forging
---
Nonliving matter becomes fully editable through touch. Shape, quantity, composition, texture, state, internal arrangement, function, and physical behavior can all be changed. A pebble can become a complex machine, a block of metal can become a furnished room, or broken debris can become a seamless new object.

The Change Aspect is not bound to conserving the touched object's original mass or volume. It needs an existing target to anchor the revision, but once that anchor exists the target can be made larger, smaller, heavier, lighter, or materially richer as part of becoming something else. The power changes an existing thing rather than acting on empty nothing.
---
entries.name: Matter Forging

entries.content:
## Material Transmutation
---
One substance can become another regardless of ordinary chemistry. Stone can become metal, steel can become glass, sand can become diamond, plastic can become living wood, or an unknown alien material can become something familiar. The Sculpter may transform the whole target or only selected regions.

Transmutation can also invent materials with properties no natural substance possesses. The Aspect defines composition and behavior together, allowing transparent armor, weightless stone, self-healing metal, solid mist, or other impossible materials to exist as stable matter. The result remains real after contact ends.
---
entries.name: Material Transmutation

entries.content:
## Composition Rewrite
---
The internal composition of an object can be edited without changing its outward form. Impurities can vanish, alloys can be redesigned, layered materials can be reorganized, hollow spaces can appear, circuitry can emerge inside solid matter, or a simple object can gain complex microscopic architecture.

Composition changes are useful when function depends on hidden structure. A cracked support can become a perfect composite, contaminated soil can become clean fertile material, or a harmless-looking object can contain advanced machinery. The Sculpter sees the internal pattern while touching the target and can alter it at any desired scale.
---
entries.name: Composition Rewrite

entries.content:
## Phase and State Rewrite
---
Solid, liquid, gas, plasma, crystalline, gel-like, spectral, energy-like, and other material states can be assigned independently from normal temperature or pressure. Water can become solid while remaining warm, metal can flow without melting, or smoke can hold a rigid shape.

State can be permanent, responsive, or conditional. A wall may become liquid only for approved users, armor may harden at impact, or a tool may alternate between solid and intangible modes. The target retains whatever stability rules the Sculpter writes into its new state.
---
entries.name: Phase and State Rewrite

entries.content:
## Density and Mass Rewrite
---
Density and mass are editable without forcing visible size to change. A feather can become massively heavy, a stone can weigh almost nothing, a wall can become dense enough to resist extraordinary force, or a vehicle can lose most of its mass while retaining strength.

The Sculpter can separate inertial behavior, gravitational weight, and material density instead of treating them as one package. This permits impossible combinations such as a dense material that is easy to lift or a light-looking object with enormous momentum. Any resulting physics are part of the touched target's revised definition.
---
entries.name: Density and Mass Rewrite

entries.content:
## Durability and Hardness Rewrite
---
Hardness, toughness, brittleness, impact resistance, tensile strength, fatigue resistance, and general durability can be changed independently. Glass can become harder than legendary metal, concrete can absorb impacts like rubber, or an indestructible object can become fragile enough to crumble by hand.

The Sculpter can protect one type of stress while allowing another. A blade may stay sharp without ever chipping, a bridge may bend safely during earthquakes, or fabric may remain soft while resisting cutting and fire. Durability does not require changing appearance or weight unless desired.
---
entries.name: Durability and Hardness Rewrite

entries.content:
## Elasticity and Flexibility Rewrite
---
Materials can gain or lose the ability to stretch, bend, compress, rebound, flow, or deform. Stone can become elastic, rubber can become rigid, metal can fold like cloth, or a structure can flex around impacts and return to perfect shape.

The change can be directionally or conditionally selective. A surface may yield to footsteps but resist weapons, or a cable may stretch only under approved loads. The Sculpter can combine flexibility with other rewritten traits so unusual materials remain useful rather than mechanically contradictory.
---
entries.name: Elasticity and Flexibility Rewrite

entries.content:
## Temperature and Thermal Rewrite
---
A touched target's temperature, heat capacity, thermal conductivity, melting behavior, ignition point, and relationship with heat can be rewritten. An object may remain cold beside a star, radiate warmth without fuel, refuse to melt, or freeze nearby moisture while itself staying comfortable to touch.

Thermal rules can be localized to the target or extended through a touched structure's defined system. A building can maintain stable internal temperature without conventional climate control, or armor can route heat away from its wearer. The Sculpter can change heat behavior without altering unrelated properties.
---
entries.name: Temperature and Thermal Rewrite

entries.content:
## Conductivity and Energy Interaction
---
Electrical, magical, thermal, kinetic, radiant, psychic, or fictional energy interaction can be changed in a touched material or object. It may become a perfect conductor, perfect insulator, absorber, reflector, storage medium, converter, or selective channel for chosen forms of energy.

An ordinary wire can carry impossible loads, armor can absorb hostile energy and release it harmlessly, or a crystal can convert light into another useful effect. The Sculpter can define what energy is accepted, where it goes, and what it becomes as part of the target's function.
---
entries.name: Conductivity and Energy Interaction

entries.content:
## Color, Transparency, and Reflection
---
The way matter interacts with visible light can be rewritten directly. Color, transparency, opacity, gloss, refraction, reflection, luminescence, and pattern can be changed without requiring pigments or coatings.

A wall can become perfectly transparent while remaining solid, a mirror can stop reflecting selected people, or an object can become visually indistinguishable from its background. These are genuine optical properties of the touched target. They can remain fixed or respond conditionally to identity, angle, lighting, or other chosen circumstances.
---
entries.name: Color, Transparency, and Reflection

entries.content:
## Friction, Adhesion, and Resistance
---
Friction, grip, adhesion, drag, and mechanical resistance can be rewritten on touched objects and surfaces. A floor can become perfectly slick, a wall can grip like adhesive, a rope can refuse cutting, or a vehicle can move through air and water with almost no resistance.

The Sculpter can make these properties selective. Shoes may grip a surface that is frictionless to everyone else, two objects may become inseparable until a condition is met, or a door may resist force while opening effortlessly for an approved person. The altered interaction belongs to the touched target and persists as one of its rules.
---
entries.name: Friction, Adhesion, and Resistance

entries.content:
## Inertia and Momentum Rewrite
---
A touched object's relationship with motion can be changed. Inertia can be reduced, increased, ignored, redirected, or made conditional, while momentum can be preserved, multiplied, cancelled, stored, or released according to newly written rules.

A moving vehicle can stop without harming occupants because its momentum is rewritten away, or a tiny push can send an object forward with enormous sustained motion. The Sculpter can decide whether the change affects the object itself, its contents, or a larger touched system, preserving fine control even when the result defies ordinary mechanics.
---
entries.name: Inertia and Momentum Rewrite

entries.content:
## Gravity Relationship Rewrite
---
The Sculpter can change how a touched target responds to gravity without needing to control gravity as a universal force. Weight can become zero, downward direction can change for that target, attraction can point toward a chosen surface, or the object can orbit a local point by definition.

A touched structure can also be given internal gravity rules affecting its own spaces, such as a room where the ceiling acts as down. These revisions belong to the target and can persist indefinitely. The Sculpter changes the target's gravitational relationship rather than remotely commanding every unrelated mass around it.
---
entries.name: Gravity Relationship Rewrite

entries.content:
## Object Function Rewrite
---
An object's purpose and operation can be changed regardless of what its original design would permit. A key can open any lock, a camera can project memories, a cup can purify whatever is poured into it, or a harmless toy can become a sophisticated tool.

The Change Aspect creates whatever internal or metaphysical implementation is needed for the new function. The object does not need visible mechanisms unless the Sculpter wants them. Existing functions can remain, be replaced, become conditional, or combine with new ones as separate layers.
---
entries.name: Object Function Rewrite

entries.content:
## Impossible Utility
---
Touched objects can receive functions that ordinary engineering or magic would consider impossible. A pencil can make its drawings physically real, a bag can contain an enormous interior, a lamp can illuminate only lies, or a map can update itself to show hidden routes.

These utilities remain target-bound rules rather than universal law changes. The object carries the impossible behavior wherever it goes until changed again. The Sculpter can make the function intuitive for users, restrict it by identity, or include safeguards without requiring a separate enchantment system.
---
entries.name: Impossible Utility

entries.content:
## Weapon Rewrite
---
Weapons can be changed in material, shape, output, targeting, lethality, ammunition, supernatural interaction, and purpose. A firearm can launch harmless objects, a sword can heal what it cuts, or a weapon can become incapable of injuring selected targets.
