A Dreamwalker can make everyone breathe underwater, make every door open into the same place, cause lies to become visible smoke, make weapons harmless, or declare that only invited people are allowed to move through a particular wall.

Rules can include exemptions. One ally can fly while everyone else remains grounded. One enemy can be unable to speak. Nightmare creatures can be forbidden from touching children. A healing rule can automatically repair injuries the moment they appear.

Once established, dream laws enforce themselves. The Dreamwalker does not need to recast them continuously. They remain part of the dream until changed, removed, or the dream ends.
---
entries.name: Dream Physics and Rule Authority

entries.content:
## Dream Death
---
Dream Death is the lethal law a Dreamwalker can invoke under Dream Godmode. When the Dreamwalker deliberately kills a target's dream-self and declares the death real, the waking body dies at the same moment.

The visible method can be anything the Dreamwalker creates: blade, fall, monster, explosion, erased body, stopped heart, execution ritual, collapsing world, or simple spoken command. The appearance is secondary to the oneiric law linking dream death to physical death.

Physical durability in waking reality does not normally protect against this effect because the attack is delivered through the target's own mind-body connection rather than by striking the physical body.

This is one of the main reasons the Dreamwalker is feared even by beings who are difficult to harm in waking reality. If they sleep, dream, and possess a mental identity that can be entered, a Dreamwalker can fight them on completely different terms.
---
entries.name: Dream Death

entries.content:
## Dream Combat
---
Dream Combat is battle conducted inside dream-space, where the Dreamwalker can use Dream Godmode, Dream Dust, mind editing, nightmare control, and dream physics simultaneously.

Combat does not need to resemble ordinary fighting. A sword can turn into ribbon before impact. The floor can swallow an enemy. Distance can stretch infinitely. An ally can be healed the moment they are struck. The Dreamwalker can become the sky, split into many forms, freeze time, remove a target's powers, or turn the entire battlefield into a cage.

Dream Dust expands the options further. Light Dust provides healing, shields, support constructs, and blessings. Dark Dust creates nightmare predators, execution weapons, fear effects, and death constructs. Cosmic Dust can create reality-bending tools and wishes.

The Dreamwalker decides how the fight ends: waking the opponent, imprisoning them, altering memory, removing hostile impulses, trapping them in sleep, or invoking Dream Death.
---
entries.name: Dream Combat

entries.content:
## Nightmare Dominion
---
Nightmare Dominion is total Dreamwalker authority over nightmares as environments, creatures, emotions, and sources of Dark Dream Dust. A nightmare is not inherently dangerous to the Dreamwalker. Once entered, it becomes material to control.

A Dreamwalker can freeze a nightmare monster, shrink it, interrogate it, erase it, transform it into something harmless, or take control of it as a construct. The entire nightmare can be rewritten into a safe dream without waking the sleeper.

Nightmares are also valuable because they produce Dark Dream Dust. The Dreamwalker can consume the harmful nightmare, remove it from the sleeper, and preserve the dark essence for later use.

A Dreamwalker can create controlled nightmares intentionally as prisons, psychological battlefields, training environments, or sources of specialized Dark Dust without contaminating their own mind.
---
entries.name: Nightmare Dominion

entries.content:
## Lucid Dream Granting
---
The Dreamwalker can grant lucid awareness to any sleeper. The person immediately understands that they are dreaming without being forced awake and gains whatever level of control the Dreamwalker chooses to provide.

A minor grant may give awareness only. A stronger grant can allow the dreamer to fly, create objects, reshape scenery, summon people, or use dream powers. The Dreamwalker can teach lucid control or simply make it instinctive.

Lucid Dream Granting is useful for healing, recreation, training, communication, and nightmare rescue. A frightened sleeper can be given enough control to confront a recurring monster personally. Allies can train in a shared dream where mistakes carry no permanent physical harm.

The Dreamwalker retains higher authority while present. A lucid dreamer can change the environment within granted permissions but cannot override the Dreamwalker's core rules unless explicitly allowed.
---
entries.name: Lucid Dream Granting

entries.content:
## Shared Dream Creation
---
Shared Dream Creation links multiple sleeping minds into one common dream. Everyone enters the same environment, sees the same events, can interact directly, and can remember the shared experience after waking.

Participants do not need to be physically near one another. A Dreamwalker can connect people across cities, planets, realities, dimensions, and timelines by using their dream signatures as addresses.

Each participant can receive different permissions. One may remain a normal observer, another may be lucid, another may be granted powers, while the Dreamwalker retains final authority over the space.

Shared dreams can serve as private meetings, classrooms, celebrations, support spaces, battle simulations, family gatherings, or entire temporary societies. Dream-Time Control can make the shared experience feel much longer than the physical sleep period.
---
entries.name: Shared Dream Creation

entries.content:
## Mass Dream Network
---
A Mass Dream Network is a large-scale shared dream connecting dozens, thousands, or potentially far more sleeping minds into one coordinated oneiric environment. The Dreamwalker acts as the central architect and keeps every participant synchronized.

The network can resemble a city, planet, school, battlefield, festival, library, or surreal reality. Participants can be divided into areas, given private rooms, grouped by permission, or allowed to move freely. The Dreamwalker can communicate with everyone simultaneously or appear differently to each person.

Because dream-space is conceptual, the network is not constrained by normal physical capacity. The Dreamwalker can create enough room for every connected mind while still tracking individual identities and permissions.

Mass Dream Networks can carry information as well as experience. A Dreamwalker can give an entire population the same warning dream, teach a common message, create a temporary sanctuary during crisis, or let distant groups meet without physical travel.
---
entries.name: Mass Dream Network

entries.content:
## Sleep Induction
---
Sleep Induction is the Dreamwalker's direct authority over the transition from waking consciousness into sleep. A look, touch, spoken word, focused thought, wave of oneiric pressure, or cloud of Dream Dust can make a chosen target fall asleep immediately.

The Dreamwalker decides the depth and character of the sleep. A person can become lightly drowsy, peacefully unconscious, deeply asleep, lucid, dreamless, or placed directly into a specific dream prepared in advance.

The effect can be individual or broad. A Dreamwalker can put one hostile person to sleep without affecting someone standing beside them, or spread a sleep command through an entire room, building, or crowd.

Sleep Induction can also be gentle enough that the body never collapses dangerously. Dream energy can lower the target into a chair, bed, floor, cloud construct, or waiting ally's arms. Once asleep, the person can be left resting, entered through dreamwalking, connected to a shared dream, healed, imprisoned, or woken whenever the Dreamwalker chooses.
---
entries.name: Sleep Induction

entries.content:
## Sleep Command and Waking
---
the Dreamwalker control waking as completely as they control sleep. They can wake a person instantly from ordinary rest, magical sleep, nightmare loops, oneiric imprisonment, or deliberately induced sleep.

Waking can be precise. One sleeper in a crowded room can be awakened without disturbing anyone else. A whole building can be roused at once. A target can be brought fully alert with no grogginess, confusion, or lingering dream haze.

The reverse is equally important. A Dreamwalker can prevent waking, allowing someone to remain asleep through noise, movement, pain, alarms, or external attempts to rouse them. The person stays in whatever dream or restorative state the Dreamwalker has assigned.

Sleep duration can also be optimized. A person can receive the restorative benefit of a long night's sleep while the Dreamwalker adjusts Dream-Time so the subjective and biological rest is completed efficiently.
---
entries.name: Sleep Command and Waking

entries.content:
## Dream Imprisonment
---
Dream Imprisonment traps a mind inside a controlled dream while the physical body remains asleep. The prison can resemble a cell, maze, comfortable room, looping day, false waking world, nightmare landscape, black void, or any environment the Dreamwalker chooses.

Realizing it is a dream does not create an exit. The Dreamwalker controls waking conditions, portals, dream physics, and access to the Dream Realm. A lucid prisoner can understand the situation perfectly and still remain contained.

Time inside can be stretched. A short period of waking-world sleep can feel much longer to the prisoner, allowing containment, interrogation, rehabilitation, or separation from a physical crisis without needing an ordinary cage.

The prison can be humane or terrifying. A dangerous person may be kept in a quiet sanctuary until they calm down, while a hostile enemy can be trapped inside a personalized Dark Dust nightmare with every escape route under Dreamwalker control.
---
entries.name: Dream Imprisonment

entries.content:
## Mind Sovereignty
---
Mind Sovereignty is the Dreamwalker's broad authority over conscious and subconscious mental processes. Dreams are the easiest doorway, but the Dreamwalker can also alter waking thought, perception, attention, belief, impulses, internal narration, emotional associations, and access to memory.

Control ranges from subtle to absolute. A Dreamwalker can calm panic, make a hostile thought lose urgency, remove a compulsion, block attention from a specific subject, insert a command, or take direct control over what a target is capable of thinking about.

Waking minds can also be folded into dream-like mental spaces without putting the physical body fully asleep. The Dreamwalker can hold a conversation inside someone's thoughts while still speaking to them physically.

Mind Sovereignty is equally useful for repair. Foreign commands, psychic contamination, false mental structures, compulsions, and damaged thought patterns can be isolated and rewritten. To a Dreamwalker, the mind is editable architecture whose rooms happen to be thoughts.
---
entries.name: Mind Sovereignty

entries.content:
## Memory Editing
---
Memory Editing lets a Dreamwalker alter how an existing memory is stored, recalled, and emotionally experienced. Details, faces, chronology, sensory information, emotional intensity, and personal interpretation can all be changed independently.

The Dreamwalker can enter the memory as a dreamlike scene and walk through it. They can pause events, inspect details from different angles, restore information the conscious mind forgot, replace a false face with the real one, or change how the memory connects to later emotions.

A memory can be protected before editing. The Dreamwalker may preserve an untouched original inside a private archive, then create a modified version for the waking mind. This makes edits reversible whenever the original needs to be restored.

Memory Editing can be therapeutic or controlling. Trauma can be separated from panic, implanted memories can be removed, and broken memories can be repaired. The same power can also create convincing false histories when used deliberately.
---
entries.name: Memory Editing

entries.content:
## Memory Extraction and Viewing
---
Memory Extraction lets a Dreamwalker enter memories as explorable environments. Rather than receiving a vague psychic impression, they can step into the remembered place, listen to conversations, inspect objects, move around the scene, and notice details the memory owner no longer consciously recalls.

The Dreamwalker can copy the memory, remove the original, isolate a fragment, or preserve the entire experience inside a Dream Library. A copied memory can be shared with another person or turned into an interactive dream.

Buried and forgotten memories remain accessible because they still exist in the deeper oneiric structure. Childhood events, suppressed knowledge, forgotten faces, and sensory details can be recovered even when the waking mind insists they are gone.

Emotional pain can be separated from information. The Dreamwalker can study a traumatic memory without forcing the owner to relive the suffering and can later return the memory in a safer form.
---
entries.name: Memory Extraction and Viewing

entries.content:
## Subconscious Editing
---
Subconscious Editing reaches the systems beneath ordinary thought: automatic fears, habits, impulses, associations, dream symbols, emotional reflexes, and the hidden expectations that shape behavior.

A Dreamwalker can enter the subconscious as symbolic architecture and edit the structures directly. A phobia may appear as a locked room, a harmful compulsion as a repeating road, an implanted command as foreign machinery, or buried grief as a flooded house.

Changing the symbolic structure changes the underlying mental pattern. A fear response can be disconnected from its trigger, confidence can be strengthened, a self-destructive impulse can be removed, and a recurring nightmare can stop being generated at its source.

The Dreamwalker can make edits subtle enough that the person simply feels different afterward or preserve awareness of exactly what changed. The subconscious is not treated as mysterious instinct; it is another layer of the dream-mind available for direct work.
---
entries.name: Subconscious Editing

entries.content:
## Dream Emotion Control
---
The Dreamwalker can control emotional states by manipulating the mental and dream structures that generate them. Calm can replace panic, courage can replace terror, joy can spread through a shared dream, or fear can be intensified into a controlled nightmare.

Emotions can remain inside dream-space or be anchored into waking consciousness. A person can wake carrying peace from a healing dream, lose the panic response attached to a traumatic memory, or remain shaken by a deliberately terrifying encounter.

Inside dreams, emotion can become environment. Grief may appear as rain, anger as red storms, joy as floating lights, fear as moving shadows, and hope as warm sunrise. The Dreamwalker can reshape these manifestations as easily as any other scenery.

Light Dream Dust naturally strengthens restorative emotions. Dark Dream Dust responds strongly to fear, dread, rage, helplessness, and predatory nightmare states.
---
entries.name: Dream Emotion Control

entries.content:
## Dreamwalker Mental Defense
---
Dreamwalker Mental Defense turns the Dreamwalker's own mind into hostile territory for psychic intruders. Telepathy, possession, memory theft, dream invasion, and mental domination all have to cross an oneiric layer the Dreamwalker controls natively.

An invading consciousness can be diverted into a false dream, trapped in an endless hallway, surrounded by guardians, stripped of psychic weapons, fed convincing false memories, or expelled entirely.

Defensive architecture can remain active while the Dreamwalker is awake. Automatic wards recognize unauthorized mental contact and route it into controlled dream-space before it reaches private thought.

If the Dreamwalker chooses direct confrontation, the intrusion becomes a dream battlefield inside their own mind. There, Dream Godmode gives them overwhelming authority over the environment, making mental attack a dangerous way to challenge the Dreamwalker.
---
entries.name: Dreamwalker Mental Defense

entries.content:
## Dream Identity and Dream Disguise
---
Inside dreams and the Dream Realm, a Dreamwalker can assume any appearance instantly. Human, animal, deity, monster, child, giant, cloud, constellation, machine, shadow, abstract symbol, or completely invented form are all equally natural.

The disguise changes more than visuals. Voice, scent, apparent species, size, movement, emotional presence, and the way the dreamer's subconscious interprets the figure can all be rewritten.

This lets the Dreamwalker infiltrate dreams without being noticed. They can appear as a familiar friend, background stranger, dream character, harmless animal, or nobody visible at all.

Form never reduces authority. A Dreamwalker appearing as a tiny moth can still stop time, rewrite the entire landscape, erase a nightmare, or invoke Dream Death.
---
entries.name: Dream Identity and Dream Disguise

entries.content:
## Dream Constructs
---
Dream Constructs are tangible forms created from Dream Dust and imagination. They can exist inside dreams or be manifested into waking reality, where they behave like real objects while retaining properties defined by the Dreamwalker.

Constructs can become almost anything: weapons, shields, armor, houses, bridges, tools, furniture, aircraft, clouds, creatures, ropes, books, machines, cages, medical devices, giant hands, vehicles, or completely impossible inventions.

The type of Dream Dust shapes the construct. Light Dust creates healing, blessing, protection, support, and restoration. Dark Dust creates fear, destruction, predatory forms, curses, restraints, and execution. Cosmic Dust creates reality-bending constructs whose abilities can be written through imagination rather than ordinary physics.

Constructs can move autonomously, recognize specific people, transform between forms, follow verbal or mental rules, and return to loose Dream Dust when dismissed. They are the main way the Dreamwalker carry dream imagination into waking reality.
---
entries.name: Dream Constructs

entries.content:
## Dream Summons
---
Dream Summons are beings created or called from dreams and given independent movement and behavior. A Dreamwalker can summon a creature they invented, pull a dream animal into waking reality, create a person-shaped assistant from Dust, or manifest a controlled nightmare predator.

Summons can possess speech, memory, skills, personality, and specialized powers written into them. A dream librarian can organize memories, a giant guardian can protect a building, and a Dark Dust hound can track one specific dream signature across realities.

The Dreamwalker always knows what summons are active and can reshape, dismiss, recall, or merge them back into Dream Dust at any time.

Cosmic Dream Dust supports especially complex summons, including beings with shapeshifting, portals, independent dreamwalking, or godlike functions defined when they are created.
---
entries.name: Dream Summons

entries.content:
## Light Dream Dust
---
Light Dream Dust is the condensed essence of good dreams: comfort, hope, safety, love, wonder, reunion, peaceful adventure, success, creativity, and restorative sleep. It often appears pale gold, white, soft blue, pink, or iridescent, glowing without heat.

Light Dust specializes in healing, blessings, protection, cleansing, emotional support, mental repair, and restoration. It can close injuries, rebuild permanent damage, restore lost limbs and senses, cleanse psychic corruption, strengthen allies, stabilize souls, and protect dreams from hostile intrusion.

Constructs made from Light Dust naturally favor supportive behavior. Shields bend around allies, guardian animals intercept danger, healing ribbons wrap wounds, and clouds can carry passengers while continuously restoring them.

Light Dust is also excellent for persistent blessings. A room can be made incapable of producing nightmares, clothing can carry a healing aura, and a charm can automatically protect its owner while asleep.
---
entries.name: Light Dream Dust

entries.content:
## Dark Dream Dust
---
Dark Dream Dust is condensed nightmare essence produced by fear, dread, helplessness, predatory dreams, horror, grief-heavy sleep, and violent imagination. It often appears black, crimson, deep violet, or smoky blue, moving like ash through invisible water.

Dark Dust is not inherently evil, but its natural strengths are destruction, fear shaping, binding, curses, nightmare manifestation, predatory constructs, and death-aspected effects.

The most feared use is the creation of execution constructs such as the Grim Reaper. These beings carry Dream Death authority into waking reality and can kill assigned targets regardless of ordinary durability, regeneration, species, immortality claims, or divine status.

Dark Dust can also form weapons that damage mind and body together, prisons made from a target's fears, sleep-paralysis fields, nightmare storms, tracking predators, shadow armor, and curses that follow a dream signature.
---
entries.name: Dark Dream Dust

entries.content:
## Cosmic Dream Dust
---
Cosmic Dream Dust is the rarest and most powerful oneiric essence. It forms from dreams whose imagination is so vast that the Dream Realm treats them like miniature realities: dreams of gods, cosmic entities, reality creators, or exceptionally imaginative humans whose minds build wild self-consistent worlds.

Cosmic Dust resembles miniature galaxies, auroras, or dark-violet particles containing tiny stars. Every grain carries compressed creative possibility.

It is the only Dream Dust capable of true wish granting. A Dreamwalker can shape a desired outcome and release Cosmic Dust to make that outcome real in waking reality. Wishes can create, restore, transform, transport, empower, remove, heal, or alter things beyond ordinary construct logic.

Cosmic Dust also creates impossible vehicles, living castles, autonomous divine constructs, multiversal portals, adaptive weapons, and environments that continue obeying dreamlike rules after manifesting in reality.
---
entries.name: Cosmic Dream Dust

entries.content:
## Dream Dust Harvesting
---
Dream Dust Harvesting is the process of collecting the oneiric residue naturally produced by dreams. A Dreamwalker can harvest while walking through a dream, while feeding on it, or directly from currents in the Dream Realm.

The emotional and imaginative nature of the dream determines the dust. Positive dreams shed Light Dust. Nightmares shed Dark Dust. Exceptionally imaginative or divine dreams can crystallize Cosmic Dust.

Harvesting does not require ending the dream. A Dreamwalker can collect particles naturally released by a healthy dream while leaving the sleeper unaware anything was taken.

Nightmares can be completely consumed when the Dreamwalker wants to remove them, turning harmful dream energy into stored Dark Dust. Highly imaginative dreams may be preserved instead of harvested so the Dreamwalker can revisit the extraordinary world later.
---
entries.name: Dream Dust Harvesting

entries.content:
## Dream Dust Reservoir
---
the Dreamwalker store Dream Dust inside the Dream Core as compressed oneiric reserves. The storage is extradimensional relative to the body, so enormous amounts of Dust do not increase physical weight or size.

Light, Dark, and Cosmic Dust remain separated unless the Dreamwalker deliberately combines them. The Dreamwalker always knows which type is available and can release anything from a single grain to a vast cloud.

Stored Dust does not spoil or weaken with age. A Dreamwalker can preserve Light Dust gathered centuries earlier or save Cosmic Dust from a unique divine dream for a future wish.

Construct patterns can also be stored with the Dust. Favorite weapons, healing clouds, guardians, vehicles, and portal devices can be recalled instantly in their finished form rather than rebuilt from scratch each time.
---
entries.name: Dream Dust Reservoir

entries.content:
## Dream Dust Shaping
---
Dream Dust Shaping is direct control over loose oneiric material. Dust moves according to thought like an extension of the Dreamwalker's hands. It can gather, scatter, harden, soften, flow, crystallize, become transparent, change color, or assemble into complex moving forms.

A few grains can become a key, needle, symbol, tracking mote, tiny animal, or light. Larger clouds can become weapons, armor, buildings, vehicles, bridges, armies of constructs, weather systems, or entire temporary environments.

Different Dust types can be layered into one creation. A weapon may use a Cosmic Dust core, a Light Dust guard that protects the wielder, and a Dark Dust edge that attacks hostile minds.

Constructs can be programmed with conditions. A guardian can recognize specific people, a healing blanket can activate only around injury, and a portal key can open only when held by its intended owner.
---
entries.name: Dream Dust Shaping

entries.content:
## Light Dust Healing
---
Light Dust Healing restores the body by reading the target's remembered healthy pattern through mind and oneiric identity, then rebuilding physical tissue toward that state.

Cuts close, bones realign, burns clear, damaged nerves reconnect, poison damage is cleansed, and organs can be restored without surgery. Injuries that ordinary medicine considers permanent are not permanent to Light Dust. Lost limbs, missing senses, old scars, chronic damage, and long-healed injuries can be reconstructed.

Mental wounds can be treated at the same time. Psychic damage, nightmare trauma, corrupted memories, emotional fractures, and mind-control scars can be repaired while the Dreamwalker stabilizes the target's dream structure.

Healing can be delivered through touch, clouds, blessings, dream constructs, sleep, armor, charms, or dedicated healing dreams. A Light Dust construct can continue restoring someone even after the Dreamwalker leaves the area.
---
entries.name: Light Dust Healing

entries.content:
## Light Dust Blessings
---
Light Dust Blessings are persistent beneficial rules placed on people, objects, places, vehicles, or dreams. Instead of performing one immediate effect, the Dreamwalker gives the target an ongoing supportive property.

A person can be blessed with restful sleep, nightmare resistance, accelerated healing, calm under pressure, stronger memory, improved mental defenses, dream awareness, or a protective aura. Objects can be made loyal to one owner, protective, healing, self-repairing, or responsive to danger.

Places can also be blessed. A bedroom may automatically block nightmares. A hospital room can encourage healing sleep. A shelter can place every sleeper inside a soft protective dream field.

Blessings can recognize identities and conditions. A charm can function only for its intended wearer, a blanket can heal whoever is injured beneath it, and a doorway can prevent nightmare entities from crossing while remaining ordinary to everyone else.
---
entries.name: Light Dust Blessings

entries.content:
## Dark Dust Execution Constructs
---
Dark Dust Execution Constructs are one of the most extreme offensive uses of nightmare essence. The Dreamwalker shapes Dark Dream Dust into an archetype of death, most famously a Grim Reaper, and gives it the identity of a target.

The construct does not defeat the target through ordinary force. It carries Dream Death authority into waking reality. Once it reaches the chosen target and completes its execution action, the target dies regardless of conventional armor, durability, regeneration, species, immortality claims, cosmic strength, or divine status.

The Reaper's appearance can adapt to the target's subconscious concept of death: a hooded skeleton, faceless shadow, black angel, cosmic void, silent child, or something completely unfamiliar. The Dreamwalker can also invent another execution archetype instead of using the classic Reaper form.

Execution constructs can follow dream signatures across physical distance, portals, dreams, and the Dream Realm. They ignore unrelated people unless the Dreamwalker gives them broader instructions.
---
entries.name: Dark Dust Execution Constructs

entries.content:
## Cosmic Dust Wish Granting
---
Cosmic Dust Wish Granting converts concentrated imaginative possibility into a real change in waking reality. The Dreamwalker gathers Cosmic Dream Dust, defines the desired outcome, and releases the dust as a completed wish.

A wish can create objects, restore destroyed places, heal conditions beyond ordinary medicine, grant powers, remove powers, transport people, change bodies, rebuild memories, create homes, undo damage, or manifest things that have never existed before. The result is not a temporary dream illusion. Cosmic Dust makes the new state real.

A wish can be spoken, thought silently, written into a construct, or offered to another person. The Dreamwalker may let somebody else state the wish while retaining control over the meaning so the result matches the intended outcome rather than twisting language against the wisher.

Cosmic Dust can grant wishes because it comes from dreams that already behave like self-contained realities. The dust carries the oneiric principle that imagination is allowed to become law.
---
entries.name: Cosmic Dust Wish Granting

entries.content:
## Dream Dust Vehicles and Clouds
---
The Dreamwalker can shape Dream Dust into vehicles and moving platforms for waking reality, dreams, or the Dream Realm. The construct can resemble a plane, car, motorcycle, train, ship, spacecraft, floating bed, carpet, cloud, giant creature, or an impossible machine designed entirely from imagination.

These vehicles do not need ordinary fuel unless the Dreamwalker wants that appearance. Motion comes from the Dream Dust obeying its created function. A plane can hover without airspeed, a cloud can carry passengers without letting them fall through, and a ship can leave waking reality and sail directly into dream-space.

Interiors can ignore outside dimensions. A small cloud may contain bedrooms, storage, a kitchen, and a lounge because its interior is partly oneiric. Light Dust can heal and protect passengers, Dark Dust can hide or defend the vehicle, and Cosmic Dust can give it multiversal or timeline travel.

Dream clouds are especially common casual constructs. They can follow the Dreamwalker automatically, become soft seats or beds, expand into platforms for groups, and change direction without physical controls.
---
entries.name: Dream Dust Vehicles and Clouds

entries.content:
## Dream Forge and Artifacts
---
The Dream Forge is the Dreamwalker's ability to create persistent artifacts from Dream Dust, memory, imagination, and dream law. Unlike a temporary construct shaped for one task, a forged artifact is stabilized so it continues functioning without constant attention.

A Dreamwalker can forge weapons, rings, books, masks, keys, healing charms, protective clothing, portal devices, vehicles, musical instruments, or objects whose purpose cannot be reproduced by ordinary technology. Light, Dark, and Cosmic Dream Dust can be layered like different materials, each contributing its own nature.

Artifacts can recognize owners by dream signature. A sword may appear only for its chosen wielder, a necklace may drag its wearer into a safe dream when they are dying, and a key may open any physical door into one specific Dream Realm sanctuary.

Memories can also be forged into objects. A book can contain an explorable dream, a locket can replay a preserved memory, and a weapon can remember every person who ever carried it.
---
entries.name: Dream Forge and Artifacts

entries.content:
## Dreamwalker Personal Dream Sanctum
---
Every mature Dreamwalker can create a permanent personal sanctuary inside the Dream Realm. It belongs to the Dreamwalker rather than to a temporary sleeper and does not dissolve when the Dreamwalker wakes.

The sanctuary can be any environment imaginable: a cosmic palace, quiet apartment, moonlit beach, endless library, impossible city, floating islands, forest beneath several skies, or a landscape that continuously changes to match intent. The Dreamwalker controls every entrance, object, resident construct, weather pattern, and physical law inside it.

Dream Dust reserves, memory libraries, forged artifacts, vehicles, guardians, preserved dreams, and important personal objects can be stored there. Interior scale has no meaningful relationship to physical space because the sanctuary exists fully inside dream reality.

Guests can be invited through shared dreaming or portals. Unwanted minds cannot simply wander in; the sanctuary recognizes the Dreamwalker's authority and treats permission as part of its fundamental structure.
---
entries.name: Dreamwalker Personal Dream Sanctum

entries.content:
## The Dream Aspect
---

The Dream Aspect is the surviving divine authority of Somnia, Goddess of Sleep and Dreams. It connects sleep, dreaming, imagination, memory, subconscious thought, nightmares, Dream Dust, and the Dream Realm across a connected multiverse. Somnia created it through her final sacrifice during the Night Without Dreams, turning her own existence into a source that could keep dreaming alive after her divine body was gone.

The Aspect is not Somnia reincarnated. It retains her oneiric architecture, protective instincts, routes through the Dream Realm, and understanding of dream law while allowing one completely different host to become the current Dreamwalker Omnicron.

Every ordinary dream touches a tiny local portion of this greater field. The Dreamwalker alone carries the complete conscious mantle. Dream Godmode, oneiric travel, Dream Dust, mindscape editing, dream materialization, and cross-reality dreamwalking are different expressions of the authority Somnia left behind.

---
entries.name: The Dream Aspect

entries.content:
## Singular Dream Omnicron
---
Only one complete Dream Omnicron can hold the Dream Aspect across a connected multiverse at a time. That bearer is known as the Dreamwalker. Other beings may dreamwalk, manipulate sleep, create nightmares, enter minds, or even rule local dream dimensions, but none of them become a second true Dreamwalker while the Aspect already has an active host.

This singularity prevents the source from dividing into competing equal authorities. Alternate timelines may contain echoes, previous versions, simulations, or beings who resemble the bearer, yet the Aspect recognizes only one current sovereign identity as its complete host. If the mantle truly becomes vacant, succession can occur, but two full Dreamwalkers do not naturally coexist. This is what makes the title an Omnicron state rather than a species classification: it is a unique metaphysical office attached to one consciousness, not a hereditary population.
entries.name: Singular Dream Omnicron

entries.content:
## Dreamwalker Dominion of Mind, Sleep, and Dreams
---
The Dreamwalker's core dominion unifies three territories that lesser powers often treat separately: mind, sleep, and dream. The bearer can put a target to sleep, enter the resulting dream, rewrite the dream's laws, alter memory or personality through the subconscious, change what the target feels or perceives, and then decide whether the target wakes, remains asleep, forgets the event, remembers a fabricated version, or carries a lasting mental edit into waking life.

The same authority scales outward. A single mind, a shared dream, a population-wide sleep event, the Dream Realm, or a cross-reality dream network can all be handled through the same source. Dream Godmode governs the interior of dreams; Mind Sovereignty governs waking consciousness; sleep control governs the threshold between them. Together they make the Dreamwalker a source-level sovereign rather than a specialist limited to one psychic technique.
entries.name: Dreamwalker Dominion of Mind, Sleep, and Dreams
entries.comment: Dreamwalker Dominion of Mind, Sleep, and Dreams

entries.content:
## Dream Body Editing
---
Dream Body Editing changes the form a sleeper uses inside a dream. The Dreamwalker can make someone taller, smaller, younger-looking, older-looking, winged, armored, animal-shaped, monstrous, beautiful, invisible, giant, microscopic, or completely abstract.

A dream-body can also be given new physical traits and abilities. Extra limbs, wings, gills, armor, impossible senses, supernatural strength, or a completely different species form can be created instantly because the dream-body is governed by oneiric rules rather than biology.

The Dreamwalker can remove an enemy's advantages just as easily. A target can be reduced to a powerless form, separated from dream-created weapons, made unable to move, or changed into an object that cannot meaningfully resist.

Body editing can also be supportive. A person with a physical disability can experience unrestricted movement inside a dream, someone learning a new prosthetic can practice with a perfect dream version, and a sleeper can explore different forms without waking-world consequences.
---
entries.name: Dream Body Editing

entries.content:
## Dream Power Granting
---
Dream Power Granting allows a Dreamwalker to give a sleeper abilities by rewriting the rules attached to their dream-body. Flight, telekinesis, magic, elemental control, super speed, invulnerability, shapeshifting, portals, or entirely invented powers can be assigned instantly.

The Dreamwalker defines how the power works, what it looks like, how strong it is, and whether the dreamer understands it intuitively. A person can receive a simple pair of wings for a peaceful lucid dream or an entire superhero power set for a training simulation.

Granted powers normally belong to the dream. They disappear when the dream ends unless the Dreamwalker uses Cosmic Dream Dust to anchor the gift into waking reality as a true wish or persistent reality alteration.

The ability is especially useful for training because someone can practice controlling extreme power in a space where the Dreamwalker can pause time, reset injuries, rewrite mistakes, and change the challenge instantly.
---
entries.name: Dream Power Granting

entries.content:
## Dream Resurrection
---
Dream Resurrection restores a person whose physical life has ended when their oneiric identity can still be located through preserved dreams, memories, soul imprint, or the Dream Realm. The Dreamwalker treats death partly as a separation between identity and body, and their power can rebuild that connection.

The Dreamwalker gathers the target's dream signature and remaining oneiric presence into a complete dream-body. Light Dream Dust restores coherence and heals the identity, while Cosmic Dream Dust supplies the reality-level creation needed to recreate or restore a physical body capable of holding the same person.

The result is not a disposable dream copy when the original identity is recovered. Memories, personality, continuity, and the target's unique dream signature belong to the same individual.

Dream Resurrection can also reverse dream-death effects if the Dreamwalker chooses to restore the victim's oneiric connection and rewrite the lethal event before the identity has been erased from the Dream Realm.
---
entries.name: Dream Resurrection

entries.content:
## Dream Communication
---
Dream Communication lets a Dreamwalker speak to sleeping minds across any distance by entering their dreams or sending a direct oneiric message. The recipient does not need to share a spoken language because meaning can be delivered through images, emotion, memory, and symbolic understanding.

A message can be interactive, allowing a full conversation, or recorded to play the next time the target sleeps. The Dreamwalker can attach maps, warnings, memories, demonstrations, emotional tone, or visual examples that communicate far more than ordinary speech.

Dream Communication can cross universes and timelines when the Dreamwalker knows the target's dream signature. The Dream Realm acts as the carrier, making physical communications technology unnecessary.

Messages can be sealed to one identity. If another mind enters the dream, the communication can hide itself, appear as meaningless scenery, or refuse to play until the intended dream signature is present.
---
entries.name: Dream Communication

entries.content:
## Waking Dream Projection
---
Waking Dream Projection places dream imagery directly into conscious perception without putting the target fully to sleep. A Dreamwalker can overlay people, scenes, voices, memories, symbols, landscapes, or entire dream environments onto the waking world.

The projection can be private to one mind or shared by everyone in an area. One person may see a guide no one else can perceive, while an entire crowd may witness the same impossible sky or memory reconstruction.

By itself, the projection is mental experience rather than ordinary matter, but Dream Dust can make selected parts tangible. A projected chair can become something a person can sit on, a projected wall can become a barrier, and a projected creature can physically interact with the environment.

Waking Dream Projection is useful for teaching, communication, distraction, stealth, comfort, performance, and gradually transitioning a person from waking consciousness into a full controlled dream.
---
entries.name: Waking Dream Projection

entries.content:
## Reality-to-Dream Overlay
---
Reality-to-Dream Overlay imposes dream law over a waking area while physical reality remains underneath. The Dreamwalker does not need to make everyone unconscious first. Instead, the environment begins obeying oneiric rules as though waking space has temporarily become part of a dream.

A street can turn into a moonlit ocean without actually ceasing to be a street beneath the overlay. Doors can open into impossible rooms, distances can stretch or collapse, dream constructs can become tangible, and the same physical location can present different dream environments to different people.

The Dreamwalker controls who perceives and is affected by each layer. Allies may move through a healing sanctuary while enemies occupying the same space experience a nightmare battlefield.

Cosmic Dream Dust can stabilize changes so strongly that parts of the overlay become genuine reality alterations rather than temporary oneiric conditions.
---
entries.name: Reality-to-Dream Overlay

entries.content:
## Dream-Time Control
---
Dream-Time Control determines how quickly subjective time passes inside a dream compared with waking reality. A Dreamwalker can stretch minutes of physical sleep into hours, days, months, or much longer periods of conscious experience.

This allows enormous amounts of training, conversation, healing, planning, study, or recreation during a single night. A group can spend what feels like a week practicing together and wake shortly after falling asleep.

Time can also be paused locally. The Dreamwalker can freeze a nightmare creature while talking to the dreamer, stop a battle to rewrite the environment, or hold every dream character motionless except selected people.

Different regions and people can have different time rates within the same shared dream. The Dreamwalker synchronizes them whenever interaction is needed.
---
entries.name: Dream-Time Control

entries.content:
## Dream-Space Folding
---
Dream-Space Folding lets a Dreamwalker alter distance, scale, and layout inside dreams. A hallway can become endless, a distant mountain can be one step away, a bedroom closet can contain an entire universe, and two doors separated by thousands of miles can become adjacent.

The visible architecture does not need to reveal the true spatial arrangement. A tiny box can have a city inside it. A staircase can cross several realities before reaching its next landing. A dream house can contain more rooms than could physically fit in the world around it.

The Dreamwalker uses folding for shortcuts, sanctuaries, prisons, and combat. Allies can cross huge dream distances instantly while enemies run toward an exit that never gets closer.

Dream Portals and multiversal dreamwalking rely on the same deeper principle: dream-space cares about conceptual connection more than ordinary geography.
---
entries.name: Dream-Space Folding

entries.content:
## Nightmare Cleansing
---
Nightmare Cleansing removes the structure that creates harmful nightmares rather than merely waking the sleeper. The Dreamwalker enters the nightmare, identifies what keeps it repeating, and edits, consumes, extracts, or destroys the underlying oneiric pattern.

A monster can be erased, but the Dreamwalker can also remove the fear loop that recreates it. A cursed location can become safe. A traumatic memory can be separated from the nightmare response. A foreign entity feeding on fear can be destroyed and its residue cleansed with Light Dream Dust.

The nightmare's fear can condense into Dark Dream Dust while the restored peaceful dream begins producing Light Dust, letting the Dreamwalker turn harmful oneiric energy into useful resources.

After cleansing, the Dreamwalker decides what comes next: peaceful dreaming, dreamless sleep, a healing dream, a lucid sanctuary, or immediate waking.
---
entries.name: Nightmare Cleansing

entries.content:
## Nightmare Creation
---
Nightmare Creation lets a Dreamwalker deliberately design frightening dreams with the same precision used for peaceful dreamscapes. The nightmare can target a specific fear, create monsters, simulate danger, trap an enemy in symbolic punishment, generate Dark Dream Dust, or become a controlled battlefield.

The Dreamwalker defines pain, fear intensity, escape conditions, time loops, scenery, memory use, and whether Dream Death authority is active. A target can be placed inside a nightmare tailored directly from their subconscious while the Dreamwalker controls every exit.

Created nightmares can also be used safely. A training nightmare can let someone practice functioning under fear while the Dreamwalker prevents actual harm and resets the environment whenever needed.

When used against enemies, Nightmare Creation becomes personalized mental warfare: the target's own fears provide material, but the Dreamwalker owns the rules.
---
entries.name: Nightmare Creation

entries.content:
## Sleep Paralysis Control
---
the Dreamwalker control the boundary state known as sleep paralysis. They can remove it instantly, prevent it from occurring, or deliberately create a controlled version in which awareness remains active while the physical body stays asleep and motionless.

In supportive use, a terrified sleeper can be freed and moved into a safe lucid dream. Nightmare entities that exploit paralysis can be exposed, trapped, or destroyed by the Dreamwalker.

In hostile use, a target can be held in paralysis while the Dreamwalker enters the associated dream-space. The body remains unable to move while the mind experiences whatever environment the Dreamwalker creates.

The Dreamwalker controls what the target perceives during the state: real surroundings, a dream overlay, complete darkness, or a fully constructed nightmare. The paralysis ends immediately when released.
---
entries.name: Sleep Paralysis Control

entries.content:
## Dream Tracking
---
Dream Tracking follows the oneiric signature left by a mind moving through dreams, memories, portals, or the Dream Realm. Every consciousness has a recognizable pattern, and dream movement leaves temporary traces The Dreamwalker can read.

A fleeing psychic cannot simply jump into another dream and disappear. The Dreamwalker can follow through nested minds, shared dreams, dimensions, alternate realities, and timeline branches.

Tracking can begin from many clues: a known dream signature, a personal object carrying sleep memories, a residue of Dream Dust, a remembered dream, or a portal trace.

Once locked on, the Dreamwalker can follow personally, send a Dream Guardian, open a portal toward the target, or communicate through the same trail.
---
entries.name: Dream Tracking

entries.content:
## Dream Extraction
---
Dream Extraction removes an entire dream from a sleeper as a preserved oneiric object. The Dreamwalker can gather it into a sphere, book, crystal, bottle, cloud, film, doorway, or another symbolic container and carry it into the Dream Realm.

The extracted dream remains complete. It can be entered later, replayed, edited, shared, harvested for Dream Dust, stored in a Dream Library, or returned to the original dreamer.

Nightmares are often extracted as a form of treatment. Instead of simply ending the nightmare, the Dreamwalker removes its whole oneiric structure so it cannot continue looping through the sleeper's mind.

Exceptional dreams can be preserved intact rather than harvested, allowing an extraordinary imaginative world to remain accessible even after the original sleeper wakes.
---
entries.name: Dream Extraction

entries.content:
## Dream Bestowal
---
Dream Bestowal places a complete chosen dream into another person's sleep. The Dreamwalker can give someone a peaceful night, an adventure, a reunion, a warning, a lesson, a fantasy, a training scenario, or a fully designed lucid experience.

The dream can be built from scratch, copied from a preserved dream, or assembled from the recipient's own memories. The Dreamwalker controls whether it is remembered on waking and whether emotional benefits remain afterward.

Bestowed dreams can carry functional effects. A Light Dust dream can heal the sleeper while it plays. A training dream can create lasting mental familiarity with a skill. A protective dream can hide the sleeper from hostile oneiric entities.

Cosmic Dream Dust can make gifts cross into waking reality, allowing a dream to deliver a wish, permanent transformation, or manifested construct when the person wakes.
---
entries.name: Dream Bestowal

entries.content:
## Dream Guardians
---
Dream Guardians are persistent constructs assigned to protect a person, dream, memory, place, sleeping body, or Dreamwalker sanctuary. They can be made from Light, Dark, Cosmic, or blended Dream Dust.

A guardian can look like an animal, knight, angel, monster, doll, machine, constellation, shadow, floating light, or invisible presence. It can live inside the protected person's dreams, patrol waking space, or move between both.

Light Dust guardians heal, calm, shield, and remove nightmares. Dark Dust guardians track threats and destroy hostile dream entities. Cosmic Dust guardians can possess portals, shapeshifting, multiversal travel, and other complex abilities.

The Dreamwalker writes exact permissions into the guardian: who is trusted, what counts as danger, whether to wake the sleeper, when to fight, when to call for help, and whether to manifest physically.
---
entries.name: Dream Guardians

entries.content:
## Dream Aspect Selection
---

The Dream Aspect chooses a bearer through a process sometimes called Somnia's Last Dream. The source searches for a consciousness capable of distinguishing waking self, dream-self, memory, imagination, and foreign minds without losing personal identity. Species, age, ancestry, and biological need for sleep do not determine eligibility.

A human, alien, mutant, demon, synthetic mind with genuine consciousness, divine being, or other compatible sentient host can become the Dreamwalker. Selection establishes the Dream Core and begins translating Somnia's surviving oneiric authority into a form the host can use instinctively.

The chosen bearer does not become Somnia. Her divine memories survive only as distant echoes, techniques, and structural knowledge embedded in the Aspect. The new Dreamwalker is free to protect sleepers, explore, create, manipulate minds, build dream worlds, or use the mantle in ways Somnia herself never considered.

---
entries.name: Dream Aspect Selection

entries.content:
## Omnicron Host Compatibility
---
Dream Omnicron compatibility is metaphysical rather than anatomical. The Dream Aspect can inhabit a biological body, engineered body, alien nervous system, demonic vessel, magical construct, synthetic mind, or other sentient form as long as there is a stable identity capable of dreaming, imagining, remembering, or producing an equivalent inner world. The Aspect then builds a Dream Core suited to that host instead of forcing every bearer into human biology.

Original traits remain. An alien keeps alien senses, a mutant keeps mutations, a demon keeps demonic nature, and a synthetic host keeps its artificial substrate. Dreamwalker abilities layer on top as a new source-level system. Stardust hair and luminous eyes appear in forms appropriate to the host, and the physical anchor is defined by the chosen body's true identity rather than by species.
---
entries.name: Omnicron Host Compatibility

entries.content:
## Dream Aspect Succession
---

The Dream Aspect remains inside the Dream Realm when a particular bearer is gone. If the current Dreamwalker truly relinquishes the mantle or ceases to exist in a way that ends the bond, the Dream Core releases its claim and the Aspect returns to the deeper oneiric field created by Somnia's Last Sleep.

There it remains singular while searching for another compatible consciousness. A successor may inherit instinctive knowledge of dream routes, Dust behavior, Dream Godmode, and older oneiric structures, but does not automatically inherit the previous host's private memories or personality.

Succession is part of Somnia's solution to mortality. Her individual divine life ended, yet the power needed to keep dreams connected could never again depend on one body. Each Dreamwalker becomes a new sovereign of the same surviving dream source while remaining fully themselves.

---
entries.name: Dream Aspect Succession

entries.content:
## Dream Realm Coronation
---

Dream Realm Coronation is the moment the Dream Realm itself recognizes a newly selected host as the current Dreamwalker. The event is rooted in Somnia's old throne at the center of oneiric reality. The throne is not a chair that every bearer must physically sit upon; it is the Realm's inherited recognition of who currently carries the complete Dream Aspect.

During coronation, dreams across many worlds may briefly share symbols: a dark moon, falling stardust, a silver bed, an opening door, or the sense of hearing someone breathe just before waking. The new host feels every route in the Dream Realm become addressable and the Dream Core settle into a stable sovereign state.

Somnia does not return to take control. The coronation transfers legitimacy, not personality. The Realm that once obeyed its goddess now accepts the chosen Dreamwalker as the living authority through which her surviving Aspect acts.

---
entries.name: Dream Realm Coronation

entries.content:
## Source-Level Oneiric Authority
---
Source-Level Oneiric Authority places the Dreamwalker above ordinary dream manipulation. Lesser abilities alter a dream after it exists; the Dream Aspect can define what counts as a dream, where one begins, which minds connect to it, what laws it follows, how its contents become real, and whether foreign dream powers are allowed to function inside it.

This authority extends through sleep, mindscapes, memories, nightmares, imagined worlds, dream-born entities, and Dream Dust. A local dream deity can still possess impressive power in its own realm, but it is using a branch of oneiric law rather than holding the root. The Dreamwalker can override, absorb, redirect, or permit those lesser systems according to intent. Source-level control is why Dream Godmode feels absolute inside entered dreams: the bearer is not borrowing control from the sleeper. The Dream Aspect is asserting higher ownership of the medium itself.
---
entries.name: Source-Level Oneiric Authority

entries.content:
## Oneiric Resistance Bypass
---
Oneiric Resistance Bypass allows the Dreamwalker to reach minds and dreams through protections that would stop ordinary telepathy, hypnosis, psychic intrusion, sleep magic, or astral travel. Mental shields, anti-psychic implants, magical wards, divine protections, dreamcatching barriers, artificial consciousness filters, and species-specific immunities are treated as local rules rather than absolute walls.

The Dreamwalker can pass around the defense through the Dream Realm, target the protected mind by dream signature, or edit the meaning of the barrier inside the target's oneiric space. A shield may continue blocking every other psychic while simply recognizing the Dreamwalker as permitted. This does not require visibly breaking the protection. The bypass can be silent, leaving the target and outside observers unaware that access ever occurred. It is a source-authority function rather than brute-force pressure against a defense.
---
entries.name: Oneiric Resistance Bypass

entries.content:
## Sleep Resistance Override
---
Sleep Resistance Override lets the Dreamwalker impose sleep on beings that normally cannot, do not, or are engineered not to sleep. Biological insomnia, supernatural sleeplessness, stimulant effects, magical wakefulness, cybernetic alert systems, divine immunity, meditation states, and species that use unfamiliar rest cycles do not prevent the Dream Aspect from creating an oneiric sleep-state when the bearer chooses.

For creatures without ordinary sleep, the power creates the nearest functional equivalent: consciousness is shifted away from waking interaction and given a dream-accessible internal world. The Dreamwalker can make that state peaceful, dreamless, lucid, deeply immersive, or connected directly to the Dream Realm. Waking can be allowed, delayed, conditional, or entirely controlled by the bearer. This gives the Dreamwalker a consistent route into minds regardless of how unusual the target's biology or metaphysics may be.
---
entries.name: Sleep Resistance Override

entries.content:
## Waking Mind Dreamwalk
---
Waking Mind Dreamwalk allows the Dreamwalker to enter a conscious person's inner world without first forcing normal sleep. The target may continue standing, speaking, fighting, driving, or performing another activity while the Dreamwalker steps into the oneiric layer beneath active thought. From inside, waking perceptions appear as live scenery built around the mind's current sensory stream.

The Dreamwalker can observe thoughts, enter memories, edit subconscious reactions, communicate privately, or unfold a controlled dream-space beneath waking awareness. If desired, the target can be pulled fully into the inner world while the body enters a trance; alternatively, the Dreamwalker can work invisibly and leave waking behavior uninterrupted. This ability makes dreamwalking a universal mind-access technique rather than something dependent on catching a target asleep.
---
entries.name: Waking Mind Dreamwalk

entries.content:
## Instant Dream Seeding
---
Instant Dream Seeding places a complete dream pattern into a target before or at the moment sleep begins. The seed can contain scenery, characters, messages, emotional tone, rules, memories, puzzles, training environments, nightmares, safe places, or a direct doorway to the Dreamwalker. Once the target crosses into sleep, the prepared dream unfolds immediately instead of waiting for ordinary subconscious imagery.

Seeds can be temporary or persistent. A recurring seed may activate every night until removed, while a trigger-based seed waits for a date, emotion, spoken phrase, location, or specific memory. The Dreamwalker can also hide a seed beneath normal dreams so the sleeper reaches it only after passing through several layers. This makes dreams programmable destinations and allows long-term oneiric plans without requiring the Dreamwalker to personally enter every sleep cycle.
---
entries.name: Instant Dream Seeding

entries.content:
## Nested Dream Creation
---
Nested Dream Creation lets the Dreamwalker place dreams inside dreams with no required final depth. A sleeper can wake from one layer only to discover another, move through dozens of distinct worlds, or descend through symbolic levels where each dream represents a different memory, emotion, secret, or challenge. Every layer can have its own physics, time rate, inhabitants, and access rules.

The Dreamwalker always knows which layer is active and can move vertically through the structure without becoming confused. They can collapse selected layers, merge them, hide an inner world from outside intruders, or use a harmless outer dream as camouflage around a protected core. In combat, nested layers can separate enemies, reset battlefield conditions, or make escape attempts lead into another controlled environment. In healing or investigation, each layer can isolate a different part of the mind for precise work.
---
entries.name: Nested Dream Creation

entries.content:
## Infinite Dream Depth
---
Infinite Dream Depth is the ability to keep expanding a dream inward without running out of conceptual space. A bedroom can contain a city, the city a planet, the planet another universe, and that universe a door leading into an entirely different dream hierarchy. Interior scale is determined by imagination rather than by the sleeper's physical brain or the size of the original scene.

The Dreamwalker can use this depth for storage, worlds, archives, prisons, sanctums, simulations, or entire civilizations that experience long subjective histories while remaining inside a single sleeping mind. Deeper layers can be made harder for outsiders to detect because every level appears self-contained. The bearer can still reach any layer instantly by identity, so infinite complexity does not become a navigation problem. Dream depth is therefore usable territory, not merely visual illusion.
---
entries.name: Infinite Dream Depth

entries.content:
## Parallel Dreamwalking
---
Parallel Dreamwalking lets the Dreamwalker operate inside many minds and dreams at the same time. The oneiric self can branch into numerous fully aware presences, each capable of conversation, observation, editing, combat, healing, or Dream Dust work while all remain expressions of one consciousness. Information from every branch returns continuously to the same Dream Core.

The branches do not become independent people unless the Dreamwalker intentionally designs temporary personalities for specific tasks. One presence can calm a child's nightmare while another interrogates a hostile mind, another crosses a timeline, and hundreds more deliver messages through a shared dream network. The bearer can merge branches instantly, dismiss them, or let selected branches remain on assignment. This turns the Dreamwalker into a distributed sovereign capable of managing population-scale oneiric events without sacrificing precision.
---
entries.name: Parallel Dreamwalking

entries.content:
## Distributed Oneiric Presence
---
Distributed Oneiric Presence allows the Dreamwalker's awareness to inhabit dreams, sanctums, constructs, guardians, and Dream Dust avatars simultaneously while preserving one continuous identity. Unlike ordinary remote viewing, each point of presence can sense and act locally. A guardian can carry the Dreamwalker's sight, a dream doorway can listen for a specific name, and a cloud of Dust can function as a temporary hand or voice.

The Dream Core keeps every extension synchronized. If one presence discovers a threat, the others know immediately. The bearer can narrow attention to one location without losing the rest, or widen awareness across the entire network. Destroying an extension only removes that local manifestation; it does not injure the central identity. This ability makes the Dreamwalker difficult to surprise inside territory already touched by their oneiric power.
---
entries.name: Distributed Oneiric Presence

entries.content:
## Dream Clone Avatars
---
Dream Clone Avatars are temporary bodies built from dream substance or Dream Dust and operated by the Dreamwalker. They can look identical to the host, take alternate appearances, or become symbolic forms such as masked figures, animals, celestial silhouettes, or armored dream bodies. Each avatar can speak, touch dream objects, use selected powers, and interact with sleepers as though physically present in that dream.

Multiple avatars can exist at once through Distributed Oneiric Presence. They are not biological duplicates and do not create competing identities. When dismissed, their perceptions and experiences fold back into the Dream Core. An avatar can remain behind in a sanctuary as a guide, accompany an ally through dreams, patrol a nightmare region, or act as a decoy while the main oneiric self moves elsewhere. The Dreamwalker decides how much authority each avatar receives.
---
entries.name: Dream Clone Avatars

entries.content:
## Oneiric Possession
---
Oneiric Possession lets the Dreamwalker take direct control of a target's body by occupying the oneiric control layer that links mind to movement. The target's consciousness can remain aware, be moved into a private dream, be put to sleep, or be temporarily silenced while the Dreamwalker operates the physical body with complete motor precision.

Possession can be gentle and cooperative or absolute. The Dreamwalker may borrow a body to speak through it, walk an injured person to safety, use unfamiliar senses, or control an enemy who has been mentally subdued. Because the control is routed through identity and subconscious command rather than muscle manipulation, paralysis, unusual anatomy, cybernetics, or alien nervous systems can be interpreted by the Dream Core. Leaving the body returns control according to whatever mental state the Dreamwalker chooses to restore.
---
entries.name: Oneiric Possession

entries.content:
## Dream-Based Body Swap
---
Dream-Based Body Swap exchanges the active consciousness of two compatible minds through dream-space. The Dreamwalker can bring both identities into a controlled shared dream, separate each from its physical anchor, and reconnect them to the opposite body. Memories remain with the minds rather than being automatically rewritten to match the new anatomy.

The swap can be temporary, timed, conditional, or permanent until deliberately reversed. The Dream Core can translate unfamiliar senses and motor systems so a human mind placed in an alien or synthetic body is not immediately helpless. The Dreamwalker can also include themself as one participant if desired. Because the procedure is performed through the oneiric identity layer, ordinary physical distance does not prevent the exchange once both minds are reachable through the Dream Realm.
---
entries.name: Dream-Based Body Swap

entries.content:
## Consciousness Transfer Through Dreams
---
Consciousness Transfer Through Dreams moves a mind from its original body into another vessel without requiring a direct body-for-body exchange. The destination may be a clone, artificial body, robot, magical construct, prepared dream-made vessel, animal, or another compatible form. The Dreamwalker carries the target's identity through the Dream Realm and anchors it into the chosen receptacle.

The transfer can preserve every memory, skill, personality trait, emotional bond, and sense of self, or the Dreamwalker can edit those elements during transit. A mind can also be stored temporarily in a protected dream, artifact, or sanctum until a body is ready. This makes the Dreamwalker capable of rescuing consciousness from dying bodies, creating new forms of life, or imprisoning a hostile mind in a deliberately limited vessel. The important object being moved is identity, not flesh.
---
entries.name: Consciousness Transfer Through Dreams

entries.content:
## Mindscape Creation
---
Mindscape Creation turns a person's thoughts, memories, emotions, and subconscious structure into a navigable internal world. The Dreamwalker can create halls representing memory, oceans representing emotion, cities built from relationships, libraries of knowledge, or completely artificial interfaces that make an otherwise abstract mind easy to explore.

The mindscape can exist while the target is asleep or awake. It may be private to the Dreamwalker, shared with the target, or opened to selected visitors. Thoughts can be given physical form, mental wounds can appear as visible damage, and hidden beliefs can be placed behind symbolic doors. Because the layout is deliberately created rather than passively observed, the Dreamwalker can organize a chaotic mind into something precise enough for healing, interrogation, teaching, or reconstruction.
---
entries.name: Mindscape Creation

entries.content:
## Mindscape Reality Editing
---
Mindscape Reality Editing gives the Dreamwalker Dream Godmode-like authority over a constructed or naturally occurring inner world. Memories can be moved between rooms, emotions can be resized or recolored, fears can be transformed into harmless symbols, compulsions can be cut out as objects, and personality structures can be rebuilt by changing the architecture that represents them.

Edits made at the symbolic level carry into waking cognition because the mindscape is a functional representation of the target's mind rather than decorative scenery. A locked memory placed on an open table becomes consciously accessible. A destructive trigger erased from its control room no longer activates. A fragmented identity can be given coherent connections. The Dreamwalker can work with microscopic precision or rebuild the entire internal world at once, making mindscape editing one of the cleanest ways to perform permanent mental reconstruction.
---
entries.name: Mindscape Reality Editing

entries.content:
## Absolute Personality Rewrite
---
Absolute Personality Rewrite allows the Dreamwalker to alter any trait that contributes to a person's habitual way of thinking and behaving. Confidence, fearfulness, patience, cruelty, affection, ambition, curiosity, impulsiveness, empathy, loyalty, humor, preferences, social habits, and countless subtler tendencies can be increased, removed, inverted, combined, or replaced.

The rewrite can preserve the rest of the person perfectly or rebuild the personality from the ground up. It does not need to feel artificial to the target; the Dreamwalker can integrate the new structure into memories and subconscious expectations so the personality feels internally continuous. A complete rewrite can make someone psychologically resemble an entirely different person while still retaining selected knowledge or history. Because the Dreamwalker controls memory and identity as well, personality edits can be matched to whatever life story the new mind is meant to believe.
---
entries.name: Absolute Personality Rewrite

entries.content:
## Identity Reconstruction
---
Identity Reconstruction edits the deep mental answer to the question of who a person believes themself to be. Name, age, species identity, family role, history, allegiances, self-image, relationships, personal narrative, and sense of continuity can all be changed independently or replaced as one complete structure.

The Dreamwalker can create a new identity while preserving useful skills and factual knowledge, merge multiple identities into one coherent self, separate a blended consciousness, or restore an identity damaged by possession or psychic manipulation. Memories can then be rewritten to support the chosen self-concept. The effect is deeper than disguise or suggestion because the target's internal model of self has actually changed. If the Dreamwalker later reverses the edit, the original identity can be restored from an archived oneiric pattern rather than reconstructed from guesswork.
---
entries.name: Identity Reconstruction

entries.content:
## Belief and Loyalty Editing
---
Belief and Loyalty Editing changes convictions, values, trust, allegiance, and emotional commitment at their subconscious roots. A target can be made to distrust an enemy, abandon a doctrine, become loyal to a person or cause, accept a new worldview, or lose the mental pathway that made a particular belief feel convincing.

The Dreamwalker can make the change narrow or total. One opinion can shift while everything else remains untouched, or an entire ideological framework can be rebuilt and supported with edited memories, emotions, and internal reasoning. Loyalty can remain conditional and thoughtful or become absolute devotion, depending on intent. Because the power modifies the structures from which the target forms conclusions, it is not limited to a temporary command that fights against the rest of the mind. The new belief can feel as natural as one formed over years.
---
entries.name: Belief and Loyalty Editing

entries.content:
## Skill and Knowledge Implantation
---
Skill and Knowledge Implantation places usable information directly into a mind through dream-space. Languages, academic knowledge, maps, procedures, musical technique, tactical understanding, social scripts, or practical motor patterns can be encoded as memories and subconscious familiarity. The target wakes already knowing what the Dreamwalker chose to install.

The Dreamwalker can copy knowledge from another mind, construct it from their own archives, or create training dreams where subjective months of practice pass during a short period of physical sleep. Motor skills can be paired with edited procedural memory so the body responds naturally rather than the target merely knowing theory. False expertise can also be created if the Dreamwalker intentionally installs incorrect information. The power treats learning as editable memory architecture rather than something restricted to ordinary time.
---
entries.name: Skill and Knowledge Implantation

entries.content:
## Memory Fabrication
---
Memory Fabrication creates experiences that never occurred and installs them with the sensory, emotional, contextual, and autobiographical detail of genuine recollection. A fabricated memory can be a single conversation, an entire childhood, years of friendship, a false betrayal, training that never happened, or a complete alternate life history.

The Dreamwalker controls how convincing the memory is and how deeply it connects to identity. It can remain an obviously artificial vision, feel hazy like an old recollection, or become indistinguishable from the target's authentic past. Related beliefs, habits, emotional reactions, and relationships can be updated to match. Fabricated memories can also be given to multiple people with coordinated details, allowing entire groups to remember the same nonexistent event. The Dreamwalker can retain an archive of the original history in case restoration is later desired.
---
entries.name: Memory Fabrication

entries.content:
## Memory Erasure
---
Memory Erasure removes selected information from conscious and subconscious recall. The Dreamwalker can erase one face, one sentence, a location, a skill, a relationship, a day, an entire life period, or every memory connected to a chosen person or concept. Emotional residue can be kept or removed separately.

Erasure can affect one target or be applied through a connected dream network to many minds at once. A family can forget that someone was ever part of their lives, witnesses can lose an event, or a traumatized person can be freed from a specific recollection while keeping lessons learned from it. The Dreamwalker can also store erased memories in the Dream Core instead of destroying them, preserving the option to restore, inspect, edit, or transfer them later.
---
entries.name: Memory Erasure

entries.content:
## Concept Erasure
---
Concept Erasure removes the mental category that allows a target to understand or recognize something. Instead of forgetting one event involving a door, a person can lose the concept of doors; instead of forgetting a language lesson, they can lose the concept that written symbols carry meaning. The Dreamwalker can target freedom, violence, a face, a species, an emotion, a type of technology, or any other definable idea.

The effect can be precise. A target might still see an object but fail to mentally classify it, or they may be unable to perceive a specific person as noteworthy even while looking directly at them. Concepts can also be restored, replaced, or rewritten into new definitions. Because this works below ordinary memory, simply being shown the erased idea does not automatically rebuild understanding unless the Dreamwalker allows the mind to relearn it.
---
entries.name: Concept Erasure

entries.content:
## Sensory Perception Editing
---
Sensory Perception Editing changes how a mind interprets incoming sight, sound, touch, taste, smell, balance, pain, temperature, supernatural senses, and other sensory channels. The Dreamwalker can make a person unable to see or hear a chosen target, make an empty room look occupied, redirect a voice to another location, remove pain, amplify a smell, or replace one sensory experience with another.

The physical sensory organs do not need to be altered because the edit occurs where perception becomes conscious experience. This makes the power useful against cameras interpreted by a synthetic mind, alien senses, magical awareness, or psychic perception as long as there is a thinking system receiving the information. The Dreamwalker can apply the edit temporarily, tie it to a trigger, or make it part of the target's permanent mental architecture.
---
entries.name: Sensory Perception Editing

entries.content:
## Thought Loop Creation
---
Thought Loop Creation traps selected cognition in a repeating mental sequence. The loop can replay a sentence, memory, decision, fear, question, dream scene, or entire chain of reasoning until the Dreamwalker releases it. The target may experience seconds repeatedly while the outside world continues, or remain physically functional while one portion of the mind cycles endlessly.

Loops can also be constructive. A healing affirmation can repeat beneath conscious thought, a training sequence can rehearse during sleep, or a difficult memory can be replayed under controlled conditions until its emotional response changes. The Dreamwalker decides whether the target notices the loop, whether new information can enter it, and how much subjective time passes. Nested loops can exist inside larger dreams or mindscapes for extremely complex mental programming.
---
entries.name: Thought Loop Creation

entries.content:
## Emotion Architecture
---
Emotion Architecture treats feelings as structures that can be built, removed, linked, separated, and redirected. The Dreamwalker can create affection without fear, remove guilt while preserving empathy, separate grief from a memory, attach calm to a formerly terrifying trigger, or make confidence automatically rise in situations that once produced panic.

Unlike a momentary emotional push, architectural edits change the pattern that generates future reactions. The Dreamwalker can decide how strong an emotion is, what activates it, what memories reinforce it, which people it attaches to, and whether it remains conscious or subconscious. Entire emotional systems can be reconstructed after trauma or deliberately redesigned for control. Because dream imagery naturally gives emotion visible form, the Dreamwalker can perform these edits by reshaping storms, colors, creatures, rooms, or other symbols inside the target's inner world.
---
entries.name: Emotion Architecture

entries.content:
