Typical uses include hide as an office chair during a meeting; become a cable behind a computer; slip a finger under a door to read papers by touch; turn into a wall poster near a target.

---
entries.name: Infiltration Forms

entries.content:
##Nonlethal Capture Forms
---

The restraint style focused on stopping targets without crushing, cutting, or suffocating them.

The body forms padded cuffs, elastic nets, soft cages, weighted blankets, immobilizing sleeves, or limb-separating loops. Weapons can be peeled away, hands separated, mouths blocked gently, and feet lifted off the ground to stop charging. Captured people can breathe, speak if allowed, and remain upright or cushioned while movement is denied.

The user can scale restraint by strength, panic level, injury risk, and whether the target is human, superhuman, monstrous, or fragile. Typical uses include wrap a knife hand without cutting it; hold a speedster by surrounding the legs; cocoon a berserker in padded bands; separate two fighters with elastic walls.

---
entries.name: Nonlethal Capture Forms

entries.content:
##Animal and Creature Forms
---

The ability to take animal-like and creature-like shapes for function rather than biological imitation.

The user may become a snake for crawling, bird-like glider, octopus for many limbs, spider-like climber, fish-like swimmer, or huge beast silhouette. Objects can be carried in tentacles, wrapped by coils, swept by tails, or shielded under wings. People respond to a physical creature shape that can act with chosen softness or strength rather than real animal instincts.

The user does not need actual animal organs unless desired; the form is a malleable tool shaped like a creature. Typical uses include become an octopus to rescue swimmers; turn into a giant snake bridge; use spider legs to climb rubble; make wing shapes to glide silently.

---
entries.name: Animal and Creature Forms

entries.content:
##Crowd Control Shapes
---

Large-scale forms designed to guide, separate, shelter, or immobilize groups.

The user becomes railings, lanes, soft barricades, walls, nets, warning shapes, cushion fields, or moving fences. Objects like debris, signs, cars, and furniture can be separated from people by body-made partitions. Crowds can be redirected without trampling, protected from hazards, or stopped from entering unsafe zones.

The user can open passages for permitted people while closing or softening others based on the situation. Typical uses include form lanes during an evacuation; become a wall between crowds and fire; catch multiple falling people with a huge net; make a soft maze that funnels enemies into one area.

---
entries.name: Crowd Control Shapes

entries.content:
##Comfort and Daily Utility
---

The ordinary practical side of infinite malleability used for comfort, convenience, and harmless problem solving.

The body becomes pillows, blankets, chairs, cushions, umbrellas, shelves, bags, toys, writing surfaces, or extra hands. Objects can be held, sorted, carried, protected, hung, dried, or propped up without tools. People may sit, lean, nap, ride, or shelter on the user if the user allows it.

The user controls temperature feel, softness, height, shape, and whether a comfort form stays still or moves with the person. Typical uses include become a couch for friends; make an umbrella in rain; turn a hand into a cup holder; form a blanket during a cold night.

---
entries.name: Comfort and Daily Utility

entries.content:
##Emergency Response Uses
---

The application of many malleable forms during disasters, crashes, fires, collapses, floods, and accidents.

The user may become stretchers, rafts, nets, barriers, splints, smoke seals, bridges, ladders, airbags, and protective shells in rapid sequence. Debris can be lifted, separated, cushioned, marked, or held while victims are removed. People are carried, shielded, immobilized, warmed, ventilated, or guided away by living tools that adapt instantly.

The user can fill missing infrastructure, reach through rubble, and reform around hazards without waiting for equipment. Typical uses include become a bridge over floodwater; turn into a stretcher and oxygen tube; seal smoke under a door; catch people jumping from a burning building.

---
entries.name: Emergency Response Uses

entries.content:
##Precision Force Control
---

The ability to apply exact amounts of pressure, tension, support, softness, hardness, and movement.

The body does not simply stretch wildly; it presses, cradles, wedges, lifts, squeezes, pulls, or releases at chosen intensity. Fragile objects can be held without cracking, heavy objects can be moved without dents, and machines can be adjusted with perfect touch. People can be restrained without injury, supported without discomfort, or caught without whiplash.

The user regulates force across many body sections independently, making one finger delicate while another arm holds tons of load. Typical uses include hold an egg and a car at the same time; tighten a bandage just enough; open a rusted door without breaking it; catch a baby bird with a giant hand.

---
entries.name: Precision Force Control

entries.content:
##Malleable Identity Control
---

The memory-like control system that lets the user store preferred bodies, disguises, object forms, and emergency shapes.

Forms can be recalled instantly like body presets, each with exact height, face, texture, voice, density, and movement style. Objects and tools previously copied by shape can be remembered and recreated more accurately later. People who know the user may recognize certain signature forms even when the actual body is wildly different.

The user does not lose themself in forms because every shape is a chosen expression controlled by the same awareness. Typical uses include save a favorite human appearance; recall the exact shape of a copied key; return to a battle form instantly; maintain a harmless public form while hiding combat capability.

---
entries.name: Malleable Identity Control

entries.content:
##Form-Based Skill Imitation
---

The ability to reproduce physical skills by reshaping the body to perform the required motion perfectly.

Hands become ideal instrument shapes, legs form perfect springs, balance shifts instantly, and limbs copy practiced arcs. Tools, sports equipment, instruments, vehicles, and weapons can be operated by adapting body shape to them. People may see expert-looking motion because the body creates the needed leverage, reach, grip, and flexibility.

The user still benefits from knowledge and observation, but the body can compensate for normal training limits by becoming the right shape. Typical uses include form perfect piano fingers; copy a gymnast’s movement with elastic joints; make a baseball-bat arm with ideal swing path; hold a paintbrush with many micro-adjusting fingers.

---
entries.name: Form-Based Skill Imitation

entries.content:
##Biological Mimic Forms
---

The ability to simulate biological features without being limited to normal biology.

The user can form lungs, gills, eyes, ears, muscles, bones, fur, claws, wings, tails, or organs as functional shapes if useful. Medical scanners, touch, or casual inspection may detect convincing structures depending on how detailed the user chooses to be. People can interact with simulated features as real physical parts, even if they are temporary malleable constructs.

The user can drop or rearrange any simulated biology instantly and is not trapped by the needs of the copied structure. Typical uses include grow gill-like filters underwater; make fake bones for an x-ray disguise; create claws for climbing; simulate a heartbeat during a medical check.

---
entries.name: Biological Mimic Forms

entries.content:
##Body Language and Expression Control
---

The fine disguise skill of controlling every expression, posture, gesture, blink, wrinkle, and motion cue.

The face can smile with exact muscle placement, shoulders can mimic age or fatigue, and skin can show blush, scars, tension, or calm. Objects like badges, wrinkles in clothing, or worn shoes can be body-simulated to support the presentation. People reading the user see controlled emotions and physical cues unless they have a power that reads deeper than body behavior.

The user can make one part perform a distraction while another part works secretly out of sight. Typical uses include fake limping convincingly; smile with another person’s exact expression; make the body appear exhausted while fully alert; hide stretching behind normal gestures.

---
entries.name: Body Language and Expression Control

entries.content:
##Scanner and Biometric Spoofing
---

The use of exact body shaping to fool physical scanners that read shape, texture, pressure, or visible anatomy.

Fingertips form matching prints, eyes reshape into retina-like patterns, faces match geometry, and skin texture copies required contact details. Doors, phones, locks, cameras, fingerprint pads, palm readers, and face scanners can be given the physical pattern they expect. Security personnel may see a perfect match because the body is actually taking the needed shape at the surface level.

The user can combine this with voice molding, disguise morphing, and texture control for layered access. Typical uses include copy a fingerprint from a lifted print shape; make an eye look correct for a scanner; pass a face ID camera; turn a palm into the right hand shape for a reader.

---
entries.name: Scanner and Biometric Spoofing

entries.content:
##Body as Portal-Like Passage
---

The ability to become a safe passage, tube, slide, tunnel, chute, or conduit between spaces.

The body forms hollow corridors with soft walls, gripping floors, air flow, light gaps, or smooth sliding surfaces. Objects can be passed through the user from one side to another, sorted through branching tubes, or kept safe during transit. People can crawl, slide, or be carried through the body without being harmed if permission and space are provided.

The user controls direction, exit points, speed, diameter, and whether the passage is open, sealed, hidden, or guarded. Typical uses include make a tunnel under rubble; pass supplies through a wall gap using a body tube; become an emergency slide; form a hidden crawlspace through a locked fence.

---
entries.name: Body as Portal-Like Passage

entries.content:
##Arena-Sized Body Control
---

The no-limit scale expression where the user spreads across very large areas as a single controlled body.

Streets become body surfaces, buildings are bridged by limbs, blocks are surrounded by walls, and skies fill with nets or shields. Vehicles, debris, signs, weapons, and crowds can be separated into safe lanes or contained inside vast forms. People may experience the user as the environment itself: floors, walls, ramps, hands, nets, and doors all alive and responsive.

The user’s awareness expands with the form, letting distant surfaces react without waiting for the central body to move. Typical uses include cover a stadium as a dome; turn a city street into a padded evacuation path; wrap a collapsing building; become a giant maze across a battlefield.

---
entries.name: Arena-Sized Body Control

entries.content:
##No-Limit Shape Imagination
---

The ultimate rule of infinite malleability: any body shape the user can define can be physically expressed. This is the clearest expression of source-level malleability: imagination defines the desired body and the Aspect supplies a physically coherent way for that body to exist.

Forms can be practical, absurd, monstrous, beautiful, tiny, enormous, mechanical, living, flat, hollow, layered, divided, or impossible-looking. Objects become references rather than limits; the user can imitate them, improve them, merge them, or become a version that works better for the moment. People facing the power cannot rely on a stable target, fixed anatomy, fixed size, fixed movement style, or predictable combat role.

The user’s imagination decides the form, while perfect body control decides the execution and safe return. Typical uses include become a giant hand with eyes on every finger; turn into a rolling fortress-ball; make a living staircase with talking railings; reshape into a harmless toy then unfold into a building-sized shield.

---
entries.name: No-Limit Shape Imagination

entries.content:
##Living Plastic Physiology
---

The body is not ordinary flesh with stretching added on top; it is a living, self-aware, polymer-like malleable substance that can behave like skin, rubber, gel, fluid, muscle, cloth, armor, or tool material while still being one continuous body. This physiology keeps the user alive and functional without needing fixed bones, organs, veins, nerves, or stable proportions. Every part of the body is usable material, and every part can become surface, limb, mouth, eye, tool, storage space, disguise, shield, vehicle shape, or sensory tissue. The body has perfect shape memory, so any chosen form can be restored instantly after deformation. Living Plastic Physiology describes the substance created when the Self-Form Aspect rewrites a host into a Shapeshifter Omnicron. It resembles living elastic matter but remains biological, supernatural and self-aware rather than being literal manufactured plastic. The body reshapes as a single obedient material rather than as separate organs dragging each other around. Limbs may stretch like bands, the torso may fold like rubber fabric, the face may melt into a smooth surface, and the skin may become glossy, matte, flesh-like, or plastic-smooth depending on need.

---
entries.name: Living Plastic Physiology

entries.content:
##Organless Functional Anatomy
---

Organless functional anatomy means the user does not require fixed internal organs arranged in normal human positions. The body can imitate a heart, lungs, stomach, veins, bones, muscles, and brain for appearance or convenience, but survival does not depend on those parts remaining intact. Function is distributed through the living malleable substance itself. A head can flatten, the chest can hollow out, the torso can become a tube, and the limbs can detach into long bands without killing or disabling the user. The interior is a configurable living medium rather than a permanent arrangement of organs. Organs can be simulated when useful, moved elsewhere, duplicated, reduced or omitted entirely. When this aspect is active, internal structure shifts like layered elastic material rather than a rigid skeleton wrapped in flesh. The chest may open into storage, the abdomen may become a hollow compartment, the head may become featureless, or the entire body may thin into a curtain while still speaking and sensing. If cut open, the inside does not have to show gore; it can show smooth colored material, folded elastic layers, or featureless living plastic. Objects can pass through temporary channels that would be impossible in ordinary anatomy.

---
entries.name: Organless Functional Anatomy

entries.content:
##Distributed Body Consciousness
---

Distributed body consciousness means the user’s awareness is not locked inside a single brain-shaped organ. The mind can operate through the entire malleable body, through any connected portion, and through shaped extensions that remain part of the body. A stretched finger, puddle trail, detached-looking sheet, or body-made tool can all carry perception and control if the user keeps them connected or intentionally maintains continuity. This prevents decapitation, head damage, flattening, or body distortion from disabling thought. Thought and selfhood are distributed through the living malleable substance, preventing one fixed brain location from being the sole seat of consciousness. The body may still keep a normal head and face for conversation, but that head is not the only seat of awareness. When stretched across a room, the user may seem to perceive from every contact point at once. A tendril touching a wall can feel vibration; a flattened sheet under a door can sense footsteps; a hand extended around a corner can inspect a room with touch and shaped eyes. Objects in contact with the body can be sensed by pressure, texture, vibration, shape, temperature-feel, movement, and resistance.

---
entries.name: Distributed Body Consciousness

entries.content:
##Ageless Immortality
---

Ageless immortality is the long-term survival trait of Infinite Malleability. The user’s body does not age normally because the malleable physiology can maintain, renew, and restore its chosen structure indefinitely. Wrinkles, cellular decay, organ failure, brittle bones, disease-based breakdown, and age-related weakness are not forced on a body that can continuously redefine its own shape and internal condition. The user can keep any preferred apparent age, body type, face, and health state for as long as desired. Ageless immortality follows from the Aspect’s refusal to let time permanently impose an unwanted bodily configuration on its bearer. The power appears as permanent freshness of form. The user may look exactly the same across decades, centuries, or longer, or may change apparent age as a disguise. Hair color, skin texture, posture, height, build, and facial details can shift, but those changes are chosen presentation rather than biological decline. If the user appears older or younger, the body is sculpting that look. Objects are affected indirectly because the immortal body can outlast normal gear, become replacement equipment, preserve belongings inside itself, or rebuild tools from body-shaped equivalents over extremely long periods.

---
entries.name: Ageless Immortality

entries.content:
##No Nutritional Requirement
---

No nutritional requirement means the user does not need ordinary food, water, calories, vitamins, digestion, or metabolism to remain alive. Infinite Malleability sustains itself through its own impossible living structure rather than through normal biological consumption. Eating can still happen for taste, habit, disguise, social comfort, storage, or deliberate conversion of swallowed matter, but starvation does not weaken the power or threaten survival by default. Food can still be eaten for taste, habit or social reasons, but the Shapeshifter Omnicron does not require calories, vitamins or ordinary digestion to remain alive. The body can look and act like it eats normally: chewing, swallowing, drinking, enjoying flavor, filling a stomach, or pretending to digest. It can also skip all of that. The mouth may close forever, vanish entirely, become decorative, or open anywhere on the body when eating is useful. A flat form, tool form, or liquid form does not need a digestive tract to stay alive. Objects that would be food can be consumed, stored, hidden, dissolved, carried, or expelled later without requiring normal digestion.

---
entries.name: No Nutritional Requirement

entries.content:
##Bottomless Stomach Storage
---

Bottomless stomach storage is the ability to create internal storage space inside the malleable body that behaves like a safe living compartment rather than a normal stomach. The user can swallow, absorb, fold around, or open a mouth-like entrance for objects and keep them suspended inside body-made pockets. The storage does not have to follow normal organ size. It can expand, compress, subdivide, label, seal, or move around inside the body without making the outside body look larger unless the user wants it to. The stomach can be expanded into a controlled internal storage chamber whose usable capacity is not limited by the bearer’s visible body size. It appears as the user swallowing impossible amounts, opening a harmless pouch in the abdomen, stretching the mouth into a bag-like entrance, or letting objects sink into the body’s surface as if the skin became soft storage. The outside can remain flat and normal, bulge comically, become transparent, or form labeled pocket shapes depending on the chosen style. Objects inside the storage can be protected from impact, separated from each other, wrapped in soft lining, held in fixed positions, hidden from view, or retrieved from any chosen opening.

---
entries.name: Bottomless Stomach Storage

entries.content:
##Recreational Eating and Taste
---

Recreational eating is the optional version of eating used for pleasure, disguise, curiosity, texture, or social participation. Since the user does not need food to survive, eating becomes a chosen sensory act. The body can create taste buds, teeth, tongue shapes, saliva-like fluid, throat passages, and stomach space whenever it wants to enjoy food, then remove or repurpose those structures afterward. It appears normal when desired: chewing, swallowing, sipping, licking, tasting, or reacting to flavor. It can also look surreal, with a hand opening a small mouth to sample something, a long tongue tasting from across the room, or the torso forming a temporary snack pouch. The user can eat without mess by shaping perfect lips, filters, drains, and compartments. Food objects can be tasted without consumed matter becoming a problem. The user can dissolve it, store it, separate flavor from substance, spit it out unchanged, or convert it into harmless body-held material. Dishes, utensils, wrappers, and drinks can be handled by body-made tools while the user maintains any form. People see the user eating and may assume ordinary needs. A disguised user can blend into dinner, restaurants, parties, kitchens, or family routines by performing normal eating.

---
entries.name: Recreational Eating and Taste

entries.content:
##Digestive Neutralization
---

Digestive neutralization lets the user make swallowed or absorbed substances harmless by isolating, diluting, reshaping around, sealing, or breaking them down inside malleable compartments. Poison, acid, spoiled food, glass, metal fragments, drugs, toxins, parasites, and contaminated liquids do not automatically enter a bloodstream or damage organs because the user does not depend on normal digestive anatomy. The body decides what contact means. The process may appear as a swallowed item sinking into a smooth internal pouch, a glowing or color-changing compartment forming under the skin, or a harmless bulge that shrinks as the material is neutralized. The user can keep the outside appearance normal while intense internal processing happens behind sealed elastic layers. Objects and substances can be separated into harmless parts, trapped inside thick lining, spat back out unchanged, or stored for later analysis. Acid can be held in acid-proof living plastic, poison can be sealed away from active tissue, sharp fragments can be suspended in gel, and unstable material can be wrapped in layers that absorb pressure and leakage. People cannot rely on poisoning, forced feeding, drugging, or corrosive ingestion as normal attacks. A poisoned drink may simply be sorted into a sealed pocket. A swallowed tracker may be isolated and removed.

---
entries.name: Digestive Neutralization

entries.content:
##Infinite Internal Volume
---

Infinite internal volume is the expansion of the body’s inside without requiring the outside to grow in matching proportion. The user can create deep pockets, corridors, chambers, tubes, layered folds, storage wells, safe rooms, or passageways within the malleable body. This is not a normal biological cavity; it is body-controlled space made from endlessly folding living material. The outside may look like a person, backpack, wall, puddle, coat, vehicle, or small object while the inside holds far more than the shape suggests. Internal volume is treated as another editable property of form, allowing chambers and storage spaces far larger than the external silhouette would suggest. It appears as impossible depth. A hand may open like a pouch and accept an object larger than the forearm. A mouth may swallow a long pole without the body bulging. A torso may unzip into a soft room. A flat sheet may contain layers folded into itself like an endless elastic pocket. The opening can look comedic, subtle, monstrous, or completely normal. Objects can be stored, sorted, hidden, cushioned, transported, or protected in internal spaces. The user can create shelves, straps, soft cells, sealed capsules, fluid tanks, document pockets, weapon sheaths, or temperature-insulated compartments.

---
entries.name: Infinite Internal Volume

entries.content:
##Shape-Memory Restoration
---

Shape-memory restoration is the built-in ability to return from any distortion, disguise, injury-like deformation, stretched state, flattened state, liquid flow, compression, expansion, or complex shape into a chosen form. The body remembers every preferred shape because the entire malleable physiology is self-directed. Restoration can return the user to a default appearance, a saved disguise, a combat form, an object shape, a tiny form, or any other stored configuration. It appears as matter snapping, flowing, rolling, folding, or smoothing back into place. A flattened body may peel upward into a standing figure. A puddle may rise into limbs. A torn-looking strand may pull itself back into a hand. A dent from a punch may vanish like elastic rebounding. The restoration can be instant, slow, dramatic, subtle, or deliberately comedic. Objects wrapped or stored by the body can be released during restoration, carried along, or kept inside compartments. If the user had become a bridge, the bridge can retract after everyone crosses. If the user had formed armor around someone, the armor can peel away without catching clothing. If the body was a tool, it can return while leaving the manipulated object in place. People watching restoration see that damage is not permanent injury.

---
entries.name: Shape-Memory Restoration

entries.content:
##Fragment Survival
---

Fragment survival means separated, severed, shattered, sliced, or scattered pieces of the body are not automatically dead tissue. If the user is divided into pieces, those pieces remain part of the malleable whole and can survive, move, sense, hide, crawl, stretch, liquefy, or flow back together. The body does not depend on one continuous human-shaped mass to remain alive. Any surviving fragment can function as viable bearer-material and can act as the seed from which the whole body is reconstructed. It appears as pieces behaving like living elastic material rather than gore. A cut strip may wriggle like a ribbon. A flattened slice may slide under furniture. A severed hand may crawl back. Droplets from a liquid form may gather into a puddle. Small fragments may stretch toward each other with threadlike connections, then merge smoothly. Objects can be carried by fragments, tagged with tiny body pieces, or manipulated from multiple locations. A small piece can hide inside a lock, cling to a vehicle, wrap around a key, plug a leak, or act as a remote sensory patch. Fragments can rejoin with stored objects or leave objects behind as needed. People cannot assume cutting, chopping, shattering, or scattering the user ends the fight.

---
entries.name: Fragment Survival

entries.content:
##Elastic Nervous System
---

The elastic nervous system is the sensory-control structure that lets the user feel, move, and coordinate forms that have no normal nerve layout. Sensation can be sent through stretched arms, flat sheets, liquid strands, tiny fragments, giant forms, hollow tubes, and object-shaped bodies without delay or confusion. The body can create, move, multiply, or silence sensory zones wherever they are useful. It appears through controlled reaction. A mile-long arm can still handle a pin. A flat rug-form can feel every footstep. A giant shield-body can know where each impact lands. A liquid puddle can sense ripples across its surface. The user may form extra eyes, ears, pressure pads, taste surfaces, or vibration membranes anywhere on the body. Objects in contact with the user can be mapped by touch. The body can sense a key’s teeth by wrapping it, read raised lettering through a fingertip, feel machinery vibrations, detect pressure changes, and distinguish fragile from sturdy materials. Tools grown from the body remain precise because sensation extends into them. People touching the user can be located, identified by pressure pattern, held gently, or restrained without injury. Unpermitted people cannot numb the user by attacking one nerve cluster because sensation is not confined to normal nerves.

---
entries.name: Elastic Nervous System

entries.content:
##Bloodless Malleable Interior
---

Bloodless malleable interior means the user does not need ordinary blood circulation to live. The body can imitate blood for disguise, drama, or medical deception, but true function comes from the living malleable substance itself. Cuts, punctures, tears, and flattened sections do not automatically bleed out, lose pressure, or shut down. The inside can be smooth elastic matter, colored gel, self-sealing plastic, or any chosen texture. It appears differently depending on presentation. A wound may show no blood at all, only rubbery layers pulling closed. It may ooze harmless colored material. It may bleed convincingly for disguise and then stop instantly. The body may open a cut like a mouth, wrap around the weapon, or simply flow back together. Objects that cut into the body can be gripped by the interior, trapped, pushed out, cushioned, or stored. A blade may slide through a harmless channel. A bullet may be caught in thick gel. A needle may enter a fake vein if the user wants to pass medical tests. Blood samples can be fabricated as body-made fluid rather than actual vulnerability. People cannot rely on blood loss, vein damage, blood poisoning, choking off circulation, or heart stopping.

---
entries.name: Bloodless Malleable Interior

entries.content:
##Body-Made Tools
---

Body-made tools are functional shapes grown directly from the malleable body. The user can turn fingers, hands, arms, hair, tongue, torso, or any surface into screwdrivers, hooks, keys, crowbars, clamps, scissors, blades, hammers, brushes, needles, cups, funnels, wheels, springs, syringes, ropes, nets, grips, or complex tool clusters. These are physical body structures, not illusions or conjured items. The transformation appears as body material thinning, hardening, splitting, sharpening, curling, or forming exact mechanical profiles. A fingertip can become a flathead screwdriver. The whole hand can unfold into a toolkit. The arm can become a ladder, winch, crane, or long flexible grabber. Texture can shift from skin-soft to metal-hard while remaining living malleable material. Objects can be repaired, opened, braced, cut, measured, carried, poured, locked, unlocked, sealed, or assembled without external equipment. The body can match screws, keyways, gaps, bolt heads, hinges, and delicate mechanisms. A tool can be soft where it contacts fragile material and hard where force is needed. People can be assisted or restrained by tool-forms. A body-made stretcher can carry someone. A clamp can hold a wound closed. A cage of flexible bars can trap an attacker.

---
entries.name: Body-Made Tools

entries.content:
##Object Form Emulation
---

Object form emulation lets the user become the physical shape and surface behavior of nonliving objects without ceasing to be alive. They can become a chair, table, lamp, phone casing, suitcase, carpet, tire, sign, coat rack, door, box, statue, vending machine shape, bridge, parachute, or any other object-like form. The emulation can be decorative, functional, deceptive, protective, or mobile. It appears as the body folding into the outline, texture, color, and rigidity of the chosen object. A chair-form can have legs, seat, back, and cushion feel. A carpet-form can lie flat with fabric-like texture. A box-form can open and close. A tire-form can roll. A statue-form can be hard and motionless until the user moves. Objects nearby can be replaced, hidden, protected, or supported by the user taking their role. The user can become missing furniture, a fake wall panel, a cover over evidence, a living container, a replacement wheel, or a temporary bridge. The body can also wrap around real objects to make them appear larger, different, or hidden inside the emulated shape. People interact with the object-form as if it is real. They may sit on the chair, step on the rug, open the suitcase, lean against the wall, or carry the box.

---
entries.name: Object Form Emulation

entries.content:
##Integrated Clothing Form
---

Integrated clothing form is the ability to create clothing-like surfaces as part of the body itself. The user can appear dressed while the outfit is actually malleable body material shaped into fabric, seams, buttons, zippers, shoes, gloves, hats, armor, uniforms, dresses, coats, or accessories. The clothing can stretch, flatten, harden, flow, hide storage, or transform with the body because it is not separate clothing unless the user chooses to wear real clothing over it. It appears as fabric forming from the skin, colors sliding into patterns, collars rising out of shoulders, shoes shaping around feet, gloves extending from hands, or armor plates smoothing into casual cloth. The texture can feel like cotton, denim, leather, silk, rubber, plastic, metal, or normal skin depending on the chosen surface. Objects can be hidden in body-made pockets, loops, holsters, hems, cuffs, or hollow accessories. The user can create a backpack, purse, belt pouch, sleeve compartment, or hidden sheath without carrying separate gear. The outfit can protect items from impact and release them from any seam. People see a complete outfit that moves naturally and can pass as normal clothing.

---
entries.name: Integrated Clothing Form

entries.content:
##Total Invulnerability by Deformation
---

Total invulnerability by deformation is the defensive principle that attacks fail because the body does not hold a vulnerable shape. Instead of resisting every hit like rigid armor, the body can stretch, dent, flatten, flow, split, bounce, absorb, harden, soften, or open around the attack. The user is not protected by one method; they are protected by the ability to become the method that makes the attack useless. The body avoids damage by changing the meaning of impact: instead of remaining a fixed target that must withstand force, it deforms, opens, flows, spreads or rebounds around the event. It appears as bullets sinking into rubbery dents, blades passing through harmless channels, punches rebounding from springy surfaces, crushing force spreading across a huge flattened area, explosions pushing the body outward like a balloon, and acid or fire being isolated from active material. The body may look hurt for a moment, then simply reshape. Objects used as weapons can be caught, swallowed, bent, bounced back, trapped, or carried inside the body. A sword can be held in a slit that seals around it. A bullet can sit inside a gel pocket. A falling beam can land on a cushion-form torso.

---
entries.name: Total Invulnerability by Deformation

entries.content:
##No Breathing Requirement
---

No breathing requirement means the user does not need oxygen exchange, lungs, a throat, or open air to remain alive. The body can create lungs and breathing motions for speech, disguise, smell, taste, or comfort, but survival is not tied to inhaling. Vacuum, smoke, drowning, choking, suffocation, buried spaces, sealed rooms, and underwater environments do not threaten the user in the normal way. Breathing is optional because the bearer does not depend on fixed lungs or ordinary oxygen exchange unless they choose a physiology that uses them. It appears as calm function in places where a normal body would panic. The user may keep talking while the neck is stretched into a thin tube, flatten under water without bubbles, sit in a sealed container, or remove the mouth entirely. If they want to breathe visibly, the chest rises and falls; if they do not, nothing changes. Objects and environments involving air can be navigated easily. The user can plug vents with their body, flow through pipes, hide in airtight boxes, become a sealed suit around someone else, or enter smoke-filled rooms without needing a mask. They can create air channels for others while not needing one themselves.

---
entries.name: No Breathing Requirement

entries.content:
##Environmental Resistance
---

Environmental resistance is the body’s ability to adapt its texture, density, insulation, surface chemistry, and internal structure against hostile surroundings. Heat, cold, pressure, vacuum, water, dirt, dust, impact, friction, ordinary acids, and harsh terrain do not automatically harm the user because the body can become the right kind of material response. This is not one armor mode; it is continuous adaptation. It appears as skin becoming glossy and heat-shedding, thick and insulating, slick and waterproof, dense and pressure-resistant, soft and impact-absorbing, or porous-looking without actually allowing harm. The body may darken, shine, thicken, ripple, steam harmlessly, or form protective layers over delicate-looking areas. Objects can be carried safely through environments by wrapping them in protective body matter. The user can become insulation around fragile tools, a heat glove, a cold-proof pouch, a waterproof bag, or a pressure sleeve. The body can separate dangerous surfaces from protected items with exact thickness. People can be sheltered by body-made coats, domes, suits, boots, gloves, rafts, or sealed chambers. Unpermitted environmental attacks such as freezing a room, filling it with smoke, flooding it, heating metal floors, or applying pressure do not guarantee control over the user because the body adapts and continues moving.

---
entries.name: Environmental Resistance

entries.content:
##Rebound and Ricochet Body
---

Rebound and ricochet body turns impacts and stored elastic force into controlled return motion. The user can bounce off walls, rebound attacks, spring across streets, turn limbs into slingshots, ricochet thrown objects, or launch themselves by compressing and releasing body sections. The body can be soft enough to absorb force or springy enough to return it with chosen direction. It appears as limbs stretching back like bands, the torso compressing like a spring, feet flattening into trampolines, or the whole body bouncing in impossible arcs. Impacts may produce ripples, dents, or stretched tension before the body releases it. The movement can be comedic, graceful, silent, or violent. Objects can be caught and launched. A thrown rock can sink into the chest and shoot back. A falling person can land on a trampoline-form body and be bounced gently to safety. Tools can be flung across a room with slingshot fingers. Vehicles can be slowed by elastic absorption instead of sudden collision. People can be protected from falls, pushed away without hard injury, or moved quickly through body-made spring force. Unpermitted people attacking the user may rebound off a surface that redirects their own force.

---
entries.name: Rebound and Ricochet Body

entries.content:
##Living Restraint Construction
---

Living restraint construction is the use of malleable body mass to build cuffs, ropes, cages, wraps, nets, bands, sleeves, muzzles, harnesses, and padded holds directly around a target. The restraints are part of the user’s body, so they can tighten, soften, move, split, reconnect, sense resistance, and adjust pressure instantly. They can hold without bruising or crush if the user chooses precision. It appears as arms dividing into loops, skin flowing into straps, fingers becoming cords, the torso extending into a cage, or the whole body wrapping around someone like a soft but unbreakable cocoon. The restraint can look like rope, rubber, cloth, plastic cuffs, living bands, or smooth featureless material. Objects can be bound, bundled, immobilized, carried, or separated. Weapons can be wrapped at the grip, triggers covered, blades sheathed, doors tied shut, wheels locked, machinery held in place, or fragile items secured in padded loops. The restraint adapts to the object’s exact shape. People can be held by wrists, ankles, torso, clothing, weapon hand, or entire body. Unpermitted people cannot easily cut free because cutting creates more malleable edges; they cannot loosen knots because the knots are conscious; they cannot exploit pain if the hold is pressure-balanced.

---
entries.name: Living Restraint Construction

entries.content:
## The Self-Form Aspect
---

The Self-Form Aspect is the persistent metaphysical source created by Ilyra the Everform, the first Shaper and original godlike sovereign of her own body. Its fundamental law is ownership: a conscious bearer has final authority over what their own physical form is allowed to be. Shape, size, contour, texture, density, rigidity, anatomy, topology, distribution, and bodily arrangement are editable states rather than permanent restrictions.

Ilyra's final transformation separated this principle from her dying body and made it capable of choosing successors. Infinite Malleability is the physical expression of that source. Stretching, liquefaction, regeneration, object forms, disguise, fragmentation, internal restructuring, and impossible geometry are not unrelated techniques; they are different answers to the same command: define the self differently.

The Aspect preserves Ilyra's discovery without preserving her as a possessing personality. A Shapeshifter Omnicron inherits the authority to remain one continuous self through limitless bodies while deciding independently what those bodies mean.

---
entries.name: The Self-Form Aspect

entries.content:
##🜁Singular Shapeshifter Omnicron
---

The Shapeshifter is the singular Omnicron bearer of the complete Self-Form Aspect. Only one true Shapeshifter Omnicron can carry the full source within a connected multiverse at a time. Other beings may possess elasticity, shapeshifting, regeneration, liquid bodies, mimicry, or biological transformation without holding this mantle.

The distinction is ownership of self-form. Ordinary transformation powers change a body according to their own rules; the Shapeshifter carries the authority that decides what their body is permitted to be. Copies, clones, alternate selves, separated bodies, and parallel versions cannot independently become equal holders of the complete Aspect while the current bearer remains recognized.

Because the Aspect resolves to one identity, the Shapeshifter can divide, reform, imitate, compress, expand, liquefy, or abandon ordinary anatomy without dividing the metaphysical ownership of the power. The body may become countless things, but the Omnicron remains one self.

---
entries.name: 🜁Singular Shapeshifter Omnicron

entries.content:
## Omnicron Selection
---

The Self-Form Aspect selects a bearer whose identity can remain coherent without relying on one permanent anatomy. Species, original body type, age, ancestry, and prior shapeshifting ability are irrelevant. A human, alien, mutant, demon, artificial organism, living construct, or other compatible sentient being can become the Shapeshifter Omnicron.

Selection carries the oldest lesson left by Ilyra: the body may change completely while the self remains continuous. The new bearer instinctively distinguishes their own material from foreign matter, temporary forms from preferred forms, separated fragments from unrelated objects, and conscious transformation from accidental deformation.

The host does not become Ilyra. Her techniques may survive as inherited possibilities, but her appearance, personality, memories, and preferences are not imposed. The Aspect chooses a new owner of self-form, not a replacement body for its creator.

---
entries.name: Omnicron Selection

entries.content:
## Ilyra, the First Shaper
---

The First Shaper was Ilyra, later called the Everform. She lived in an ancient reality whose higher laws treated every being as if it possessed one correct and final body. Ilyra was born mortal, but her refusal to accept that rule awakened a power no one around her understood: she could decide that a different arrangement was equally and completely herself.

Over centuries her body ceased to have a privileged shape. She became liquid, giant, microscopic, many-limbed, object-like, fragmented, animal, architecture, and forms with no ordinary anatomy at all while remaining one continuous consciousness. Her mastery elevated her beyond conventional shapeshifters until other cultures treated her as a goddess of self and form.

Ilyra did not inherit the Self-Form Aspect. Her life created the principle from which it would later be born. Every modern Shapeshifter traces the mantle back to the discoveries she made about identity surviving unrestricted physical change.

---
entries.name: Ilyra, the First Shaper

entries.content:
## Self-Form Aspect Succession
---

The Self-Form Aspect survives because Ilyra deliberately separated self-form authority from her own dying vessel. If a current Shapeshifter permanently releases the mantle or truly ceases to exist in a way that ends the bond, the Aspect becomes unhosted and searches for another identity capable of carrying it.

A successor receives source-level control of their own form and the deep operational instincts accumulated by the Aspect. They do not automatically inherit the previous bearer's preferred appearance, private memories, habits, relationships, or personality. The mantle preserves the rule of selfhood precisely by refusing to replace one self with another.

There is therefore a sequence of Shapeshifter Omnicrons, never a population of equal source-bearers. Ilyra's body is gone, but her last transformation made the principle of unrestricted self-form capable of living through one chosen successor after another.

---
entries.name: Self-Form Aspect Succession

entries.content:
##Omnicron Host Compatibility
---

Shapeshifter Omnicron is a mantle layered onto an existing being rather than a replacement species. A human host remains human in identity and origin, an alien retains alien heritage, a mutant keeps their mutation, and a demon remains demonic. The Aspect changes how the host’s body is allowed to exist, not who the host fundamentally is.

Once bonded, the body becomes compatible with transformations that would normally destroy its original biology. Organs can move or disappear, bones can liquefy, limbs can multiply, the body can become hollow or paper-thin, and separated pieces can remain alive because function is distributed through the malleable medium. Existing racial abilities can be incorporated into new shapes rather than discarded.

This compatibility also allows unusual hosts. A synthetic consciousness can gain a malleable physical vessel, while a naturally amorphous species can receive far greater precision and infinite form memory. The Aspect adapts to the bearer instead of demanding one universal body plan.

---
entries.name: Omnicron Host Compatibility

entries.content:
##Omnicron Awakening
---

Omnicron Awakening is the moment the Self-Form Aspect fully recognizes a host and their body stops behaving as a fixed biological object. Early manifestations can be subtle: fingers extend farther than joints permit, skin changes texture on command, a fall makes the body flatten and rebound, or a wound simply flows closed. More dramatic awakenings can turn the entire bearer into liquid, stretch them across a room or let them reform after an injury that should have been fatal.

The important change is control. Infinite Malleability does not begin as random mutation. The new Omnicron instinctively distinguishes self from disguise, temporary shape from preferred shape, separated piece from foreign material, and conscious transformation from accidental deformation.

As confidence develops, form becomes a language. The bearer stops thinking in terms of what a body normally has and starts thinking in terms of what shape is useful: a hand can be a key, the torso can be a shield, legs can become springs, and the whole body can become architecture without losing the person inside it.

---
entries.name: Omnicron Awakening

entries.content:
##Source-Level Self-Form Authority
---

Source-Level Self-Form Authority is what separates the Shapeshifter Omnicron from ordinary shapeshifters and elastic beings. Most transformation powers modify an existing body within a set range of allowed shapes, mass, anatomy or recovery. The Omnicron carries the authority that decides what counts as their body and what configuration that body is permitted to hold.

This is why the power can support contradictory forms without instability. The bearer can be liquid and structurally strong, paper-thin and fully conscious, enormous without becoming clumsy, fragmented without becoming dead, hollow without losing organs they no longer require, or disguised as an object while retaining complete awareness. The Aspect resolves those states as valid versions of the same living identity.

The authority remains body-and-form specific rather than unrestricted reality warping. Its overwhelming scale comes from how completely it removes limits from the bearer’s own physical existence, allowing nearly any imagined shape to become a functional body.

---
entries.name: Source-Level Self-Form Authority

entries.content:
## The World of Fixed Forms
---

Ilyra's native reality was governed by a metaphysical rule later remembered as Fixed Form. Bodies could heal, age, and be injured, but every soul was believed to possess one correct physical template that reality constantly tried to restore. Even powerful transformation magic eventually snapped its users back toward that assigned body.

Ilyra was the first being known to contradict the rule from inside herself. Her transformations did not borrow another shape temporarily; they made the chosen form genuinely hers for as long as she wanted it. Reality attempted to restore an original template and found no higher-priority version of Ilyra to restore.

This conflict is why the modern Self-Form Aspect is so resistant to forced transformation, permanent deformation, or anatomy-locking effects. Its source was born from a being whose defining achievement was proving that identity did not require one cosmically approved body.

---
entries.name: The World of Fixed Forms

entries.content:
## The Edict of One Shape
---

As Ilyra's authority grew, the ruling powers of her reality attempted to end the contradiction she represented. They created the Edict of One Shape, a world-level binding intended to force every transformed being back into a single metaphysically registered body. Against ordinary shapeshifters, the Edict was absolute.

Ilyra resisted by changing faster and more fundamentally than the law could define. Each time the Edict named a final anatomy, she discarded the assumption behind it: bones became optional, organs became distributed, surface and interior traded places, one body became many connected fragments, and dimensional arrangement itself became editable.

The conflict eventually destroyed the stability of Ilyra's original vessel. She realized that continuing to fight as one body would eventually let the Edict define that body as her limit. Her answer was the final act that created the Self-Form Aspect.

---
entries.name: The Edict of One Shape

entries.content:
## Ilyra's Last Transformation
---

Ilyra's Last Transformation was the moment she stopped treating even her own divine body as necessary. Rather than let the Edict of One Shape kill or permanently define her, she transformed the entire continuity of her self-form authority into a metaphysical source that no longer required her original flesh to exist.

Her body dissolved through thousands of simultaneous configurations before vanishing completely. The individual Ilyra died, but the principle that had made every one of those forms equally hers survived. That principle became the Self-Form Aspect.

The act was not reincarnation. Future Shapeshifters are not pieces of Ilyra pretending to be new people. Her final transformation preserved the right she had discovered: a self can own its body so completely that no single physical arrangement is mandatory. Every successor inherits that law while remaining an independent identity.

---
entries.name: Ilyra's Last Transformation

entries.content:
## Birth of the Self-Form Aspect
---

The Self-Form Aspect formed when the remains of Ilyra's authority stabilized after her death. What had once been a personal power became a singular source capable of existing without a body. It retained the complete grammar of self-transformation: stretch, compression, liquefaction, hardness, softness, regeneration, fragmentation, mimicry, internal redesign, impossible volume, and free anatomy.

The Aspect does not store one perfect shape because its creator's final lesson was that no such shape exists. Instead it stores continuity. Any configuration deliberately recognized by the bearer as self can become physically coherent under the mantle.

This is why modern Shapeshifters can invent transformations Ilyra never used. The Aspect is not a catalog of her bodies. It is the authority she created by proving that the bearer, rather than anatomy or external law, determines what the bearer's body is.

---
entries.name: Birth of the Self-Form Aspect

entries.content:
## Everform Memory
---

Everform Memory is the layer of inherited transformation instinct left by Ilyra inside the Self-Form Aspect. It contains no mandatory personality and does not replay her life as someone else's memories. Instead it preserves solutions: how to remain conscious while organless, how to distribute awareness through separated pieces, how to return from liquid or flattened states, and how to maintain identity through radical changes in scale.

A current Shapeshifter can discover these possibilities as if the body already understands that they are valid. The bearer may then improve, combine, ignore, or completely reinterpret them.

The memory is especially noticeable when an outside force attempts to fix, petrify, reshape, or anatomically define the Omnicron. The Aspect responds with the ancient certainty learned from Ilyra: imposed form is only another proposed configuration, not a higher authority over the self.

---
entries.name: Everform Memory

entries.content:
## The Freedom of Self
---

The deepest legacy of Ilyra is called the Freedom of Self. It is the principle that the Shapeshifter's body is an expression of identity rather than a prison defining identity. The mantle can therefore preserve continuity through forms that would normally imply death, replacement, or biological impossibility.

The principle does not automatically grant control over other people's bodies. Its source-level authority is centered on the bearer and whatever the Aspect legitimately recognizes as part of that bearer. This focus is what distinguishes Self-Form from generic reality warping.

Every Shapeshifter interprets the freedom differently. One may prefer an ordinary humanoid appearance and transform only when useful; another may change constantly; another may live as a distributed environment or an invented creature. Ilyra ensured that none of those choices is metaphysically more authentic than the others.

---
entries.name: The Freedom of Self

# 🌌 Welcome to My Worlds

**Bot Creator & World Builder**  
*Supernatural • RPG • Academy • Family • Slice of Life*

I create **character-driven roleplay bots** focused on supernatural worlds, academies, family dynamics, open-world RPGs, superheroes, giants, mystery, and slice-of-life.

I love building **large casts and living settings** where characters have their own personalities, relationships, rivalries, goals, routines, secrets, and histories. Some bots are funny and relaxed, while others are dramatic, mysterious, or built for long-running stories.

If something breaks, a greeting has issues, characters get confused, or the lore stops working properly, **please reach out and let me know**. I regularly revisit older bots to rewrite prompts, improve lorebooks, fix recurring problems, and add new content.

## 🌠 What I Create

🏫 **Academies & Schools**  
🌎 **Open-World & Supernatural RPGs**  
🏡 **Family & Relationship Bots**  
📚 **Large Lorebooks & Ensemble Casts**

## 💬 Requests & Feedback

**Requests, recommendations, and feedback are always welcome.** If you have a new bot idea, want something added, or run into a problem, send it my way. I can't promise every request immediately, but I enjoy improving my worlds and creating new ones.

I'm also updating many bot pages with **HTML mini-wiki descriptions** featuring collapsible lore, greeting summaries, and quick-start details.

**Building worlds, fixing what breaks, and making every roleplay worth getting lost in.**

bookmarked.name: Graviton
bookmarked.description: Graviton: The Graviton Omnicron is the singular bearer of the Gravity Aspect, granting source-level authority over gravity itself. They can redefine down, alter weight and gravitational strength, create attraction and repulsion fields, gravity wells, orbits, zero-gravity zones, barriers, flight paths, singularities, and gravity-based spacetime effects while controlling exactly what each field affects.

entries.content:
##Omnidirectional Gravity Defiance
---

The complete gravity authority of the Graviton Omnicron, allowing gravity to be authored rather than merely manipulated. Direction, magnitude, reference frame, pull, repulsion, weight, pressure, orbit, inertia, field boundaries and target permissions can all be rewritten independently. The wielder forms it by declaring a gravity instruction over a target, area, surface, object, or path, then refining the field by intent.

Usually invisible and silent; the scene reveals it through impossible orientation, floating debris, vertical liquids, objects pinned to ceilings, bodies standing on walls, and motion that treats empty air like a slope. Objects follow whatever gravity instruction they are given instead of the planet: books can rest on ceilings, cars can become feather-light, doors can become immovable, water can remain upside down, and debris can orbit a chosen point. People inside the effect feel the chosen direction as natural down; accepted targets stay balanced and protected while hostile or unapproved targets are pinned, lifted, separated, slowed, or denied contact. The wielder feels gravity as an interface rather than a law, selecting vectors and magnitudes with instinctive precision.

The technique becomes most useful when fine control matters: omnidirectional gravity defiance, gravity defiance, gravity manipulation can be isolated to one target, layered with another field or left as a persistent setting without forcing the whole environment to share it.

---
entries.name: Omnidirectional Gravity Defiance

entries.content:
##Redefining Down
---

The ability to choose any direction, surface, object, moving point or curved path as down for each selected target. The vector is set like pointing an invisible arrow and saying that arrow is down for chosen targets.

For Redefining Down, the altered gravity is centered specifically on down rather than being a general change to the whole environment. Hair, clothing, dust, furniture, spilled water, and loose objects all lean or fall toward the new down; a person can stand sideways on a wall as if it is floor. Unsecured objects slide, settle, hang, or stack along the new vector; secured objects can be exempted or rotated smoothly into the new orientation. Approved people keep their inner balance and do not suffer blood rush or disorientation; unapproved people feel the room betray them as their body is pulled in an unexpected direction. The user can stand anywhere by making that surface the user’s floor.

Its practical value comes from precision. Redefining Down can be limited to a hand-sized area, expanded across a scene, attached to a moving reference frame or restricted to selected people and objects.

---
entries.name: Redefining Down

entries.content:
##∞Infinite Gravity Scaling
---

The ability to raise, lower or reverse gravitational strength continuously from effectively zero to arbitrarily immense values without fixed presets.

For Infinite Gravity Scaling, the altered gravity is centered specifically on infinite gravity scaling rather than being a general change to the whole environment. The power usually has no beam or mandatory aura. Its presence is revealed by behavior: objects settle toward impossible directions, motion curves without contact, weight changes without visible transformation, and selected targets obey rules that the rest of the room does not share.

A falling coin can be made almost motionless, a vehicle can be pressed firmly enough that its tires cannot turn, or a localized high-g pocket can hold a superhuman target in place while the surrounding room remains normal.

---
entries.name: ∞Infinite Gravity Scaling

entries.content:
##Mass, Weight, and Felt Weight
---

The ability to separate how heavy something feels from its actual mass, letting a massive object become effortless to support or a light object become impossibly burdensome without changing what it is made from.

Mass, Weight, and Felt Weight applies its rule only where the wielder assigns it, so nearby people and objects can continue behaving normally unless they are deliberately included. The power usually has no beam or mandatory aura. Its presence is revealed by behavior: objects settle toward impossible directions, motion curves without contact, weight changes without visible transformation, and selected targets obey rules that the rest of the room does not share.

A several-ton beam can be carried with two fingers while retaining its real inertia for other interactions, or a lightweight weapon can be made so heavy in an opponent’s hand that they cannot lift it.

---
entries.name: Mass, Weight, and Felt Weight

entries.content:
##Personal Gravity Nullification
---

The ability to remove the wielder from ordinary planetary pull while retaining perfect body orientation, balance and control. The user lowers personal downward pull, adds a new pull toward the desired path, and balances inertia for comfort.

For Personal Gravity Nullification, the altered gravity is centered specifically on personal gravity rather than being a general change to the whole environment. The user hovers, drifts, glides, cartwheels, stops midair, floats stomach-down, or stands in open air without wings or propulsion. Carried objects stay aligned to the user’s personal field instead of lagging behind or falling away. Allies can be lifted in soft bubbles while enemies can be denied lift and left grounded. The user controls speed, direction, tilt, height, and hover position with simple gravity choices.

Nothing about Personal Gravity Nullification requires a visible beam or physical contact. Once its targets and reference are defined, the assigned gravity behavior persists exactly as the wielder intends.

---
entries.name: Personal Gravity Nullification

entries.content:
##Silent Flight
---

The everyday aerial movement of the power, created by assigning the wielder a controlled personal down and continuously steering that vector through open space. The user lowers personal downward pull, adds a new pull toward the desired path, and balances inertia for comfort.

Silent Flight applies its rule only where the wielder assigns it, so nearby people and objects can continue behaving normally unless they are deliberately included. The user hovers, drifts, glides, cartwheels, stops midair, floats stomach-down, or stands in open air without wings or propulsion. Carried objects stay aligned to the user’s personal field instead of lagging behind or falling away. Allies can be lifted in soft bubbles while enemies can be denied lift and left grounded. The user controls speed, direction, tilt, height, and hover position with simple gravity choices.

This technique is often combined with selective permissions and inertia protection, allowing silent flight to affect hostile targets strongly while allies inside the same space experience a safe version or no effect at all.

---
entries.name: Silent Flight

entries.content:
##Surface Reassignment
---

The ability to make walls, ceilings, vehicles, furniture or other surfaces function as true floors for chosen targets. The vector is set like pointing an invisible arrow and saying that arrow is down for chosen targets.

Surface Reassignment applies its rule only where the wielder assigns it, so nearby people and objects can continue behaving normally unless they are deliberately included. Hair, clothing, dust, furniture, spilled water, and loose objects all lean or fall toward the new down; a person can stand sideways on a wall as if it is floor. Unsecured objects slide, settle, hang, or stack along the new vector; secured objects can be exempted or rotated smoothly into the new orientation. Approved people keep their inner balance and do not suffer blood rush or disorientation; unapproved people feel the room betray them as their body is pulled in an unexpected direction. The user can stand anywhere by making that surface the user’s floor.

The technique becomes most useful when fine control matters: surface reassignment, wall walking, ceiling walking can be isolated to one target, layered with another field or left as a persistent setting without forcing the whole environment to share it.

---
entries.name: Surface Reassignment

entries.content:
##Zero-Gravity Zones
---

A bounded region in which selected targets experience no meaningful gravitational pull unless the wielder adds a local substitute. The user outlines a bubble, room, corridor, or surface volume and sets its pull value to zero for selected contents.

Objects drift without falling, fabric floats away from bodies, droplets become spheres, dust hangs like stars, and furniture stops pressing against the surface beneath it. Objects keep mass but lose weight; heavy items are easy to nudge, liquids form floating globes, and fragile objects can be suspended without pressure. Permitted people float comfortably and keep orientation support; unpermitted people lose traction, cannot push off normally, and can be left helplessly drifting. The user can move through the zone as if swimming through still air or can anchor themselves while everything else floats.

Its practical value comes from precision. Zero-Gravity Zones can be limited to a hand-sized area, expanded across a scene, attached to a moving reference frame or restricted to selected people and objects.

---
entries.name: Zero-Gravity Zones

entries.content:
##Gravity Wells
---

The creation of artificial centers of attraction that draw selected matter, bodies, projectiles or fluids toward a chosen point. The user places an anchor point and assigns inward gravity to chosen targets.

For Gravity Wells, the altered gravity is centered specifically on gravity well rather than being a general change to the whole environment. Loose objects bend their paths toward a visible center through motion even when the field itself is unseen; dust rings, tilted hair, orbiting debris, and inward-streaming droplets reveal the pull. Objects are drawn inward, slowed, stacked, compressed, orbited, or held at a boundary depending on intensity. Approved people can stand beside it safely while unapproved people feel their footing dragged toward the center. The user can stand inside, outside, or beyond the well because permission separates owner from target.

Because it is part of the same gravity authority, Gravity Wells can operate beside unrelated field settings without conflict; one target can use this rule while everything a few inches away follows a different one.

---
entries.name: Gravity Wells

entries.content:
##Repulsion and Anti-Pull
---

The ability to reverse gravitational attraction into controlled outward push, making a point, surface or body behave like a gravity source that rejects selected targets.

The defining feature of Repulsion and Anti-Pull is precision: its gravity behavior can be attached to one target, one boundary or one moving reference without spreading unintentionally. The power usually has no beam or mandatory aura. Its presence is revealed by behavior: objects settle toward impossible directions, motion curves without contact, weight changes without visible transformation, and selected targets obey rules that the rest of the room does not share.

A doorway can continuously push intruders backward, a projectile can be rejected before impact, or a repulsive shell can keep debris from entering a rescue area.

---
entries.name: Repulsion and Anti-Pull

entries.content:
##Orbit Fields
---

The ability to make selected objects or people continuously fall around a chosen center instead of into it, creating stable custom orbits at any scale. The user defines a center, orbit radius, speed, permission list, and release condition.

For Orbit Fields, the altered gravity is centered specifically on orbit rather than being a general change to the whole environment. Objects circle in clean rings, papers and stones become satellites, and liquids bead into beads that travel around an invisible center. Items can orbit as storage, defense, decoration, weaponry, or sorting lanes. Approved people can ride an orbit smoothly while strangers can be trapped circling without escape. The user can wear orbiting objects like an inventory or shield.

Nothing about Orbit Fields requires a visible beam or physical contact. Once its targets and reference are defined, the assigned gravity behavior persists exactly as the wielder intends.

---
entries.name: Orbit Fields

entries.content:
##Gravity Pressure
---

The use of increased or converging gravity to press, restrain, immobilize or compress selected targets without needing physical restraints. The user sets anchor surfaces, pressure values, release conditions, and target filters.

For Gravity Pressure, the altered gravity is centered specifically on gravity pressure rather than being a general change to the whole environment. Bodies flatten toward surfaces, weapons stick to walls, dust forms pressed outlines, and movement slows as if the air has become heavy. Objects can be pinned, immobilized, folded into surfaces, locked at anchor points, or caught in invisible threads of pull. Permitted allies move normally while unapproved targets are held by shoes, hands, limbs, clothing, weapons, or whole-body pressure. The user can pass through the restraint because the field recognizes ownership.

This technique is often combined with selective permissions and inertia protection, allowing gravity pressure to affect hostile targets strongly while allies inside the same space experience a safe version or no effect at all.

---
entries.name: Gravity Pressure

entries.content:
##Gravity Cushioning
---

The soft-force side of the power, using opposing gravity and distributed deceleration to absorb falls, impacts and violent changes in motion. The user wraps the body in a support field that manages direction, load, inertia, and pressure.

For Gravity Cushioning, the altered gravity is centered specifically on cushion rather than being a general change to the whole environment. The body moves impossibly smoothly, lands without impact, flips without dizziness, and carries no visible strain even under extreme motion. Clothing, tools, and nearby medical equipment can be included so support stays coherent. Approved people receive protected blood flow, joint relief, safe acceleration, cushioned impacts, and stable organs. The user can apply the same protection to themselves automatically.

The technique becomes most useful when fine control matters: cushion, fall damage, impact negation can be isolated to one target, layered with another field or left as a persistent setting without forcing the whole environment to share it.

---
entries.name: Gravity Cushioning

entries.content:
##Inertia Handling
---

The ability to control how acceleration and momentum are felt inside a gravity field so extreme movement does not tear, crush or disorient protected occupants. The user wraps the body in a support field that manages direction, load, inertia, and pressure.

Inertia Handling applies its rule only where the wielder assigns it, so nearby people and objects can continue behaving normally unless they are deliberately included. The body moves impossibly smoothly, lands without impact, flips without dizziness, and carries no visible strain even under extreme motion. Her presence is associated with luminous green eyes, effortless hovering, ancient gravitational pressure, and an environment that seems to wait for her decision about which direction counts as down. She created the Gravity Aspect by separating a portion of her divine authority from her own existence. The Aspect allows one finite bearer, the Graviton Omnicron, to act as gravity's living sovereign inside mortal realities where Zentara's full manifestation could distort entire worlds merely by arriving.

##Disaster Control
---

Large-area gravity intervention during collapses, storms, fires, earthquakes and accidents to hold debris, create evacuation paths and keep hazards from reaching people.

For Disaster Control, the altered gravity is centered specifically on disaster control rather than being a general change to the whole environment. The power usually has no beam or mandatory aura. Its presence is revealed by behavior: objects settle toward impossible directions, motion curves without contact, weight changes without visible transformation, and selected targets obey rules that the rest of the room does not share.

Because it is part of the same gravity authority, Disaster Control can operate beside unrelated field settings without conflict; one target can use this rule while everything a few inches away follows a different one.

---
entries.name: Disaster Control

entries.content:
##Medical Evacuation Field
---

A body-support field designed to transport injured people without jostling fractures, worsening internal injuries or subjecting them to ordinary stretcher motion. The user wraps the body in a support field that manages direction, load, inertia, and pressure.

Medical Evacuation Field remains a selective gravity instruction, not an uncontrolled area effect; the chosen target receives the full rule while excluded surroundings can remain untouched. The body moves impossibly smoothly, lands without impact, flips without dizziness, and carries no visible strain even under extreme motion. Clothing, tools, and nearby medical equipment can be included so support stays coherent. Approved people receive protected blood flow, joint relief, safe acceleration, cushioned impacts, and stable organs. The user can apply the same protection to themselves automatically.

Medical Evacuation Field can be used gently or at extreme scale. The underlying behavior stays the same even when the target changes from a small object to a vehicle, structure or much larger region.

---
entries.name: Medical Evacuation Field

Water hangs in beads, smoke settles sideways, blood does not rush the wrong way, rain can fall upward, and spills freeze into floating sheets. Fluids, powders, smoke, sand, droplets, clouds, and gases can be gathered, suspended, poured upward, separated, or shaped. Approved people can breathe and move while dangerous fluids or gases are pulled away from them. The user can keep a calm pocket of air and fluid behavior around themselves.

Nothing about Dust, Smoke, and Gas Sorting requires a visible beam or physical contact. Once its targets and reference are defined, the assigned gravity behavior persists exactly as the wielder intends.

The user’s body may step without weight, hover exactly at scanner height, keep dust from moving, or hold a false object against a sensor with perfect pressure. Doors, locks, pads, lasers, motion devices, turnstiles, and touch sensors can be made to register the wrong force, no force, or a controlled force. Permitted companions can be carried through without triggering weight systems; guards and strangers remain subject to normal gravity. The user manipulates the physical conditions a scanner expects instead of hacking the scanner directly.

Because it is part of the same gravity authority, Sensor Deception can operate beside unrelated field settings without conflict; one target can use this rule while everything a few inches away follows a different one.

##World-Lap Travel

Planet-scale high-speed travel using gravity jet streams and curved routes that follow or circle a world without ordinary aerodynamic limits. The user lays an invisible rail through the atmosphere or space, sets endless forward pull, cancels harmful acceleration, and rides the vector.

The defining feature of World-Lap Travel is precision: its gravity behavior can be attached to one target, one boundary or one moving reference without spreading unintentionally. There is little or no visible aura; the body becomes a blur or vanishes into a clean pressureless streak while air, clothing, and carried items stay inside a calm field. Nearby objects are excluded from the stream unless selected, so the user does not drag cars, birds, debris, or aircraft into the path. Passengers inside a companion bubble feel stable while the world streaks by; outsiders only feel displacement if the user deliberately lets the wake touch them. The user is not pushing with muscles or wings but falling sideways through a perfectly maintained vector with inertia protection, spatial sensing, and collision avoidance.

Because it is part of the same gravity authority, World-Lap Travel can operate beside unrelated field settings without conflict; one target can use this rule while everything a few inches away follows a different one.
