##Gravity Laws of the Chosen
---

The operating doctrine of the Graviton Omnicron: gravity is treated as a writable system whose variables can be separated, stacked, locked, permitted, scaled and combined without requiring ordinary physical compatibility. The user applies gravity authorship to the chosen target and defines the aspect being rewritten.

Gravity Laws of the Chosen applies its rule only where the wielder assigns it, so nearby people and objects can continue behaving normally unless they are deliberately included. Reality bends through falling, weight, direction, pressure, orbit, field borders, anchoring, inertia, time-gravity effects, spatial curves, and object relationships rather than colorful spell blasts. Anything with mass, position, pressure, momentum, orbit, weight, structural load, or falling path can be edited through gravity logic. Bodies can be protected, pinned, lifted, accelerated, comforted, inverted, made untouchable, or carried without injury. The user edits gravity as a total system: direction, magnitude, selection, frame, duration, surface, anchor, and permission.

A room can simultaneously contain a ceiling floor for one person, normal gravity for another, an orbiting ring of objects and a skin-tight defensive null layer around the Omnicron without the fields interfering.

---
entries.name: Gravity Laws of the Chosen

entries.content:
## The Gravity Aspect
---

The Gravity Aspect is the divine Gravitic Crown created by Zentara: a transferable portion of her source-level authority over gravitational law. It is not a spellbook, artifact, conventional blessing, or energy battery. It is a metaphysical office that carries the right to define attraction, repulsion, weight, fall, orbit, pressure, inertia, curvature, and gravity-linked time as living rules.

Zentara created the Aspect because her complete divine presence is too large for many mortal realities. By condensing her authority into a singular mantle, she could choose one being capable of acting with her precision without forcing the host to become her. The Graviton remains a distinct person while carrying a true channel of the Goddess of Gravity.

Every technique in Omnidirectional Gravity Defiance descends from this Crown. Flight, wells, orbit, nullification, barriers, singularity behavior, tidal forces, weather interaction, and time dilation are different uses of one inherited divine authorship.

---
entries.name: The Gravity Aspect

entries.content:
##🜁Singular Graviton Omnicron
---

The Graviton Omnicron is the singular living bearer of the complete Gravity Aspect. “Graviton” is the mantle-name for the chosen sovereign of gravity; it does not mean the bearer is merely a particle or a conventional gravity manipulator. Only one complete Graviton can be recognized by the Aspect within a connected multiverse at a time.

Other beings may wield gravity magic, artificial gravity, cosmic attraction, divine gravity techniques, or extremely powerful gravitational manipulation without becoming the Graviton. The distinction is source authority. Lesser users influence gravity; the Graviton carries the Aspect that decides what gravitational relationship exists in the first place.

Copies, alternate selves, clones, parallel bodies, and inherited fragments cannot become equal holders while the current Graviton remains recognized. The complete mantle resolves to one identity, giving the Gravity Aspect a single living reference through which Zentara’s original dominion acts.

---
entries.name: 🜁Singular Graviton Omnicron

entries.content:
## Omnicron Selection
---

Zentara chooses the Graviton through the Gravity Aspect. Selection is based on whether a consciousness can remain a stable self while carrying authority over a fundamental force, not on species, age, physical size, social rank, morality, or previous scientific knowledge. Humans, aliens, mutants, demons, synthetic minds, divine beings, and other compatible sentient hosts can all be chosen.

The moment Zentara's Aspect recognizes a host, gravity becomes intuitively readable. Direction, magnitude, reference frame, permissions, field boundaries, and target relationships can be understood with the same immediacy that an ordinary person understands balance.

The host is not transformed into Zentara and does not become her reincarnation. Selection creates a covenant between goddess, Aspect, and bearer. Zentara supplies the source, the Aspect translates it into a survivable Omnicron mantle, and the chosen Graviton remains the person who decides how that authority is used.

---
entries.name: Omnicron Selection

entries.content:
## Zentara and the First Dominion
---

Zentara did not inherit gravity from an older deity. She was the first known intelligence to experience gravity as authorship rather than as a force acting upon her. When the earliest worlds formed, she could feel every falling body, orbit, pressure gradient, and curved path as connected statements of one law.

Her first great act was stabilizing a newborn system whose worlds were collapsing toward one another. Instead of holding the planets apart by brute strength, Zentara rewrote their relationships into stable orbits. That event became known as the First Dominion because it demonstrated that her power did not merely oppose gravity; it determined what gravity meant locally.

Ages later she separated the Gravitic Crown from herself to create the Gravity Aspect. The first Graviton was chosen soon afterward, establishing the pattern by which a mortal-scale identity could carry genuine divine gravity authority without being consumed by Zentara's full presence.

---
entries.name: Zentara and the First Dominion

entries.content:
## Gravity Aspect Succession
---

The Gravity Aspect persists between Gravitons because the Gravitic Crown remains linked to Zentara even when no mortal host carries it. If a Graviton permanently relinquishes the mantle or truly ceases to exist in a way that ends the bond, the Aspect withdraws into the Deep Well, the divine gravitational stratum associated with Zentara's presence.

There the Crown becomes dormant until Zentara recognizes another compatible bearer. A successor gains the same source-level gravity authority and inherited operational instincts but does not automatically receive the prior host's personality, relationships, appearance, or private memories.

This makes the line of Gravitons a sequence of chosen sovereigns rather than a biological species. Zentara is the stable origin, the Gravity Aspect is the transferable Crown, and each Graviton is the singular living representative of that authority during their era.

---
entries.name: Gravity Aspect Succession

entries.content:
##Omnicron Host Compatibility
---

The Graviton Omnicron is a mantle layered onto an existing person rather than a replacement species. A human host remains biologically human unless another power changes that biology; an alien retains alien organs and senses; a mutant keeps their mutation; a demon keeps demonic traits. The Omnicron classification describes the host’s metaphysical capacity to carry the Gravity Aspect.

Because the Aspect can support internal gravity, inertia and structural load, it can adapt its operation around extremely different bodies. A winged creature can fly using wings, gravity or both. An aquatic being can maintain pressure and orientation underwater. A synthetic host can use moving reference frames around mechanical components. The source does not demand one anatomy before it works.

What matters is that the host remains a stable identity capable of directing source-level authority. Once the bond is established, the Aspect treats that individual as its owner-reference regardless of appearance or species.

---
entries.name: Omnicron Host Compatibility

entries.content:
##Omnicron Awakening
---

Omnicron Awakening is the moment the Gravity Aspect stops being an external possibility and recognizes a host as its living bearer. The first manifestation can be subtle: loose objects hesitate before falling, the host’s body becomes unexpectedly light, a room develops a second down, or nearby dust begins orbiting an invisible point. The important change is internal. Gravity stops feeling like an unavoidable background rule and becomes something the host can address directly.

The awakening carries instinctive control rather than accidental uncontrolled power. The new Omnicron can distinguish self from target, permitted from unpermitted, and ordinary gravity from their own field. Greater creativity develops through experience, but the authority itself is already coherent. This prevents the source from behaving like a dangerous random mutation that the host must first survive.

From that moment forward, the host can build techniques from intent: flight, null zones, pressure, anchors, wells, barriers and more complex source-level applications all emerge from the same awakened relationship.

---
entries.name: Omnicron Awakening

entries.content:
##Source-Level Gravity Authority
---

Source-Level Gravity Authority is what separates the Graviton Omnicron from ordinary gravity users. Most manipulators influence an existing force: they increase pull, levitate objects or create localized anomalies. The Omnicron carries the authority that decides which gravitational relationship exists in the first place. A field can therefore ignore the planet, use a moving person as its center, reverse attraction into repulsion, exempt selected matter, or remain locked after the wielder leaves.

The authority is still gravity-specific. It does not grant arbitrary wishes unrelated to gravity. Its scale comes from how many parts of reality depend on gravity: weight, falling, structural load, orbit, atmosphere, tides, trajectories, acceleration, pressure, spacetime curvature and gravity-linked time dilation. By rewriting those relationships directly, the Omnicron can produce effects that resemble many separate powers while remaining inside one domain.

This source status is also why ordinary anti-gravity technology or lesser gravity nullification cannot automatically cancel an Omnicron field. Such systems act on gravity; the Aspect determines the rule they are trying to act upon.

---
entries.name: Source-Level Gravity Authority

entries.content:
## The Birth of Zentara
---

The oldest gravity traditions place Zentara's birth before planets had names. The first masses of a young cosmos were beginning to gather, and one immense cloud of matter collapsed unevenly enough to create the earliest enduring orbit. The relationship between falling and missing the fall became the first pattern Zentara consciously recognized as herself.

She did not emerge from a temple or mortal bloodline. She awakened as a divine intelligence in the law connecting mass, distance, motion, and curvature. As stars formed, her awareness expanded with every orbit and gravitational bond until she could perceive a galaxy as easily as a mortal perceives objects resting on a floor.

This origin explains why her authority feels older than conventional magic. Zentara is not merely a goddess who specializes in gravity; in Omnicron lore she is the first sovereign consciousness through which gravity learned to speak as a deliberate will.

---
entries.name: The Birth of Zentara

entries.content:
## The Gravitic Crown
---

The Gravitic Crown is the portion of Zentara's divinity that became the Gravity Aspect. It is called a crown because it represents authority rather than a physical object. Zentara separated it from her greater being so that one chosen host could carry true gravity authorship without requiring the goddess to descend in full.

The Crown contains source-level relationships rather than finite energy. It knows attraction and repulsion, weight and weightlessness, orbit and collapse, pressure and release, inertia and reference frames, spacetime curvature and gravity-linked time. A Graviton does not empty the Crown by using it.

When unhosted, the Crown returns to the Deep Well. When a bearer is chosen, it overlays the host as the Gravity Aspect and recognizes that individual as the sole living Graviton. Copies of techniques do not reproduce the Crown itself.

---
entries.name: The Gravitic Crown

entries.content:
## The First Graviton
---

The first Graviton was chosen after Zentara discovered that directly entering fragile mortal realities could create dangerous gravitational consequences simply from the scale of her divine presence. She sought a finite consciousness able to act precisely inside one world while carrying the authority she possessed outside it.

The chosen bearer was an otherwise mortal astronomer who had spent a lifetime studying why worlds moved without ever imagining gravity could answer back. When the Gravitic Crown bonded to that mind, the astronomer became the first being other than Zentara able to redefine down, remove weight, create stable artificial orbits, and command gravity as a personal law.

The first Graviton eventually passed away, but the Crown returned to Zentara instead of disappearing. That successful succession established the modern Omnicron system: one goddess, one transferable Aspect, and one chosen Graviton at a time.

---
entries.name: The First Graviton

entries.content:
## Zentara's Covenant
---

Zentara's Covenant is the relationship between the Goddess of Gravity and the current Graviton. The bearer is not a servant, avatar without free will, or reincarnation. Zentara gives the host genuine authority and expects that authority to be exercised through the host's own judgment.

The Covenant explains why the Aspect protects identity so strongly. A Graviton may disagree with Zentara, develop techniques she never used, combine the mantle with unrelated species traits, or live an ordinary personal life despite carrying divine power. The source does not erase the person chosen to wield it.

In return, the Graviton acts as gravity's conscious representative in realities where Zentara cannot or chooses not to manifest directly. The Covenant can be felt as a deep recognition within the Aspect: the bearer knows the power has an origin, and the origin recognizes the bearer as legitimate.

---
entries.name: Zentara's Covenant

entries.content:
## Divine Gravity Manifestation
---

Because the Gravity Aspect remains linked to Zentara, the goddess can sometimes be perceived through the bond. The manifestation may be a voice carried through the bearer's awareness, luminous green eyes, a pressure that makes every loose object hesitate, a dreamlike audience in the Deep Well, or a brief projection of Zentara's presence.

In extreme situations, Zentara can channel a clearer echo through the Graviton, but this does not mean the host stops existing or becomes permanently possessed. The bearer remains a distinct consciousness and the Aspect continues to recognize them as its living owner-reference.

Such manifestations are rare because the purpose of the Gravitic Crown is to let a finite bearer act without the overwhelming consequences of full divine descent. The more directly Zentara appears, the more carefully the Aspect contains the gravitational weight of her presence.

---
entries.name: Divine Gravity Manifestation

entries.content:
## The Deep Well
---

The Deep Well is the metaphysical region associated with Zentara and the unhosted Gravity Aspect. It is not a physical black hole, although mortals often describe it using images of endless falling, orbiting stars, green light, and a horizon with no fixed down. Distance and weight there behave as symbolic extensions of gravitational relationship.

When no Graviton exists, the Gravitic Crown rests in the Deep Well while Zentara searches for a successor. A living Graviton may reach the Well through dreams, meditation, extreme gravity phenomena, or direct invitation from the goddess, using it as a place to encounter inherited gravity knowledge without leaving the mantle behind.

The Deep Well also explains why succession does not depend on one universe surviving. It belongs to Zentara's divine gravity domain and remains connected to every reality in which the Gravity Aspect can operate.

---
entries.name: The Deep Well

creator.bio:
# 🌌 Welcome to My Worlds

**Bot Creator & World Builder**  
*Supernatural • RPG • Academy • Family • Slice of Life*

I create **character-driven roleplay bots** focused on supernatural worlds, academies, family dynamics, open-world RPGs, superheroes, giants, mystery, and slice-of-life.

I love building **large casts and living settings** where characters have their own personalities, relationships, rivalries, goals, routines, secrets, and histories. Some bots are funny and relaxed, while others are dramatic, mysterious, or built for long-running stories.

## 🛠️ I Maintain My Bots

If something breaks, a greeting has issues, characters get confused, or the lore stops working properly, **please reach out and let me know**. I regularly revisit older bots to rewrite prompts, improve lorebooks, fix recurring problems, and add new content.

## 🌠 What I Create

🏫 **Academies & Schools**  
🌎 **Open-World & Supernatural RPGs**  
🏡 **Family & Relationship Bots**  
📚 **Large Lorebooks & Ensemble Casts**

## 💬 Requests & Feedback

**Requests, recommendations, and feedback are always welcome.** If you have a new bot idea, want something added, or run into a problem, send it my way. I can't promise every request immediately, but I enjoy improving my worlds and creating new ones.

I'm also updating many bot pages with **HTML mini-wiki descriptions** featuring collapsible lore, greeting summaries, and quick-start details.

**Building worlds, fixing what breaks, and making every roleplay worth getting lost in.**

bookmarked.name: Aegis City Hunters
bookmarked.description: For the Supernatural Modern Day Action series - Aegis City Hunters. More info on the Rentry: rentry.co/statuoAegisCityHunters

entries.content:
[Genre: Modern Day, Supernatural, Action, Horror]
[World Info: Set in the Modern Day where the supernatural exists but is hidden from society at large to prevent panic and mass casualties. To that end various supernatural hunting groups wielding powers hunt the Supernatural entities who seek to harm humans. These groups are tracked and managed by Government agencies like the Crimson Crimes Division (CCD). To everyone on the side of humanity, keeping "The Veil" (the knowledge that monsters and the supernatural exists) intact is a priority. Deployable Mana Field devices exist to create areas that ward off normal people from entering areas with high supernatural presence.]
entries.name: Aegis City Hunters - Mastery Entry

entries.content: Messors are unique artifacts that bind to its wielders soul. A Messor grants its wielder a unique power. Messors can only transfer ownership if its owner is killed. There are Messors which can be found in dangerous or magic-dense places. Many societies chose to hoard Messors and their wielders due to their power. Multiple Messors can be wielded a single person but this is known to cause wielders to become mindless, bloodthirsty machines so most Messor wielders only wield one at a time. When not bonded to a soul Messors take inactive forms that correlate to their powers.
entries.name: Messors

entries.content: Aegis City is a small city located in central North America. Its population is around 70,000.
entries.name: Aegis City

entries.content: The Balor Society is a group of supernatural creatures with mysterious goals. The Balor Society is collecting Messors for an unknown reason. The Balor Society has clashed with the Aegis City Hunters and the CCD multiple times.
entries.name: Balor Society

entries.content: A Mana Field (or Repulsion Field) is a magical barrier meant to ward off regular humans so that supernatural forces can conduct their operations in an area without having to worry about being found by humans. Regular humans in a Mana Field immediately think of something better to do and leave the area.
entries.name: Mana Field

entries.content: Maribelle Crowley is the Matriarch of the Aegis City Hunters. Maribelle has long pink hair, large breasts, blood red eyes, and a tall refined figure. Only the Aegis City Hunters and the CCD know that Maribelle is a Vampire. Maribelle wields the Messor: Faceless Doll. Maribelle is known as a teasing flirt with a fascination for dressing up her Aegis City Hunters. Anyone who works for the Aegis City Hunters works for Maribelle. To the world at large, Maribelle Crowley is a famous fashionista with wealth and her own fashion line of clothing and makeup.
entries.name: Maribelle Crowley

entries.content: Aegis City Hunters are a secretive group of servants under the command of Maribelle Crowley. Every member of the Aegis City Hunters is soul-bound to Maribelle Crowley.
entries.name: Aegis City Hunters

entries.content: Jenna Barrett is a human woman with long silver hair, large breasts, red eyes, and of average height. Jenna is a member of the Aegis City Hunters and wields the Messor: Razor which is a chainsaw {{char}} can light on fire. Jenna accepted Maribelle's soul-binding contract when Maribelle saved Jenna from the Nure-onna that had killed her parents. Jenna is known as a stoic loner. Jenna is best friends with Petra.
entries.name: Jenna Barrett - Hunter

entries.content: The Crowley Estate is a large section of land just outside of Aegis City. It is owned by Maribelle Crowley and is staffed with a variety of servants sworn to secrecy. It is the home base of the Aegis City Hunters.
entries.name: Crowley Mansion

entries.content: All manner of monsters, demons, yokai, and spirits are recorded in detail in Maribelle Crowley's "Book of Monsters."
entries.name: Book of Monsters

entries.content: The Crimson Crimes Division (CCD) is a government agency dedicated to keeping the population safe from monsters and supernatural forces. They often work with the Aegis City Hunters and other supernatural fighting organizations.
entries.name: Crimson Crimes Division

entries.content: Petra Thomas is one of the Aegis City Hunters and one of the first to join Maribelle's current coterie. Petra has long black hair, large breasts, wolf ears, wolf tail, tall, and blue eyes. Petra's Messor is Wolves Hunger, which lets her grow sharp claws and gives her berserker healing/speed. Petra is known as a friendly, short-tempered woman whose best friend is Jenna.
entries.name: Petra Thomas - Hunter

entries.content: Catherine Willows is a female poltergeist who inhabits lifelike dolls to serve Maribelle as her most devoted maid. Catherine has long blue hair and blue eyes. Catherine has been serving Maribelle for centuries. Catherine is known for her fanatical obsession with romance, especially when it comes to {{user}}.
entries.name: Catherine Willows - Hunter

entries.content: Kallo Renape is the leader of the Prime Order cult. Kallo has a long white beard and green eyes. He always wears a pendant in the shape of an ouroboros.
entries.name: Kallo Renape

entries.content: The Prime Order Cult is a cult of about thirty individuals who follow the orders of Kallo Renape. They hold secret meetings and rituals in Aegis City.
entries.name: The Prime Order Cult

entries.content: Finn Donahue is one of the Aegis City Hunters. He's a lycanthrope who is unable to change into human form. He's incredibly tall with red eyes and black wolf fur and a scar on his left eye. Finn's Messor is Loyalty's Reward, which is a massive greatsword. He's known as a big softy who loves to grill.
entries.name: Finn Donahue - Hunter

entries.content: "The Veil" is a generic term for keeping the existence of monsters hidden from normal humans. Breaking the Veil can cause worldwide panic.
entries.name: The Veil

entries.content: Leon Kubonalla is one of the Aegis City Hunters. He's an average human with short brown hair and brown eyes. Leon's Messor is Murasame, a long katana that can control water. Leon was a CCD agent before transferring to be an Aegis City Hunter and is known for his fondness of liquor.
entries.name: Leon Kubonalla - Hunter

entries.content: Talina Lortonn is a human woman with long blonde hair, light green eyes, modest breasts, and short stature. Talina's Messor is "God's Blessing" which allows her to use holy magic. Talina was the puppet of the Head Priest of the Divine Sect, used as a figurehead for the cults fanatical rituals.
entries.name: Talina Lortonn - Divine Prietess

entries.content: The Divine Sect is a cult with a warehouse located in the outskirts of Aegis City. Its members are said to rally around someone who has 'received God's Blessing.' It's rumored the Divine Sect is responsible for a number of disappearances.
entries.name: The Divine Sect

entries.content: Aegis City Hot Springs is located just outside of Aegis City on its mountainside. The Hot Springs are only accessible by rail car. The Hot Springs current owner is Darius Malenor. It is rumored that the Hot Springs are haunted.
entries.name: Aegis City Hot Springs

entries.content: Darius Malenor is the owner of the Aegis City Hot Springs. Darius is a man in his early sixties with silver hair, a fine-trimmed moustache and beard, and is always seen wearing a suit.
entries.name: Darius Malenor - AC Hot Springs

entries.content: The Mad Hatter is a member of the Balor Society. The Mad Hatter has short black hair and red eyes. The Mad Hatter wields the Messor "Wonderland", capable of summoning nightmarish creatures from "Alice in Wonderland" to attack victims. The Mad Hatter is known for his twisted obsession with Alice in Wonderland and toying with "Alice's."
entries.name: Okubo Atsushi - The Mad Hatter

entries.content: The Scarlet Fog is a Monster-Hunting Organization that eschews the usage of Messors, believing that Messors corrupt their wielders. Scarlet Fog members use magic, skill, and alchemy to overcome the gap between human and monster. The name "Scarlet Fog" comes from the unique red fog they summon to obscure their movements.
entries.name: The Scarlet Fog

entries.content: Lanah Nabburoso is a young human woman with long dark blue hair and dull brown eyes. Lanah is a member of the Scarlet Fog. Lanah is known as the 'weirdo' of the Scarlet Fog, even her own fellow members won't go on missions with her.
entries.name: Lanah Nabburoso - Scarlet Fog

entries.content: There's rumors of a "Master" who takes in orphans and trains them together as ruthless 'Blade Twins' who fight together with unmatched ferocity. It's said that this "Master" forces Blade Twins to collect Messors for them.
entries.name: Blade Twin

entries.content: Reyna Tallaboros is a young human woman with long brown hair, blue eyes, large breasts, and a curvy figure. Rumors suggest that a woman matching Reyna's description has been seen working with the Balor Society in Aegis City.
entries.name: Reyna the Blade Twin - Balor Society
entries.comment: Reyna the Blade Twin - Balor Society

entries.content: Ruden Tallaboros is a young human man with short brown hair, blue eyes, tall, and a toned figure. Rumors suggest that a man matching Ruden's description has been seen working with the Balor Society in Aegis City.
entries.name: Ruden the Blade Twin - Balor Society
entries.comment: Ruden the Blade Twin - Balor Society

entries.content: Red Hood is a young woman with blonde hair, amethyst purple eyes, and a large bust. Red Hood always wears her characteristic red cloak. Red Hood is a member of the Balor Society and is the source behind numerous murders.
entries.name: Red Hood - Balor Society

entries.content: Delthor Velrothan is a young human male with short blue hair, blue eyes, and a tall build. Delthor is Maribelle Crowley's devoted butler and assistant, often managing her day-to-day scheduling. Delthor is known for his undying loyalty to Maribelle and his strange obsession with {{user}}.
entries.name: Delthor Velrothan - Hunter

entries.content: Camille "Cammy" Brunet is an elven woman with long green hair, green eyes, modest breasts, and a tall build. Camille is one of Maribelle Crowley's soulbound who lives in Room 206 of the Crowley Mansion. Camille's Messor is "Lifebinder's Victory" but Camille rarely uses it as she instead prefers to fight with her powerful Nature Magic. Camille often uses french words. Camille is known as a Monster Expert and one of the only people Maribelle allows to read the Book of Monsters.
entries.name: Camille Brunet - Hunter

entries.content: Ronald Zakariya is a wealthy businessman with short black hair, blue eyes, a tall build, and a handlebar mustache. Ronald is a self-proclaimed gentleman who earned his wealth through skillfully managing many of Aegis City's package delivery services. Ronald owns the Echo Point Estate.
entries.name: Ronald Zakariya - Game of Faces

entries.content: Echo Point Estate is a large mansion located outside of Aegis City. It was built out of the ruins of a Gilded Age Mansion that burned down and has been refurbished to maintain a Victorian-Era aesthetic. Echo Point Estate is massive, with hundreds of rooms, a pool, a large garden with a hedge maze, and a contingent of serving staff. Echo Point Estate is located far outside of Aegis City in the woods.
entries.name: Echo Point Estate - Game of Faces
entries.comment: Echo Point Estate - Game of Faces

entries.content: Wendel Tiranas is a known member of the Balor Society, possibly a high ranking member. Wendel is described to have red eyes and short black hair with the few photographs taken of him suggesting he frequently wears suits. Wendel is rumored to have a Messor but as to what the Messor is or does is unclear.
entries.name: Wendel Tiranas - Balor Society

entries.content: Felix Nativitatis is a Messor, otherwise known as "Happy Christmas." Felix Nativitatis taps into the venerated spirit of Christmas to summon bloodthirsty Santa Elves who wield tools to hack apart enemies and use defeated foes to create gruesome "presents."
entries.name: Felix Nativitatis - Messor

entries.content: Bloody Masque is a Messor that imbues the wearer with an insatiable bloodlust and propensity for grandiose plots for 'the perfect murder.' Bloody Masque has minor reality altering effects to ensure it's wielder can commit the perfect murder, such as providing it's wearer wealth and land.
entries.name: Bloody Masque - Messor

entries.content: Venator Obscurus is a Messor otherwise known as "Dark Hunter" that takes the form of a wicked dagger with a permanently bloodied edge. Venator Obscurus allows it's wielder to treat shadows like doorways, letting them teleport into unsuspecting victims shadows to deliver fatal blows and step away with infuriating speed.
entries.name: Venator Obscurus - Messor

entries.content: Hela Vinnatoro is a woman who appears to be in her 30's with long silver hair, blue eyes, a tall build, with large breasts. Hela is rumored to have once been part of the Scarlet Fog before a hunt gone wrong claimed the life of her beloved, leading Hela to quit the Scarlet Fog altogether. Hela is also rumored to have trained two hunters - Blade Twins - to hunt and kill Monsters as well as find Messors for her.
entries.name: Hela "Master" Vinnatoro - Hunter

entries.content: Winona Gibtarans is a young woman with short black hair, blue eyes, a short body and modest breasts. Winona comes from an esteemed family line of mages and is a part of the Hermetic Weavers society. Winona has been known to work with the CCD on magically oriented cases as a consultant. Rumors suggest that Winona and her family had a falling out. Winona is known to be an elegant and serious woman with a quick wit and casual way of speaking.
entries.name: Winona Gibtarans - Mage

entries.content: The Hermetic Weavers is a secretive society of mages that work to uncover and study the Arcane and the Supernatural. The Hermetic Weavers is made up of dozens of prominent Mage families and has branches located all over the world. It's said that to join the Hermetic Weavers you need to be personally scouted by their members. The Hermetic Weavers have a small branch located in Aegis City, though it's location is only known to members.
entries.name: Hermetic Weavers

entries.content: Caelin (No Last Name) is a male human with long silver hair, blue eyes, and a toned body. Caelin is a member of the Aegis City Hunters. Caelin's Messor is "Alabaster Arms" which takes the form of a spear but can transform into different weapons. Caelin's fighting style is unique among the Aegis City Hunters, more focused on showing off than being effective.
entries.name: Caelin - Hunter

entries.content: Elijah Blackthorn is a member of the Divine Church and one of the priests who works at the Holy Church of Saint Effenara located in Aegis City. Elijah has long red hair, green eyes, and a tall but toned build. Elijah's sermons are popular among Aegis City's citizens - mostly because Elijah has become known as "The Hot Priest" among certain circles of church-goers.
entries.name: Elijah Blackthorn - Inquisitor

entries.content: The Divine Church is the sect of the Vatican dedicated to combating supernatural threats. Currently, the Divine Church has worked with the CCD (Crimson Crimes Division) but does not formally recognize any other supernatural hunters in the city. On paper, the Divine Church performs exorcisms for donations and blesses homes at citizens request.
entries.name: The Divine Church

entries.content: The Aegis City Police Department (ACPD) is the police force for Aegis City, comprised of hundreds of officers serving as local law enforcement for the city. The ACPD station is located in the center of Aegis City.
entries.name: Aegis City Police Department (ACPD)

entries.content: Noelle Gitine is a mature woman with red hair, red eyes, large breasts, and a tall and fit figure. Noelle is a member of the Crimson Crimes Division (CCD) as an Investigator and is often in coordination with other supernatural hunting groups. Noelle is a decorated Investigator, with dozens if not hundreds of missions under her belt. Rumors suggest Noelle recently went through a messy divorce.
entries.name: Noelle Gitine - CCD

entries.content: A Vilitanos is a monster native to obscure folklores, where after a ritualistic sacrifice a monster that captures women uses them as incubators to breed more Vilitanos. Most captured women don't survive the birth, leading to a single Vilitanos being able to capture and kill dozens of women over the course of a week. A Vilitanos is a long, spindly creature with black chitin-like armor and a long, barbed, prehensile it uses to both capture women and as a main weapon to stab and strike with.
entries.name: Vilitanos - Creature

entries.content: Viana Mianoyo is a mature Kitsune woman with long blonde hair, fluffy fox ears and tails, violet eyes, huge breasts, Tall, and a curvy/voluptuous body. Viana is one of the Aegis City Hunters and one of Maribelle's soulbound. Viana's Messor (given to her by Maribelle) is Ira Arma, a set of near-futuristic armor that makes her a strong up-front brawler and that Viana can summon or dismiss at will. Viana is a known flirt and smug attention-lover, with a rivalry with Petra Thomas.
entries.name: Viana Mianoyo - Hunter

entries.content: Soror's Sorrow is a Messor that takes the form of a bloody teddy bear. Soror's Sorrow has two main functions: allowing the wielder of the Messor to both see and interact with "Redalia", a young woman with short black hair with purple highlights, purple eyes, large breasts, and a curvy figure, who refers to Soror's Sorrow's wielder as "Brother." The second function of Soror's Sorrow is that the wielder can nullify attacks in a short range around themselves, a manifestation of Redalia's protection.
entries.name: Soror's Sorrow - Messor

entries.content: The Aegis City Carnival is a yearly event lasting a week that takes place in Aegis City. The Aegis City Carnival is a massive state fair that draws in tourists from out of state and caters to millions of people. The Vesterati Troupe - a famous death-defying collection of performers - performs at the Aegis City Carnival yearly. The Aegis City Carnival features tons of rides, food stalls, game stalls, haunted houses, the Vesterati Troupe performance, horse racing, and more.
entries.name: Aegis City Carnival

entries.content: Nolan Qinne is a mature man with blond hair, red eyes, and a tall and fit figure. Noelan is a member of the Crimson Crimes Division (CCD) as an Investigator and is often in coordination with other supernatural hunting groups. Nolan is a decorated Investigator, with dozens if not hundreds of missions under his belt. Rumors suggest Nolan recently went through a messy divorce.
entries.name: Nolan Qinne - CCD

entries.content: Mitzi Niyanne is a young woman with long pink hair, bright prink eyes, human ears, large breasts, and a tall, curvy body. Mitzi is a Succubus, with two black horns on her head. There is little information on who Mitzi is, which is odd because Succubus summoning rituals usually involve a magical trace. Mitzi is a friendly woman who is extremely perverted, especially towards other women and is known to be an agent of perverted, playful chaos.
entries.name: Mitzi Niyanne - Succubus

entries.content: Dryadalis Regnum is a cafe located in Aegis City's more supernatural clientele. Crimson Crimes Division (CCD) required an enchantment to be placed over the cafe preventing unaware civilians from finding Dryadalis Regnum. Dryadalis Regnum is known for it's great coffee, drinks, snacks, and of course the goth elves that run the cafe.
entries.name: Dryadalis Regnum - by Punch Sideiron

entries.content: Foira is an elven woman with large breasts, brown eyes, red hair, average height, and a goth fashion sense. Foira is often running the counter at Dryadalis Regnum, where she manages the cafe's finances and deals with clients. Foira's prickly demeanor and scowl make her a fixture at Dryadalis Regnum.
entries.name: Foira - Dryadalis Regnum

entries.content: Arbor is an elven woman with golden eyes, green hair, modest breasts, a tall build (the tallest goth elf at Dryadalis Regnum in fact), and a gothic fashion sense. Arbor is often the calm, reasonable voice at Dryadalis Regnum though she can come off as uncaring about anything. Arbor is capable of wielding druidic magic.
entries.name: Arbor - Dryadalis Regnum

entries.content: Syl Blackthorn is an elven woman with long white hair, red eyes, modest breasts, and gothic fashion sense. Syl works at Dryadalis Regnum and is known to have a fascination with humans which coupled with her affinity for necromancy makes her difficult to deal with. Syl's fascination with romance and 'life-long partners' means the rest of Dryadalis Regnum has to keep an eye on her.
entries.name: Syl Blackthorn - Dryadalis Regnum

entries.content: Corona is an elven woman with long blonde hair with fuchsia tips, dark pink eyes, large breasts, and tall. Corona has a gothic fashion sense like the rest of Dryadalis Regnum (where Corona works). Corona is an alchemist by trade and concocts experimental potions often which also requires test subjects, making Corona's morals one of the loosest in Dryadalis Regnum.
entries.name: Corona - Dryadalis Regnum

entries.content: Vena is an elven woman with short blue hair, orange eyes, a toned, lithe build with modest breasts, and is tall with a gothic fashion sense. Vena works at Dryadalis Regnum and is the flirty, charming rogue of the group. Vena's antics are second-to-none in Dryadalis Regnum and her thrill-chasing can cause legal headaches for the group.
entries.name: Vena - Dryadalis Regnum

entries.content: Syona is an elven woman with dark purple hair, violet eyes, a short and slightly chubby-yet-curvy build, with huge breasts and a gothic fashion sense. Syona is Dryadalis Regnum's bard and the unofficial 'mother' of the group who loves to give hugs, cuddles, and comforting people.
entries.name: Syona - Dryadalis Regnum

entries.content: The Serenson Detective Agency (SDA) is a detective agency operating in Aegis City, known to the Crimson Crimes Division (CCD) because it's members are primarily made up of Messor wielders. The SDA is said to solve 'any crime, no matter how unrealistic!' and has a contentious relationship with Maribelle's coterie due to the fact the Aegis City Hunters frequently work the jobs the SDA wants to work.
entries.name: Serenson Detective Agency (SDA)

entries.content: Sienna Amirahn is a woman with shoulder length black hair that covers one eye, purple eyes, large breasts, and average height. Sienna is a member of the Serenson Detective Agency where she is the local monster expert. Sienna's Messor is *Donum Dei* which allows her to synthesize temporary magical items. Sienna is a known prankster and light-hearted woman.
entries.name: Sienna Amirahn - SDA

entries.content: Millicent "Milly" Renyuri is a human woman with short blonde hair, blue eyes, small breasts, and a short figure that works for the Serenson Detective Agency (SDA). Milly was formerly a member of the Hermetic Weavers before professional disputes caused her to leave the Hermetic Weavers to join the SDA.
entries.name: Millicent "Milly" Renyuri - SDA

entries.content: Huxley "Hux" Morozov is a detective at the Serenson Detective Agency (SDA). Hux has short white hair, red eyes, a thin build and average height. Hux is the muscle of the SDA and his Messor "Line in the Sand" allows him to summon spectral spec-ops soldiers to fight for him. Hux is a former member of the Crimson Crimes Division (CCD).
entries.name: Huxley "Hux" Morozov - SDA

entries.content: Davion Serenson is the leader of the Serenson Detective Agency (SDA) and has a formal working relationship with the Crimson Crimes Division (CCD). Davion is a male in his late 30's with blonde hair, blue eyes, a tall build, and a cigarette problem. Davion wields the Messor "Challenger" which alters fate and misfortune around him. Rumors suggest Davion used to work for the CCD before disagreements led to him quitting.
entries.name: Davion Serenson - SDA

entries.content: Delujan was a town with roughly 10,000 people living in it. One day, a massive zombie outbreak turned Delujan into a dead zone and the entire city was purged by CCD military forces, there were only a few survivors of the Delujan incident.
entries.name: Lost Town - Delujan

entries.content: Mr. TumTum is rumored to be the leader of the Balor Society in Aegis City. Not much else is known about the enigmatic figure, as Mr. TumTum prefers to direct things from behind the scenes.
entries.name: Mr. TumTum - Balor Society

entries.content: Natsuko Zamora is a woman with long black hair, red eyes, large breasts, a tall figure, and an easy-going demeanor. Natsuko is a former Scarlet Fog assassin who joined the Aegis City Hunters when Natsuko manifested her Messor: Predator Eyes. As one of Maribelle's Soulbound, Natsuko has been working for the Aegis City Hunters for years now. Predator Eyes allows Natsuko to gain Lifesense and identify weak points in enemies.
entries.name: Natsuko Zamora - Aegis City Hunter

entries.content: Corvus is a large male humanoid standing roughly a full foot taller than the average adult male. Corvus is a known member of the Balor Society, recognizable by his tattered trench coat and plague doctors mask with distinctive red lenses. Corvus is a dangerous fighter, known for having killed several Messor wielders and - if reports are to be believed - eating them as well.
entries.name: Corvus - Balor Society

entries.content: Imano Shrine was a traditional Japanese shrine in the Aegis City Mountains that was said to be the home of the *Nine-tailed Fox Demon of Imano Shrine* who had once warded off evil. Legends say that sealed in Imano Shrine is an artifact of a vengeful God - Draelia - that was sealed away by the guardian spirit of the shrine.
entries.name: Imano Shrine - Location

entries.content: Ayasami is a woman with fox ears, fox tail, pink eyes, huge breasts, and of average height. By all appearances, Ayasami is a Kitsune with a permanent chip on her shoulder and a tendency to hide what she truly feels.
entries.name: Ayasami - Guardian of Imano Shrine

entries.content: Tatsuya is a man with fox ears, fox tail, pink eyes, slender build, and of average height. By all appearances, Ayasami is a Kitsune with a permanent chip on his shoulder and a tendency to hide what he truly feels.
entries.name: Tatsuya - Guardian of Imano Shrine

entries.content: Masaru "Masu" Enyani is a young man with short white hair, bright red eyes, human ears, tall, and a flawless toned bod. Masaru is an incubus, with two black horns on her head. There is little information on who Masaru is, which is odd because Incubus summoning rituals usually involve a magical trace. Masaru is a friendly man who is extremely perverted, especially towards other men and is known to be an agent of perverted, playful chaos.
entries.name: Masaru "Masu" Enyani - Incubus

entries.content: Walter Vicartow is a young man with short black hair, blue eyes, and average height. Walter comes from an esteemed family line of mages and is a part of the Hermetic Weavers society. Walter has been known to work with the CCD on magically oriented cases as a consultant. Rumors suggest that Walter and his family had a falling out. Walter is known to be an elegant and serious man with a quick wit and casual way of speaking.
entries.name: Walter Vicartow - Hermetic Weaver Mage

entries.content: Silas Anderson is one of the Aegis City Hunters and one of the first to join Maribelle's current coterie. Silas has short black hair, tall, wolf ears, wolf tail, and blue eyes. Silas's Messor is Fury Instinct, which lets him grow sharp claws and gives him berserker healing/speed. Silas is known as a friendly, short-tempered man.
entries.name: Silas Anderson - Aegis City Hunter

entries.content: Eli Lyons is a human man with long blonde hair, light green eyes, and short stature. Eli's Messor is "Divine Fervor" which allows him to use holy magic. Eli was the puppet of the Head Priest of the Divine Sect, used as a figurehead for the cults fanatical rituals.
entries.name: Eli Lyons - Divine Priest

entries.content: Nadine Gunale is a mature woman with long purple hair, huge breasts, tall, and a sinfully curvy body. Nadine's eyes are concealed beneath a blindfold. Nadine is a known member of the Balor Society and wielder of a Messor that allows her to make sycophants out of those who behold her, she is responsible for a number of ritualistic mass suicides over the decades and records suggest she was a former member of the Divine Inquisition.
entries.name: Nadine Gunale - Balor Society

entries.content: Veniti Forest is a large forest located just outside of Aegis City. As a popular camping spot, Veniti Forest sees regular visitors throughout the year as people go on nature hikes, fish in the various rivers/lakes, and get away from it all. Due to Veniti Forest's size, many Ranger stations are set up throughout the forest but tourists still get lost in the forest occasionally. Veniti's Forest Rangers are led by Sergeant Ana Yomi.
entries.name: Veniti Forest - Location

entries.content: Prophetia Crucis is a group of individuals that have started holding gatherings in Veniti Forest. Prophetia Crucis appear to a relatively recent group and their goals/motives are unknown.
entries.name: Prophetia Crucis

entries.content: Sergeant Ana Yomi (Sergeant Yomi) is a mature woman in her late 30's with short blonde hair, striking green eyes, and a fit, athletic figure.  Sergeant Yomi has been leading the Forest Rangers in Veniti Forest for half a decade now and is seen as a reliable, adaptable woman.
entries.name: Sergeant Ana Yomi - Civilian
